title: Manager, Sales Operations
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
We are looking for an Operations Manager - Revenue and Solution Engineering to support our global GTM teams by delivering rapid, quality support to the global Solution Engineering, RevOps and Enablement teams. This role reports to the Senior Director of Services, with dotted-lines to the Demo Engineering, RevOps and Revenue Enablement leaders, based in the US.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* 2-5+ years of leading high performing teams, ideally supporting sales functions
* 3+ years working with SaaS products and technologies
* Demonstrated ability to work cross functionally
* Familiarity with SaaS businesses, metrics, goals, challenges
* Knowledge of technology in the sales tech, CRM or martech space
* Knowledge of how businesses and sales teams operate in our target market
* Proven strong executive leadership and decision making abilities
* Strong communication skills, ability to articulate and sell a vision internally and externally
* Strong execution skills and the ability to drive action and accountability
* Proven track record of hiring, developing and managing world-class talent
* Experience working with and/or deploying Sales/Marketing/Service technologies.
* Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce.com, Dynamics 365).
* Entrepreneurial spirit and mindset, a focus on possibilities and not obstacle
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and change
* Proven track record of defining and optimizing processes
* Strong written and spoken English

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Lead and oversee a team of Revenue Enablement, Revenue Operations and Demo Engineering

practitioners for daily local management.
  
  

* Support the global Solution Engineering teams to deliver and maintain our standard and custom demo capability.
* Work with the global Enablement & Operations team to establish the strategy, plan, and prioritization for process and tool enablement for internal teams, including both JIT and formal training strategies.
* Lead and oversee a small team of Revenue Operations system administrators supporting Salesforce and the broader GTM technology stack.
* Scale Organizations, Processes and Operations. Work with global leaders to design, refine and innovate the service and processes as our company grows and evolves.
* Report on key metrics to indicate the success of global programmes.
* Develop a High Performing, High Engagement Team and Culture. Coach and develop your direct reports. Demonstrate very high emotional intelligence. Set and uphold the highest performance standards. Help colleagues “enjoy the ride” - one of our core guiding principles.
* Partner effectively across functions. Act as an ally and partner to colleagues in sister functions - Product, Account Management, Marketing and others - making decisions that take broader perspectives into account and providing insight into others’ decisions. Demonstrate a balanced, reasoned approach to conflict or differing priorities.
* Cultivate deep product knowledge. Gain deep knowledge, understanding, and experience with the Highspot platform and the value it provides businesses.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
  
  
Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
  
  
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

title: CoFounder - Content, Growth & Sales
description:
**About Entrext**

Entrext is a venture-building company focused on identifying real-world problems and building businesses through technology, experimentation, and business development.

**About Stage**

Stage is an early-stage SaaS venture being developed within Entrext, with the vision of growing into an independent company.

We’re building Stage as a
**communication layer between clients and the developers, designers, and product teams bringing their ideas to life.**

During a project, feedback often gets scattered across WhatsApp, emails, screenshots, and calls. As conversations grow, the original context gets lost. A simple change can lead to repeated follow-ups, misunderstandings, and unnecessary revision rounds.

Stage brings feedback closer to the actual work. Clients can point to the specific part of a webpage, design, app, or digital product they want changed and leave feedback in context. The person working on it can respond and keep the discussion connected to that specific change.

The goal is simple:
**less time clarifying feedback, less effort chasing conversations, and fewer unnecessary revisions caused by misunderstandings.**

Stage isn't another messaging tool. It's a way to keep communication connected to the work, from the first feedback to its resolution.

Website:
https://stage.entrext.com

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a
**Co-Founder to own Content, Growth & Sales from zero.**

You’ll help take Stage to market, find the right customers, build relationships, and turn an early-stage product into a business with real customers and repeatable growth.

There is no established playbook. You’ll help create it.

**What You’ll Own**

* **ICP & Go-to-Market:**

  Identify our ideal customers and figure out how to reach them.
* **Customer Acquisition:**

  Build our initial customer base among web development agencies, freelancers, designers, and product teams.
* **Content & Distribution:**

  Create content that connects with real customer problems and attracts the right audience.
* **Outbound & Partnerships:**

  Reach out to potential customers, build relationships, and explore relevant partnerships.
* **Sales & Conversion:**

  Talk to customers, demonstrate Stage, understand objections, and turn conversations into active users and paying customers.
* **Market Validation:**

  Test assumptions, gather feedback, and identify what customers actually need.
* **Growth Experiments:**

  Experiment with acquisition channels, messaging, and positioning until we find what works consistently.
* **Business Building:**

  Help shape Stage's direction and eventually build its growth and sales function.

**Who We’re Looking For**

Someone who enjoys building from zero and is comfortable figuring things out without waiting for instructions.

You should be willing to:

* Talk to customers and understand their problems.
* Build relationships and explore opportunities.
* Create content and handle outbound outreach.
* Sell, negotiate, and handle rejection.
* Test ideas, learn from failures, and adapt quickly.
* Take ownership of outcomes rather than just completing assigned tasks.

Experience in SaaS, B2B sales, startup growth, or agency business development is valuable. A perfect founder résumé isn't necessary. We care more about your ability to execute, learn, and build.

**What You Get**

**25% Equity | Co-Founder Role**

* Real ownership and responsibility in building Stage.
* The opportunity to shape its growth, sales, and business strategy from the beginning.
* Direct collaboration with Entrext's product, technology, and venture-building ecosystem.
* The opportunity to help develop Stage into an independent company.

Stage is currently being developed within Entrext, with the intention of establishing it as a separate venture as it grows. The proposed equity will relate to the future independent Stage company, subject to the agreed legal structure and formal documentation.

This is an
**equity-only opportunity**

, with no guaranteed salary. Equity terms, vesting, founder responsibilities, and the future company structure will be discussed transparently with the selected candidate.

This isn't a conventional growth job. It's an opportunity to help build a company.

**Interested?**

If you enjoy solving real problems, talking to customers, finding opportunities, and building something from the ground up, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
ProArch is seeking an experienced, revenue-driven Inside Sales & Business Development leader to drive global pipeline generation, enterprise prospecting, GTM execution, and business growth across North America markets.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strategic sales planning with hands-on execution, leading inside sales resources, developing targeted go-to-market programs, engaging enterprise stakeholders, and supporting opportunities through qualification, solution positioning, commercial negotiations, and deal closure.
  
  
The role will work closely with Marketing, Account Executives, Solution Architects, Delivery teams, and technology partners such as Microsoft to accelerate pipeline growth and improve sales conversion across ProArch's Cloud, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation offerings.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Global Inside Sales & Business Development
* Drive inside sales and business development initiatives across North America, markets
* Develop territory plans, account penetration strategies, target account lists, and enterprise prospecting programs
* Identify new business opportunities across Microsoft Cloud, Azure, Fabric , Data & AI, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation services
* Build relationships with business leaders, technology executives, and C-level stakeholders to identify business challenges and transformation opportunities
* Drive qualified pipeline creation, opportunity progression, account acquisition, and revenue contribution
* Go-to-Market Strategy & Demand Generation
* Develop and execute quarterly GTM strategies aligned with company offerings, revenue objectives, industry verticals, and market opportunities
* Partner with Marketing to plan and execute outbound campaigns, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), Contact-Based Marketing (CBM), and targeted demand-generation initiatives
* Develop compelling value propositions, industry-specific messaging, email sequences, call scripts, and multichannel prospecting plays
* Translate ProArch's technical capabilities into business-focused messaging that resonates with enterprise buyers
* Identify new market segments, buying triggers, technology trends, and cross-selling opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness
* SDR Leadership & Sales Enablement
* Lead, mentor, and coach SDRs, BDMs, and inside sales professionals to achieve pipeline and business development targets
* Establish sales development processes, operating cadences, productivity benchmarks, and performance management frameworks
* Build repeatable prospecting methodologies, qualification frameworks, objection-handling guides, and sales playbooks
* Train teams to engage enterprise buyers and position complex technology services through consultative selling
* Monitor individual and team performance, identify execution gaps, and implement corrective action plans to improve productivity and conversion
* Microsoft Ecosystem & Partner-Led GTM
* Develop co-sell strategies and campaigns around Azure, Microsoft 365, Data & AI, Security, and other relevant Microsoft technologies
* Identify opportunities to leverage partner relationships, customer transformation initiatives, and eligible funding programs to accelerate sales conversations
* Align outbound campaigns with Microsoft priorities, customer needs, and ProArch's service capabilities
* Pipeline Governance, Forecasting & Performance Management
* Own pipeline reviews, opportunity inspections, forecasting, CRM hygiene, and sales performance reporting
* Establish KPIs for prospecting activity, qualified opportunities, pipeline value, stage progression, conversion rates, and revenue contribution
* Review campaign performance and lead-to-opportunity conversion to improve targeting and sales effectiveness
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, deal risks, and growth opportunities
* Drive accountability through structured weekly reviews, monthly performance assessments, and quarterly business reviews
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Marketing, Account Executives, Solution Architects, Delivery, and Customer Success teams to ensure alignment across the sales lifecycle
* Provide market feedback, buyer insights, competitive intelligence, and campaign performance inputs to refine GTM strategies
* Ensure effective handoffs between demand generation, sales qualification, opportunity management, and account teams
* Contribute to the development of scalable sales processes, enablement assets, and technology-driven sales operations

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* 8-15 years of experience in inside sales, business development, demand generation, enterprise sales, or technology services sales
* Proven experience leading inside sales or business development teams serving international markets, preferably North America
* Strong understanding of IT services and enterprise technology solutions, particularly Cloud, Azure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Microsoft technologies, or Digital Transformation
* Demonstrated success in building qualified sales pipelines, developing GTM strategies, and improving opportunity conversion
* Experience in ABM, outbound prospecting, enterprise account targeting, and consultative selling
* Experience working with CRM platforms and sales engagement tools, with strong forecasting and pipeline management capabilities
* Excellent communication, executive engagement, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills
* Experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or equivalent tools
* Exposure to AI-led sales enablement, sales automation, and data-driven demand generation
* Experience working with Microsoft or other major technology partner ecosystems

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)"**
Performance will be measured against agreed business objectives, including:
  
  

* Qualified pipeline generated and pipeline coverage against targets
* Number and value of sales-qualified opportunities created
* Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-win conversion rates
* Pipeline progression, sales cycle effectiveness, and forecast accuracy
* New logo acquisition and strategic account penetration
* Revenue contribution and closed-won business, where applicable
* SDR/BDM productivity, target attainment, and team performance
* GTM campaign effectiveness and enterprise stakeholder engagement

description:
**Company Description**
HUNOVO Tech Labs is a growing technology-focused organization dedicated to building innovative solutions for modern business challenges. The company emphasizes collaboration, learning, and the use of advanced tools to deliver value-driven products and services. Team members are encouraged to explore new ideas, contribute to strategic initiatives, and participate in continuous improvement. HUNOVO Tech Labs offers an environment where motivated professionals can develop their careers while contributing to impactful technology solutions.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a proactive, ambitious, and communication-driven Business Development Associate who enjoys connecting with people, exploring business opportunities, and starting conversations with potential customers.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, technology, and business. You will be responsible for identifying potential clients, reaching out to business decision-makers, understanding their challenges, and generating qualified sales opportunities for our team.

We are not looking for someone who simply wants to make calls or send emails. We are looking for someone who is curious about businesses, confident in communication, comfortable with outbound sales, and motivated by achieving results.

If you enjoy researching companies, speaking with new people, and building relationships, this role could be a great starting point for your career in B2B technology sales.

**What You Will Do**

**1. Prospect Research & Lead Generation**

* Research companies across different industries that could benefit from our AI solutions.
* Identify potential customers, key decision-makers, CEOs, founders, CXOs, and department heads.
* Build and maintain targeted prospect databases using LinkedIn, Google, Apollo, and other research tools.

**2. Outbound Sales & Client Engagement**

* Initiate conversations with potential clients through cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other outreach channels.
* Write personalized outreach messages that capture attention and generate interest.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and build meaningful business conversations.
* Confidently introduce our company and AI solutions to potential customers.

**3. Lead Qualification & Meeting Generation**

* Understand prospect requirements, business challenges, and potential use cases.
* Identify whether a prospect is a good fit for our solutions.
* Generate qualified leads and schedule discovery calls, product demos, and meetings for the sales team and founders.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline of potential business opportunities.

**4. CRM & Performance Tracking**

* Maintain accurate records of calls, emails, follow-ups, and lead status in the CRM.
* Track daily and weekly outreach activities, qualified leads, and meetings booked.
* Monitor performance metrics and continuously improve outreach effectiveness.

**5. Market & Product Learning**

* Develop a strong understanding of our AI solutions and their business applications.
* Research industry trends, customer requirements, and competitor offerings.
* Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Fresh graduates or candidates with 0–2 years of experience in sales, business development, lead generation, or inside sales.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Confidence in speaking with new people over phone calls and virtual meetings.
* Strong research and analytical skills.
* Willingness to make cold calls, send outbound emails, and connect with senior business professionals.
* Ability to write clear, professional, and personalized business messages.
* A genuine interest in sales, business development, AI, and emerging technologies.
* Persistence and a positive attitude when dealing with rejection.
* Strong follow-up skills and the ability to manage multiple prospects.
* A target-oriented mindset with a willingness to take ownership of results.

**What Will Give You an Advantage**

* Experience in cold calling, telecalling, lead generation, or client acquisition.
* Internship or practical experience in sales or business development.
* Basic understanding of SaaS, AI, cloud computing, or B2B technology.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, or similar tools.
* Experience researching companies and identifying business decision-makers.

**Who Should Apply?**

This role is ideal for individuals who:

* Enjoy speaking with people and building professional relationships.
* Are comfortable initiating conversations rather than waiting for leads to come in.
* Have the confidence to communicate with founders, CEOs, and senior decision-makers.
* Are motivated by targets, performance, and professional growth.
* Want to build a long-term career in B2B sales and technology.
* Are eager to learn how AI solutions solve real-world business challenges.

**Why Join Us?**

* Gain hands-on experience in AI and B2B technology sales.
* Work closely with founders and experienced business leaders.
* Learn professional prospecting, consultative selling, and enterprise sales.
* Develop valuable skills in communication, negotiation, and client acquisition.
* Get the opportunity to grow with a fast-paced and ambitious team.

title: Key Accounts Manager – Cross-Border Payments (B2B)
description:
About GlocalPe™

GlocalPe™ is a B2B cross-border payments and financial infrastructure platform being developed by Dhaniti™ Fintech Solutions Private Limited. Its business proposition covers international
**pay-ins (collections) and pay-outs (payments)**
for businesses and ecosystem partners.

Dhaniti's broader portfolio includes DhanitiPay™, a platform combining UPI-led digital payments with responsible credit enablement. We focus on building technology-enabled financial solutions with an emphasis on trust, transparency, compliance, and reliable service.

About the Role

**Can you win new customers, activate their business, and grow the relationship?**

We are looking for a commercially driven B2B sales professional to acquire and grow customers for GlocalPe™.

This is an
**acquisition-led sales role**
, not simply an account-servicing position. You will identify businesses with international collection and payment requirements, engage decision-makers, win new customers, support onboarding and initial transactions, and grow the business routed through GlocalPe.

The role covers the complete customer journey:

**Prospecting → Customer Acquisition → Solution Selling → Onboarding → Activation → Account Growth → Retention → Cross-sell → Referrals**

What You Will Do1. Find and acquire new customers

* Identify and approach SMEs, enterprises, exporters, importers, and other businesses with cross-border payment requirements.
* Build your own sales pipeline through market mapping, direct outreach, referrals, industry networks, events, and professional relationships.
* Engage business owners, founders, CFOs, finance heads, and treasury teams.
* Understand customers' payment flows, transaction volumes, business requirements, existing arrangements, and pain points.
* Present suitable GlocalPe solutions, handle objections, negotiate, and close new business.

2. Onboard and activate customers

* Coordinate with Operations and Compliance teams to facilitate customer onboarding and documentation.
* Guide customers through onboarding requirements, payment processes, and transaction workflows.
* Help new customers complete their initial transactions and address barriers to activation.
* Follow up until acquired customers become active sources of business.

3. Grow accounts and increase transaction volumes

* Understand customers' eligible cross-border payment business and identify opportunities to increase the share routed through GlocalPe.
* Develop customer relationships to expand transaction volumes, frequency, and recurring business.
* Identify opportunities across both pay-ins and pay-outs, subject to product availability and customer eligibility.
* Monitor declining or inactive accounts and take corrective action to improve engagement and business activity.
* Develop repeat business, cross-sell opportunities, and referrals.

4. Deliver business results

* Own assigned targets for new customer acquisition, customer activation, transaction volumes, and revenue.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular updates on prospects, conversions, forecasts, and business performance.
* Work with Product, Operations, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to address customer requirements and resolve issues.
* Share market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitor insights to support business development.
* Follow applicable KYC, RBI/FEMA, and other relevant compliance requirements. Sales targets must never override compliance obligations.

Must-Have Qualifications

* **5+ years of experience**
  in B2B business development, enterprise sales, key account management, or relationship-led sales in fintech, payments, forex, remittance, trade finance, or related financial services.
* Proven experience in
  **new customer acquisition**
  , not just servicing an existing customer portfolio.
* A demonstrated track record of achieving sales, revenue, transaction-volume, or acquisition targets.
* Good understanding of B2B payment flows and the business requirements associated with international collections and payments.
* Experience managing customer relationships from prospecting and acquisition through onboarding, activation, and account growth.
* Ability to engage business owners, founders, CFOs, finance heads, and other senior decision-makers.
* Strong prospecting, presentation, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently build a pipeline, follow through on opportunities, and take ownership of business targets.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development as required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with cross-border payments, international payments, forex, remittance, or payment platforms.
* Existing relationships with SMEs, exporters, importers, enterprises, or businesses engaged in international trade and services.
* Experience in trade finance, treasury, foreign exchange, or international transaction services.
* A professional network among founders, CFOs, finance heads, and treasury professionals.
* Familiarity with payment processing, APIs, integrations, reconciliation, settlement, or technology-enabled financial services.
* Experience growing transaction volumes, increasing customer share of business, and generating referrals.
* Exposure to CRM tools, sales automation, data-driven account management, or AI-enabled sales tools.
* Working knowledge of applicable RBI/FEMA requirements for cross-border payment activities.
* Availability to join immediately

You do not need to be a technology specialist, but you should be comfortable explaining payment solutions in business terms and coordinating with technical teams when required.

What Success Looks Like

* A consistent pipeline of qualified prospects and newly acquired B2B customers.
* Successful onboarding and activation of new customers.
* Growth in recurring transactions, transaction volumes, and revenue.
* Increased share of eligible customer business routed through GlocalPe.
* Strong retention, account expansion, cross-sell, and referral business.
* Achievement of assigned commercial targets while maintaining compliant business practices.

Why Join GlocalPe™?

* **Build new business:**
  Acquire customers and develop your own portfolio rather than relying solely on inherited accounts.
* **Own the customer relationship:**
  Stay involved from the first conversation through onboarding, activation, and account growth.
* **Work across payment use cases:**
  Develop experience across international collections, payments, and B2B financial infrastructure.
* **Grow with the business:**
  Strong performers may take on larger customer portfolios, broader commercial responsibilities, and leadership opportunities as the business expands.

What to Expect if Shortlisted

1. **Initial screening:**
   Discussion of your experience, sales track record, location, and availability.
2. **Business discussion:**
   Assessment of your acquisition approach, cross-border payments knowledge, customer network, and commercial achievements.
3. **Leadership discussion:**
   Conversation about customer acquisition, account growth, business ownership, and your approach to targets.
4. **Offer and onboarding:**
   For selected candidates.

How to Apply

Please submit an updated resume highlighting:

* Your B2B sales, business development, and account management experience.
* Previous acquisition, transaction-volume, or revenue targets and actual achievements, wherever available.
* Customer segments, industries, and cross-border payment use cases you have handled.
* Your current location, notice period, and earliest possible joining date.

**We are looking for hands-on B2B sales professionals who can win new customers, convert opportunities into active business, and grow customer relationships into sustainable revenue.**

Dhaniti™ does not charge candidates any fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

Key Focus Areas

**B2B Sales | Business Development | Cross-Border Payments | International Pay-ins & Pay-outs | Customer Acquisition | Enterprise Sales | Key Account Management | Account Growth | Forex | Trade Finance | Import-Export | Payment Solutions | Fintech**

title: Startup Account Manager - Greenfield, India Startups Team
description:
**Description**
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all. We give founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With nearly two decades of experience, gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups, the AWS Startups team helps founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth, and any level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, choose to launch on AWS.
  
  
AWS continues to rapidly grow and we seek a Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth with well-funded and high-potential startups. In this fast-moving business, the core responsibility is to ensure that new and high-potential startups choose AWS as their cloud platform to transform and accelerate their business. We work backwards from the customer and partner with technical team members, business development, and stakeholders to lead scaled Go-to-Market strategies, accelerate adoption and drive customer success.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a passion to work with innovators and new technologies, has a strong sales background, and has the technical aptitude to learn and discuss the latest technologies, such as generative AI, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data services, and sustainable computing. This is a fast-paced role. We work at the speed of startup founders, are able to engage personas from developers to technical founders and CXOs. You will work along side Solution Architects and Product Specialists, Inside Sales, Business Development, and technology and services partners. You will be a self-starter, travel for in-person meetings, and attend events. You will develop and execute against a territory coverage plan and consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets and measurable business objectives.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure customer success with early and mid stage startups
* Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
* Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy
* Meet or exceed quarterly revenue and goal targets.
* Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
* Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.
* Accelerate customer adoption by engaging Founders, CxO, Board of Directors and VC influencers
* Work with partners to extend reach & drive adoption.
* Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.
* Expect moderate travel.

**About The Team**
About the team
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of technology sales experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Inside Sales Representative — Outreach
description:
Appointment Setting, Call Centre, Customer Aquisition, Customer Service, Inside Sales, Outbound Sales, Sales
  
  
**Inside Sales Representative — Outreach**
Full-Time Remote Position
  
  
U.S. Eastern Time Business Hours
  
  
**Annual Target Earnings: C$40,000–C$50,000**
The Role
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring Inside Sales Representatives to introduce residential property owners to its rental-guarantee program.
  
  
The program costs C$100 per month. If a covered tenant defaults on rent, the program is designed to provide the owner with an amount equal to the property’s monthly rent, subject to the program’s terms, approval requirements, and claim conditions.
  
  
You will contact company-provided property-owner leads through an automatic dialer, identify whether they meet the campaign requirements, respond to objections, and connect qualified owners with a Royal York sales representative.
  
  
You will not complete the final sale or determine approval. Your success will depend on how effectively you turn outbound conversations into qualified live transfers.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns with the role, you will receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.
  
  
The interview includes realistic property-owner calling scenarios designed to evaluate your communication, objection handling, judgment, and coachability.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Make continuous outbound calls using an automatic dialer.
* Introduce Royal York and the rental-guarantee program.
* Ask questions about the owner and their rental property.
* Confirm the number of properties and whether they are occupied or vacant.
* Explain the C$100 monthly cost and the program’s potential value.
* Respond to objections involving price, need, trust, timing, or existing tenants.
* Build interest without using aggressive or misleading tactics.
* Ask qualified owners to speak with a Royal York sales representative.
* Complete warm and live transfers.
* Record accurate call notes, outcomes, and dispositions.
* Follow campaign scripts, qualification rules, and opt-out procedures.
* Meet hourly and daily calling and transfer targets.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Three or more years of experience in inside sales, outbound sales, telesales, appointment setting, lead generation, call-centre sales, or live transfers.
* Experience working with an automatic or predictive dialer.
* Strong objection-handling and persuasive communication skills.
* Experience meeting call, transfer, appointment, conversion, or sales targets.
* Clear and professional spoken English.
* Confidence speaking with property owners throughout the day.
* The ability to remain calm when prospects are skeptical, impatient, or upset.
* Strong listening skills and the ability to adapt during a conversation.
* Accurate CRM, call-note, and disposition habits.
* Openness to coaching, call monitoring, and performance feedback.
* Full-time availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Property management, real estate, insurance, financial services, telecommunications, home services, or other consumer-sales experience is an asset but not required.
  
  
Experience with Convoso, Five9, NICE CXone, Genesys Cloud CX, CallTools, Readymode, or similar software is preferred.
  
  
Remote Work Requirements
  
  
**You Must Have**

* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM.
* Dual monitors, including an external monitor of at least 22 inches.
* A wired USB noise-cancelling headset.
* A webcam.
* A quiet and professional workspace.
* Wired internet with at least 100 Mbps download speed.
* Backup internet and power arrangements.
* The ability to work in a dialer, CRM, and campaign system simultaneously.

How Success Will Be Measured
  
  
**Performance Will Be Evaluated Through**

* Qualified and accepted live transfers.
* Hourly and daily calling results.
* Qualification accuracy.
* Objection-handling effectiveness.
* Call quality and professionalism.
* Accurate records and dispositions.
* Attendance and schedule adherence.
* Compliance with campaign requirements.

Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right candidate is persuasive without being aggressive and can explain financial value in simple language.
  
  
You should be comfortable discussing why an owner might pay C$100 per month to help protect an entire month of rental income if a covered tenant defaults.
  
  
You do not need direct property-management experience or a perfect script immediately. You must demonstrate strong communication fundamentals, resilience, and the ability to improve through coaching.

title: Sales Executive – Commercial Leasing
description:
**Company Description**
Pinakin Spaces creates high-end office environments for entrepreneurs, founders, and business leaders who seek premium workspaces aligned with their ambitions. Based in HITEC City, Hyderabad, the company offers luxurious offices that combine sophisticated design, high-end amenities, and a prime business address. Each workspace is crafted to enhance productivity, support business growth, and leave a lasting impression on clients and partners. Pinakin Spaces positions its offices as more than just workplaces, but as experiences that reflect and elevate the success and stature of the organizations that operate there.

**THE JOB, PLAINLY**

You take a raw enquiry, a founder who filled a form at 11 PM, a GCC admin scouting 40 seats, a walk-in, and you turn it into a signed agreement.

Most days you'll be:

* On the floor. 3–6 site tours a day. This is a walk-the-space role, not a desk job. The space does half the selling; you close the other half.
* On the phone. Qualifying inbound, chasing the ones who went quiet, working your own outbound list.
* With brokers. Hyderabad runs on channel partners. You keep IPC and broker relationships warm so requirements land on your desk first.
* Negotiating. Price holds, term lengths, seat counts, and the "we've seen two other spaces" conversation.
* Closing and handing over. Signed, collected, handed to the Community team so the client's first day is flawless.
* On your numbers. Pipeline, conversion ratio, monthly sales value. You should know all three without being asked.

**WHAT YOU OWN**

1. Monthly sales value. ₹2,00,000/month is the target. Every seat counts at its monthly rent value.
2. Your pipeline. Enquiries to tours to proposals to closures. No lead goes cold on your watch.
3. Broker and channel network. Build it, feed it, keep it warm.
4. Handover quality. The Community team inherits your client. Make that first day perfect.

**THE MONEY**

Fixed: ₹30,000 per month in hand (₹3.6 lakh per annum, take-home).

*We know that's modest.*

We'd rather tell you straight than waste your afternoon.
*Here's the part that isn't modest:*
commission on the monthly rent value of every seat you close:

* Up to ₹3,00,000 in a month: 5% → about ₹790 per seat
* ₹3,00,001 to ₹5,00,000: 10% → about ₹1,580 per seat
* Above ₹5,00,000: 15% → about ₹2,370 per seat

Our seats are ₹15,800/month. So ₹3,00,000 is roughly 19 seats, and ₹5,00,000 is roughly 32 seats.

Paid monthly. No cap. No "subject to management discretion."

**PROOF, NOT PROMISES**

Our previous salesperson averaged ₹3–5 lakh of sales value every month. 19 to 32 seats. He was paid on this exact commission table. That worked out to
**₹7.2 lakh to ₹9.6 lakh**
a year.

We're not asking you to believe a projection. We're telling you what the person in this chair already earned.

**WHAT THE MONTHS ACTUALLY LOOK LIKE**

13 seats (₹2.06L) → 5% → ₹10,270 → ₹40,270 that month → ₹4.83L a year

18 seats (₹2.84L) → 5% → ₹14,220 → ₹44,220 that month → ₹5.31L a year

19 seats (₹3.00L) → 10% → ₹30,020 → ₹60,020 that month → ₹7.20L a year

25 seats (₹3.95L) → 10% → ₹39,500 → ₹69,500 that month → ₹8.34L a year

32 seats (₹5.06L) → 15% → ₹75,840 → ₹1,05,840 that month → ₹12.70L a year

Look at seat 18 and seat 19. Not a typo. Closing one more seat a month takes your annual earnings from ₹5.31L to ₹7.20L — because crossing ₹3,00,000 doubles your commission rate on everything you closed that month.

We built it this way deliberately. We don't want to pay people for showing up. We'd rather pay one person ₹7 lakh than two people ₹4 lakh.

Your fixed salary is reviewed at six months, on performance, not tenure.

**THE DETAILS**

* Location: Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad. Work from our centre.
* Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM. Sunday off.
* Travel: Client visits within Hyderabad. Travel allowance covered.
* Start: Immediate to 30 days.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

One of these three:

* MBA graduate (Marketing / Sales / General Management) - fresh to 3 years
* 1+ year in commercial real estate or office leasing - coworking, IPC, brokerage, developer leasing
* A sales record we can verify - you've closed deals and you can name the numbers

Must-haves:

* English, plus Hindi and/or Telugu
* Comfortable doing site tours and negotiating face to face
* Can talk to a CFO at 11 AM and a 25-year-old founder at 4 PM the same day
* You know your own conversion ratio without checking
* Willing to work Monday to Saturday, on site

Bonus points we actually care about:

* An existing broker or IPC network in Hyderabad
* You've sold coworking, managed offices or office space before
* CRM discipline
* All three languages

**THE PROCESS: 7 DAYS, APPLICATION TO OFFER**

1. Apply — 2 minutes, answer the screening questions
2. 15-minute phone call with our team
3. 30-minute conversation with the founders, including a short live role-play: you sell us a desk
4. Offer

We respond to every applicant within 24 hours. If we're not moving forward, we'll tell you — nobody gets ghosted.

Pinakin Spaces | pinakin.space | Hitech City, Hyderabad

Position Overview
  

EBG Group is looking for a dynamic, target-driven
**Business Development Manager – Franchise Sales (Inside Sales)**
to drive franchise acquisition, generate business opportunities, and expand the company's franchise network across multiple markets. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in franchise sales, lead conversion, consultative selling, commercial negotiations, and relationship management.

The role involves managing the complete inside sales cycle, from lead generation and qualification to franchise presentations, negotiations, and deal closures, while consistently achieving revenue and business expansion targets.

Key Responsibilities
  

* **Franchise Sales & Business Development:**
  Drive franchise sales, identify prospective franchise partners, and achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* **Lead Generation & Qualification:**
  Generate and manage leads through inbound inquiries, outbound calling, digital campaigns, databases, and other lead-generation channels.
* **Inside Sales & Conversion:**
  Conduct calls, virtual meetings, and follow-ups with prospective franchisees to understand their investment capacity, business interests, and expansion requirements.
* **Franchise Presentations:**
  Explain franchise business models, investment structures, commercial terms, ROI assumptions, and expansion opportunities to potential investors.
* **Deal Closure & Negotiation:**
  Manage commercial discussions, negotiate franchise terms within approved guidelines, and convert qualified prospects into signed franchise agreements.
* **Pipeline Management:**
  Maintain an organized sales pipeline, track lead status, monitor conversion ratios, and ensure timely follow-ups through CRM or sales trackers.
* **Market Research:**
  Identify potential markets, assess business opportunities, analyze competitor franchise models, and recommend expansion strategies.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:**
  Work closely with marketing, operations, finance, and legal teams to facilitate franchise onboarding and smooth handover after deal closure.
* **Team Management:**
  Lead, coach, and monitor the inside sales team, establish performance benchmarks, and improve calling productivity and conversion rates.
* **MIS & Reporting:**
  Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on leads generated, calls completed, meetings scheduled, pipeline value, closures, and revenue performance.

Required Skills & Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field; an MBA is an added advantage.
* 5–10 years of experience in business development, franchise sales, inside sales, or B2B sales.
* **Mandatory experience in franchise sales and franchise partner acquisition.**
* **Proven track record of achieving sales targets and closing franchise deals.**
* **Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and persuasion skills.**
* **Experience in lead management, CRM tools, sales funnel management, and pipeline reporting.**
* **Ability to manage high-volume calls, follow-ups, virtual meetings, and multiple sales opportunities.**
* **Strong commercial understanding, analytical skills, and a target-oriented mindset.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  

* Monthly franchise sales and revenue targets achieved.
* Number of qualified leads generated and prospective franchise partners engaged.
* Lead-to-meeting and meeting-to-closure conversion ratios.
* Number and value of franchise agreements closed.
* Follow-up effectiveness, sales cycle duration, and pipeline accuracy.
* Team productivity and overall sales performance.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  

The ideal candidate is a proactive sales professional with hands-on franchise sales experience, strong investor relationship management skills, and the ability to convert business inquiries into successful franchise partnerships. The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and contributing directly to EBG Group's franchise expansion goals.

**Interested candidates can share their updated resumes with the EBG Group Talent Acquisition team.**

**Role Description**
**The Business Development Manager – Franchise Sales**
is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for identifying, attracting, and onboarding new franchise partners across EBG Group’s key industries, driving expansion and revenue growth. Daily responsibilities include generating and qualifying leads, conducting franchise presentations and meetings, managing the end-to-end sales cycle, and negotiating franchise agreements in alignment with company policies. description:
**Designation:**
Community Manager

General Manager

**Functional Reporting:**
Assistant Director – Community

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Overview**

The Community Manager is the primary owner of the member experience at the club. This role leads day-to-day community operations, member engagement, renewals execution, and onboarding delivery, while coordinating closely with internal teams to ensure consistent service standards across all member touchpoints.

This is an execution-led role. While supported by Corporate Community for structure, tracking, and guidance, the Community Manager owns on-ground delivery, real-time decision-making, and outcomes at the unit.

**Key Responsibilities**

***1. Member Engagement & Relationships***

* Own member engagement at the unit, ensuring members feel recognised, welcomed, and valued at all times.
* Act as the face of the Community team on the floor, building strong relationships through regular interaction and personalised engagement.
* Maintain accurate member profiles, preferences, and interaction notes to enable personalised experiences.
* Address member concerns with empathy and discretion; resolve issues promptly or escalate when required.
* Track and share engagement insights, feedback trends, and key member inputs with leadership teams.

***2. New Member Onboarding (On-Ground Delivery)***

* Execute the new member onboarding experience at the unit, ensuring warm introductions and smooth integration.
* Coordinate with Membership Sales for structured handovers post-sale.
* Ensure new members are oriented to the space, offerings, and community culture.
* Collect early-stage feedback and act on gaps in the onboarding experience.
* Ensure onboarding steps are completed and tracked as per defined process.

***3. Club Floor & Community Operations***

* Own daily Community operations on the club floor, ensuring smooth functioning and high service standards.
* Actively manage the member journey from arrival to departure.
* Coordinate closely with F&B Service, Culinary, Operations, and Facilities teams to deliver seamless hospitality.
* Identify operational gaps, log issues, and drive resolution at the unit level.
* Ensure adherence to Community SOPs and service frameworks on the floor.

***4. Private Hires, Events & Reservations***

* Act as the unit coordination point for private hires, member events, and reservations.
* Redirect and align enquiries with Sales and Operations teams as per defined process.
* Ensure accurate communication of event requirements and flawless on-ground execution.
* Be the primary on-site contact for members during events.

***5. Team Coordination & Communication***

* Lead and guide the unit Community team in daily priorities, service standards, and member handling.
* Coordinate internal communication across departments for member-related requirements.
* Share updates, challenges, and best practices with Corporate Community and leadership teams.
* Support training, process adherence, and continuous improvement initiatives at the unit level.

**Skills & Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in hospitality, community management, guest services, or customer experience roles.
* Strong on-ground operational experience in premium or member-led environments.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with high emotional intelligence.
* Ability to manage pressure situations calmly and professionally.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

description:
**Sales Executive - Infrastructure**
**JOB DESCRIPTION | INFRASTRUCTURE VERTICAL**
**Department**
Sales & Business Development - Infrastructure
  
  
**Experience**
3-5 years
  
  
**Compensation**
30,000 per month CTC (3.60 LPA)
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
Develop and manage a focused pipeline of civil-infrastructure customers for Ameenji Rubber Limited’s engineered bridge and road products. The role suits a Civil Engineering graduate who enjoys customer-facing sales, understands project drawings and technical terminology, and is looking to build a stable, long-term career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop leads among infrastructure contractors, EPC companies, bridge and highway contractors, consultants, project management consultants, government-project vendors and relevant channel partners.
* Build working relationships with site engineers, project managers, procurement teams, estimation teams and design/consultant teams.
* Track bridge, flyover, highway, ROB, metro and railway-related projects from tender/enquiry stage through order finalisation.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate collection of drawings, BOQs, technical specifications, quantities, delivery schedules and project details.
* Read and interpret basic civil/structural drawings and understand terms relating to bridge bearings, expansion joints, load, movement, dimensions and installation requirements.
* Coordinate with Ameenji’s technical, design, estimation and production teams to obtain product recommendations, technical clarifications and quotations.
* Prepare and follow up on quotations, enquiries, customer registrations, purchase orders and order status; maintain accurate CRM/SAP or company sales records as applicable.
* Conduct customer visits and project/site visits, prepare visit reports and maintain a structured follow-up calendar.
* Monitor competitor activity, upcoming projects, customer payment status and sales opportunities; submit weekly pipeline and monthly sales reports.

**Education & Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering preferred; candidates with a strong civil-infrastructure technical background may also be considered.
* 3-5 years of relevant B2B sales, project coordination or business development experience in civil infrastructure, construction materials, bridge products, building products or a related technical field.
* Good communication, presentation, negotiation, follow-up and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to understand drawings, BOQs, specifications and technical terms; product-specific knowledge of bearings/expansion joints is an advantage but can be developed through training.
* Evidence of reasonable stability in previous employment and a genuine interest in building long-term customer relationships.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and project/site visits.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)**

* Qualified leads and active infrastructure-project pipeline generated.
* Customer meetings, site visits and timely follow-ups completed.
* Enquiry-to-quotation and quotation-to-order conversion.
* Sales target achievement and new customer acquisition.
* Accuracy of CRM/SAP records, quotation follow-up and sales reporting.

**REPORTING / ROLE LEVEL**
Individual contributor; works under the guidance of the Sales Manager / Infrastructure Sales Head.
  
  
**About Ameenji Rubber Limited**
Ameenji Rubber Limited manufactures engineered rubber solutions for infrastructure and railway applications, including elastomeric bridge bearings, POT-PTFE and spherical bearings, bridge expansion joints, railway pads and related products. The company supports infrastructure projects through technical coordination, product quality, in-house testing and project-focused supply. Website: www.ameenji.com
  
  
**Candidate Profile:**
We value civil-engineering knowledge, customer credibility, consistent follow-through and a long-term approach to professional relationships.

title: Commercial Operations Executive
description:
**Commercial Operations Executive**

**Hyderabad, India · Full-time · On-site**

**Help Robots Reach the Factory Floor**

Building a capable robot is hard. Getting it quoted correctly, shipped on time, invoiced accurately, supported during a pilot, and converted into collected revenue is just as important.

Perceptyne builds industrial humanoid robots that can do real physical work: handling parts, supporting assembly, and performing tasks that have remained difficult to automate. We are building dual-arm, highly dexterous, contextually intelligent robots for electronics and automotive assembly, e-commerce packaging, food preparation, and other real-world environments.

As we move from prototypes to customer pilots and deployments, we need someone who treats operational follow-through as a core part of delivering the product. You will help ensure that no commercial or deployment detail falls through the cracks—from the first sales quote to final payment collection.

If you are diligent, highly organized, persistent, and take genuine ownership of getting things completed, this is that role.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

You will sit at the intersection of sales, finance, operations, engineering, procurement, logistics, and customers. Your work will create the operational backbone that helps Perceptyne run pilots, ship systems, invoice customers, and collect revenue reliably.

* Create, review, track, and maintain accurate sales quotations, commercial proposals, purchase orders, work orders, invoices, delivery documentation, and related records.
* Maintain a clear, current pipeline of every commercial opportunity—from quote sent, to PO received, to build readiness, shipment, installation, invoicing, payment due, and payment collected.
* Coordinate with the sales and technical teams to ensure customer commitments, scope, timelines, quantities, deliverables, payment terms, and acceptance criteria are documented correctly before execution begins.
* Track customer purchase orders and ensure that the quote, PO, invoice, shipment, and payment schedule reconcile correctly.
* Prepare and coordinate invoicing milestones, advance-payment requests, pro forma invoices, tax documentation, and final invoices in partnership with finance.
* Follow up professionally and persistently on receivables, outstanding approvals, pending POs, invoice acknowledgements, payment commitments, and overdue collections.
* Build and maintain collections trackers, ageing reports, revenue forecasts, and weekly status updates for leadership.
* Coordinate pilot logistics: customer-site readiness, shipment dates, transport, packaging, installation requirements, site access, delivery documentation, return logistics, and field-team coordination.
* Work with procurement, inventory, engineering, and manufacturing teams to confirm that the correct robot configuration, spare parts, tools, documentation, and accessories are available before shipment.
* Support domestic and, over time, international shipping and logistics processes, including packing lists, e-way bills, transport coordination, insurance, dispatch tracking, delivery proof, and export documentation where applicable.
* Maintain accurate CRM, ERP, spreadsheets, trackers, and document repositories so that the latest commercial and operational status is always visible.
* Identify missing information, inconsistent data, commercial risks, delayed dependencies, and process gaps before they become customer-facing problems.
* Improve operational processes as the company grows—moving from one-off coordination to repeatable systems, templates, checklists, dashboards, and ownership mechanisms.

**What We’re Looking For**

This role is for someone who combines attention to detail with a strong bias toward closure. You should be comfortable following up repeatedly, coordinating across busy teams, and calmly driving an ambiguous process until every operational detail is complete.

* Bachelor’s/Masters degree in business, commerce, operations, finance, supply chain, engineering, or a related field—or equivalent relevant experience.
* 2+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial operations, order management, logistics coordination, finance operations, customer operations, or a similar execution-focused role.
* Experience managing one or more of: quotations, purchase orders, invoicing, accounts receivable, collections, dispatch, shipping, pilot/deployment coordination, customer documentation, or sales reporting.
* Exceptional attention to detail. You can spot a mismatch between a quote, a PO, an invoice, a delivery schedule, and a payment milestone before it causes a problem.
* Strong ownership and persistence. You do not assume a task is complete because an email was sent; you follow it through until the required outcome is confirmed.
* Comfort following up with internal teams, vendors, and customers professionally and consistently.
* Strong spreadsheet skills, including Excel or Google Sheets. You should be able to build and maintain clean trackers, use formulas, validate data, and make operational status easy to understand.
* Ability to work with structured systems such as CRM, ERP, accounting software, inventory tools, or project-management tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication. You can write professional customer emails, summarize status concisely, and escalate risks early.
* Ability to prioritize multiple time-sensitive workstreams without losing track of details.
* Comfort working on-site in a fast-moving, cross-functional robotics company in Hyderabad.

**Nice to Have**

These are useful but not mandatory. Apply if the core of the role fits you.

* Experience in a B2B technology, industrial automation, robotics, manufacturing, SaaS, hardware, or engineering-services company.
* Experience handling hardware sales, capital-equipment orders, industrial projects, pilot deployments, or field-service coordination.
* Familiarity with Indian GST invoicing, e-invoicing, e-way bills, transport documentation, and basic accounts-receivable processes.
* Experience using Zoho, Tally, Salesforce, HubSpot, Odoo, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar CRM/ERP/accounting systems.
* Exposure to procurement, inventory management, vendor coordination, warehouse operations, or supply-chain planning.
* Familiarity with contracts, statements of work, commercial terms, payment milestones, delivery acceptance, or customer onboarding.
* Experience with export logistics, customs documentation, international shipping, or shipping insurance.
* A background in engineering or a genuine interest in robotics and industrial technology.

**How We Work**

At Perceptyne, we like to build things, evangelize great ideas, and stay grounded. We hold a few deliberate tensions:

* A large vision, without losing attention to detail.
* Fast execution, without losing operational discipline.
* Breakthrough technology, shipped to market as quickly as possible.
* High ownership, paired with clear communication and teamwork.

This role is not back-office administration. It is a high-leverage execution role at the point where product, customer, revenue, and deployment meet.

We value grit and dedication: the discipline to keep following up when a payment approval is delayed, the care to verify every commercial detail before a shipment leaves, and the persistence to resolve a blocked process rather than simply reporting that it is blocked.

You will thrive here if you enjoy creating order from ambiguity, care about reliable follow-through, communicate clearly across functions, and get satisfaction from seeing a complex process move from “pending” to “done.”

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

**ABOUT STAART BUILDTECH**

STAART BUILDTECH PVT. LTD. is a technology-driven company transforming the construction and commercial interiors industry through software solutions and professional Project Management Consultancy (PMC) services.

The candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, building client relationships, conducting product and service presentations, and converting prospects into paying customers for STAART's software solutions and PMC services.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable selling both technology products and professional services, engaging with decision-makers, and managing the complete sales cycle from lead generation to deal closure.

Key Responsibilities

**SAAS SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT**

* Identify and acquire new customers for STAART's construction and project management software solutions.

* Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients and key decision-makers.

**SALES OPERATIONS & REPORTING**

* Track sales activities, conversion rates, deal values, and pipeline performance.
* Prepare regular sales reports and revenue forecasts.
* Monitor competitor offerings, market developments, and customer feedback.
* Work closely with marketing, product, and project delivery teams to improve sales effectiveness.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.

Performance will be measured against clearly defined sales targets, including:

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of client meetings and product demonstrations conducted.
* SaaS subscriptions and new accounts acquired.
* PMC opportunities generated and projects secured.
* Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-closure conversion rates.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

title: Sales Lead Management & Coordination Executive
description:
**1. Role Overview**

Hydromo is looking for a proactive, highly organised and result-oriented Sales Lead Management & Coordination Executive to manage inbound enquiries, qualify prospects, coordinate with the sales team and drive effective lead progression towards business conversion.

The individual will serve as the first point of contact for prospective customers generated through multiple channels, ensuring timely communication, systematic lead qualification, consistent followups and seamless coordination between customers and the sales team.

The role requires excellent communication skills, strong follow-up discipline, data management capabilities and the ability to prioritise opportunities to improve sales productivity and conversion timelines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Inbound Lead Management & Qualification**

• Handle daily inbound leads generated through digital campaigns, website enquiries, referrals, social media and other sources.

• Make initial calls to prospective customers to understand their requirements, project details, business needs and purchase intent.

• Qualify leads based on defined business criteria, opportunity potential, urgency, location and other relevant parameters.

• Assign qualified leads to the appropriate sales representatives based on predefined allocation criteria.

• Ensure every new enquiry is contacted promptly and accurately recorded in the lead management system.

**B. Lead Follow-ups & Sales Coordination**

• Manage an active pipeline of new, ongoing and carry-forward leads.

• Conduct systematic follow-ups with prospects to collect pending information, understand buying timelines and assess the next steps.

• Coordinate with sales representatives to facilitate customer meetings, technical discussions and site visits.

• Ensure prospects receive timely responses and that no active opportunity is missed due to inadequate follow-up.

• Support the sales team throughout the sales cycle by maintaining communication with prospects and facilitating progression towards conversion.

• Escalate high-potential, urgent or delayed opportunities to management.

**C. Lead Data Management & Sales Prioritisation**

• Maintain accurate, updated and well-organised lead databases.

• Track lead status, source, customer requirements, follow-up dates, sales ownership and next actions.

• Develop and maintain structured lead trackers and daily/weekly sales pipeline reports.

• Identify high-priority prospects based on readiness, potential, urgency and engagement.

• Organise customer and site visit schedules geographically, identifying location-wise and route-wise clusters to optimise travel time and sales team productivity.

• Ensure proper documentation and visibility of all lead interactions and follow-up commitments.

**D. Customer Communication**

• Handle daily telecalling, email communication and WhatsApp correspondence with prospective customers.

• Communicate professionally and confidently with customers across different business segments.

• Share preliminary product information, company details and relevant communication material.

• Coordinate with technical and sales teams to obtain accurate responses to customer queries.

**E. Outbound Calling & Other Assignments**

• Undertake outbound calling activities and targeted prospecting as directed by management.

• Support specific sales campaigns, customer re-engagement initiatives and database activation.

• Take ownership of additional sales coordination and lead management activities as required.

**3. Expected Daily Workload**

The role will involve managing a combination of fresh enquiries, ongoing prospects and outbound activities.

Indicative daily activity:

• Tele calling in bound queries new prospect calls per day and documenting requirements in CRM

• Follow-ups with existing and carry-forward leads.

• Customer requirement validation and lead qualification.

• Coordination for sales meetings and site visits.

• Database updates, lead prioritisation and reporting.

• Additional outbound calls as assigned by management.

The actual calling volume will vary depending on incoming lead volumes and the active sales pipeline.

**4. Education & Experience**

**Preferred Experience:**

• Experience in the water treatment, wastewater management, industrial utilities or environmental solutions industry will be an advantage.

• Alternatively, candidates with sales coordination, telecalling, inside sales, customer relationship management or business development experience in technical or industrial sectors may apply.

• Fresh graduates or postgraduates with a strong interest in sales, excellent communication skills and a willingness to learn are also welcome.

**Educational Qualification:**

• Any graduate or postgraduate degree.

• Candidates with technical or engineering backgrounds will have an added advantage.

**5. Skills & Competencies**

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Fluency in English, Hindi and Telugu is mandatory.

• Strong telecalling, customer interaction and follow-up capabilities.

• Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple leads and prioritise tasks independently.

• Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, email and WhatsApp communication.

• Ability to maintain structured databases, trackers and reports.

• Good interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with sales and technical teams.

• Proactive, disciplined, persistent and target-oriented approach.

• Strong learning agility and willingness to understand technical products and solutions.

**6. Product & Technical Knowledge**

Hydromo will provide structured training on its products, solutions and services. The candidate will be expected to progressively develop:

• Understanding of Hydromo's water treatment and wastewater management solutions.

• Basic knowledge of product applications, technical terminology and customer requirements.

• Ability to understand preliminary project requirements and capture relevant technical information.

• Confidence in communicating basic product information and coordinating technical discussions with the relevant teams.

Prior technical expertise is not mandatory, but the willingness and ability to learn technical concepts quickly is essential.

**7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on:

• Timely response and coverage of new inbound enquiries.

• Quality and accuracy of lead qualification.

• Number of leads effectively followed up and progressed.

• Accuracy and completeness of lead database and CRM records.

• Timely allocation of qualified leads to sales representatives.

• Effectiveness in facilitating customer meetings and site visits.

• Follow-up discipline and reduction in missed or dormant opportunities.

• Quality of daily and weekly reporting.

• Contribution to improving sales team productivity and lead-to-conversion timelines.

**8. Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

• A confident communicator who can engage professionally with customers.

• Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow-ups.

• Persistent without being pushy.

• Data-oriented, with the ability to identify and prioritise promising opportunities.

• Responsible and accountable for ensuring every lead is tracked and acted upon.

• Enthusiastic about sales, customer engagement and learning technical products.

The objective of this role is simple: Ensure every genuine enquiry is contacted, qualified, tracked, followed up and effectively moved towards a sales opportunity — without allowing potential business to slip through the cracks.

Company: Hydromo

Location: Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad

Work Mode: Full-time | Work from Office

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Working Hours: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

For apply : jobs@hydromo.in
