title: Custom AI - Software Engineer II - Sales & Service - Customer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Custom AI**
**Customer | S&S | Consultant**
**About The Role**
Deloitte is seeking a Full Stack CRM Developer to help design, build, and deliver bespoke, AI-augmented Customer Relationship Management applications. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone early in their consulting career who wants to build modern, scalable customer engagement platforms — not configure off-the-shelf tools.
  
  
You will work under the guidance of Senior Consultants, Managers, and Architects to build features, integrate AI capabilities, and deliver high-quality, well-tested code across the full stack. This role is designed to build deep technical skills in CRM engineering and GenAI integration while developing the foundation for future architecture and leadership roles at Deloitte.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****- Architecture & Solution Design (Contributor)
- Build components of custom CRM platforms — including data models, API endpoints, microservices, and front-end features — following the architecture patterns and standards set by the engagement's architects.
- Develop full-stack features using modern frameworks (React, Angular, Next.js) for frontend and Node.js or Python/FastAPI for backend, under the direction of senior technical leads.
- Follow established architecture governance standards and reusable microservice patterns; raise opportunities for improvement to senior architects.
- Support build vs. buy evaluations by prototyping and testing candidate approaches as directed.
- Product & Delivery Mindset
- Participate in discovery sprints and user feedback sessions; help translate business pain points into user stories and backlog items.
- Support a product mindset by helping track adoption and usage metrics for the features you deliver.
- Participate in innovation labs and internal hackathons, prototyping emerging CRM capabilities under guidance from senior team members.
- Contribute code, tests, and documentation to Deloitte's CRM accelerators and reference architectures.
- Stay current on emerging technologies (agentic frameworks, LLM tooling, edge inference) and share relevant findings with the team.
- AI, GenAI & Agentic Integration
- Build and test AI/GenAI features within CRM workflows — such as lead-scoring models, content generation, and chatbot integrations — as specified by the architecture team.
- Support development of RAG pipelines and LLM orchestration components (LangChain, LlamaIndex) under senior guidance.
- Implement token-usage tracking and basic semantic caching per the engagement's established cost governance framework.
- Assist with deploying and testing inference-serving components, including containerized vLLM or managed inference endpoints.
Build and test conversational AI features (chatbots, virtual agents), validating functionality against defined latency SLAs (e.g.,- Support output-validation and hallucination-detection testing as part of GenAI QA processes.
- Help capture basic AI usage metrics (cost-per-interaction, latency, accuracy) for reporting to senior team members.
- AI Implementation Fundamentals
**Area**
**What This Level Does**
**Data First**
Execute data-quality checks and CRM hygiene tasks (deduplication, completeness scoring) as defined by the team's data standards, before AI features are deployed.
  
  
**Scalability by Design**
Build components following the team's established autoscaling and async-queue patterns rather than introducing one-off solutions.
  
  
**Cost Efficiency**
Apply caching and token-budget practices defined by the engagement; monitor and report token spend for the features you own.
  
  
**Adaptable Architecture**
Build modular, configurable components (prompt layers, pluggable services) rather than hard-coded logic, per team design guidance.
  
  
**Change & Adoption**
Build intuitive UX per design specifications and help instrument usage/engagement metrics; surface adoption friction observed during testing.
  
  
**Ethical AI**
Apply bias-detection and fairness-testing checklists provided by senior architects when validating model outputs.
  
  

* Integration Support
* Build integrations with legacy systems, ERPs, MDM platforms, and third-party tools using REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and event-driven patterns (Kafka, RabbitMQ), following designs provided by senior architects.
* Support integration of the CRM with marketing automation platforms, communication APIs (Email, SMS, WhatsApp), and data lake/warehouse environments (Snowflake, Databricks).
* Database Development & Performance
* Build and maintain relational and non-relational data models per designs provided by senior architects; implement indexing and partitioning as specified.
* Support performance-tuning tasks: query optimization, connection pooling, and cache implementation using Redis/Memcached.
* Write and maintain SQL/NoSQL code across PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, and Cassandra environments.
* Security, Compliance & Cloud Engineering
* Implement security controls (RBAC, OAuth2/SAML, field-level encryption, audit logging) in line with compliance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
* Build and deploy containerized services on AWS, Azure, or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes; contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
* Delivery Excellence
* Deliver high-quality, well-tested code that adheres to team coding standards; participate actively in code reviews.
* Support migration and modernization workstreams under senior direction.
* Flag technical risks, blockers, and dependencies to project leads in a timely manner.
* Practice & Community Contribution
* Contribute to internal accelerators, code libraries, and technical documentation.
* Support the creation of point-of-view content and client-ready materials under the guidance of senior team members.
* Participate in Deloitte's technical communities of practice and knowledge-sharing sessions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3-6 years of experience in software development, with exposure to CRM system design or customer data platforms a plus.
* 2+ years of hands-on full-stack development using modern web frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue) and backends (Node.js, Python, or Java).
* Working knowledge of CRM domain concepts — Leads, Opportunities, Account Management, Sales Pipelines, Service Cases.
* Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to CRM (lead scoring, recommendation logic, conversational AI).
* Exposure to GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) or LLM integration patterns (RAG, function calling) through coursework, personal projects, or prior engagements.
* Familiarity with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) databases.
* Experience integrating applications via REST, SOAP, or GraphQL APIs.
* Exposure to cloud-native deployment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker/Kubernetes.
* Basic understanding of security and compliance concepts (OAuth2, SAML, RBAC, GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA).
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional delivery teams.
* Experience contributing to a delivery POD or project team of roughly 3-6 engineers or equivalent team-based project work.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Personal, academic, or hackathon projects involving LLM integration, RAG, or agentic frameworks.
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi).
* Cloud certifications at the Associate level (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Prior internship, co-op, or project experience in a consulting or client-facing environment.

****Core Competencies****
**Competency**
**Description**
**Strategic Thinking**
Understands how assigned tasks connect to broader business outcomes; asks clarifying questions to align work with client goals.
  
  
**Product Mindset**
Understands the product being built; contributes input on backlog items and incorporates user feedback into delivered work.
  
  
**Innovation Drive**
Curious about emerging technologies; experiments in labs/hackathons and shares findings with the team.
  
  
**AI & GenAI Fluency**
Builds and tests AI/GenAI features under guidance; developing foundational RAG and LLM integration skills.
  
  
**Technical Excellence**
Writes clean, tested, well-documented code; follows engineering best practices and team coding standards.
  
  
**Architecture Awareness**
Follows established architecture standards and design principles; escalates gaps or inconsistencies to senior architects.
  
  
**Client Centricity**
Translates specific requirements into working code; asks questions to clarify ambiguity before building.
  
  
**Communication**
Communicates clearly with team leads and peers; developing confidence presenting work to internal stakeholders.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
Actively seeks feedback and mentorship; supports peers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  
  
****Why Deloitte?****
Deloitte Consulting's Technology & Digital Transformation practice is a trusted advisor to the world's leading enterprises. As a Full Stack CRM Developer, you will build the technical foundation of your consulting career — working alongside world-class engineers and architects on real, high-impact AI-native CRM platforms.
  
  
At Deloitte, we believe that together makes progress. You will build products that outlast engagements, learn from experienced architects and managers, and grow within a practice where curiosity and continuous learning are part of the daily discipline.
  
  
Deloitte is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: VP Sales - Mining (AI Transformation)
description:
**About the Company**

knacklabs.ai builds AI-powered products and platforms that help organizations turn complex workflows into simple, reliable systems. We work closely with customers to deploy real solutions to real problems, not just ship features. As we scale, we're looking for engineers who are as comfortable in front of a customer as they are in a codebase. 

 

**The role**

KnackLabs is hiring a Senior Sales Manager to build and own its mining business, reporting directly to the CEO.

Title: Senior Sales Manager – Mining (AI Transformation)

Reports to: Founder & CEO

Location: Hyderabad, with frequent travel to mine sites and mining clients' offices across India

Type: Full-time

Experience: 10–15 years selling IT, digitisation or AI solutions to mining companies

Owns: New logos, revenue and pipeline in the mining and metals vertical

You will turn our mining wins into a repeatable, multi-crore business line. Mining companies are under pressure to raise output, cut fuel and haulage costs, improve safety and keep up with compliance. Most have ERP and some sensors, but still run on spreadsheets, manual reports and siloed systems. That gap is where KnackLabs comes in.

You will be the first dedicated mining seller, working directly with the CEO. You open doors with CXOs and mine heads, shape the opportunity with our Forward Deployed Engineers, and close multi-site digitization and AI programmes. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role at first, with room to build a team as the vertical grows.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Own the mining vertical.**

  Build and execute the go-to-market plan for coal, iron ore, limestone, bauxite, non-ferrous metals and mining services companies in India, and later in selected overseas markets.
* **Open CXO doors.**

  Build relationships with CEOs, COOs, CIOs, CDOs, mine heads and heads of operations, safety, maintenance and procurement.
* **Sell outcomes, not licences.**

  Position AI agents, automation platforms and digitisation programmes against real problems such as fleet and fuel optimisation, production planning, predictive maintenance, safety and compliance reporting, dispatch, and procurement or tendering.
* **Shape deals with engineers.**

  Run discovery alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers, scope pilots that prove value in weeks, and turn pilots into multi-site, multi-year programmes.
* **Run the full sales cycle.**

  Lead prospecting, solutioning, proposals, commercial negotiation, PSU and government tenders, and contract closure.
* **Build a pipeline the CEO can plan on.**

  Keep a clean, forecastable pipeline in the CRM and report on it weekly to the CEO.
* **Grow existing accounts.**

  Expand work with current mining clients through new sites, new use cases and managed services.
* **Build partnerships.**

  Work with OEMs, mining-equipment vendors, ERP partners and consultancies that can bring KnackLabs into deals.
* **Be the voice of the market.**

  Feed customer problems back into our solutions, case studies and pricing, and represent KnackLabs at mining conferences and industry bodies.

**What we're looking for**

* 10–15 years of enterprise B2B sales, with most of it selling into the mining and metals industry.
* A track record of selling IT solutions, digitization and AI or analytics programmes, such as ERP, MES, fleet management, IoT, mine planning, data platforms or AI transformation.
* Deals closed in the ₹1–10 crore+ range, with multiple stakeholders and long buying cycles.
* A personal network across mining majors, PSUs and mid-sized private miners, from mine site to boardroom.
* A working understanding of mine operations: extraction, haulage, beneficiation, dispatch, maintenance, safety and statutory compliance.
* Experience with PSU and government procurement, including GeM and formal tenders.
* The ability to explain how AI creates business value to a mine head and to a CIO, without overselling the technology.
* Comfort working directly with a founder-CEO in a fast-moving company, and building process where little exists.
* Willingness to travel frequently to mine sites and client offices.
* A bachelor's degree in mining, engineering or a related field.

**Nice to have**

* An MBA, or a degree in mining engineering or metallurgy.
* Earlier hands-on experience in mine operations or mining consulting.
* Experience selling services or outcome-based programmes, not only software licences.
* Relationships with mining-equipment OEMs, ERP vendors or system integrators.
* Exposure to overseas mining markets such as Australia, Indonesia, the Middle East or Africa.
* Experience building a sales vertical or a small sales team from scratch at a growth-stage company.What

**We Offer**

* A direct line to the CEO, and real influence over how KnackLabs grows in mining.
* A proven offer to sell, with live mining deployments and a strong engineering team behind every deal.
* Competitive fixed pay plus an uncapped, deal-linked incentive plan [details to confirm].
* The chance to build and lead a mining sales team as the vertical scales.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note on the largest mining digitisation or AI deal you closed: the client problem, your role, the deal size and the outcome. 

**About KnackLabs**

KnackLabs
is an AI transformation company based in Hyderabad. We embed Forward Deployed Engineers inside a client's business to find where AI creates real value, then build and run the AI agents and automation platforms that deliver it. We have been shipping since 2016 and have taken 100+ products to production.

Mining is already one of our proven verticals. For
MineGate
we built one system that brings production, fleet, fuel, GIS and compliance together across multiple sites, and Sainik Mining is also a client. We are an OpenAI Select Partner and a Sarvam launch partner, and Analytics India Magazine certified us as Best Firm for Forward Deployed Engineers in 2026.

* MineGate case study

title: Technical Sales Support Engineer at DESMI
description:
Are you our newest team member as a Technical Sales Support Engineer ready to specialize, deepen your expertise, and make an impact within a dynamic and supportive team? DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where your ideas matter. We're building a culture that values collaboration, continuous learning, and making a difference. As an employee at DESMI, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects, develop cutting-edge skills, and connect with a diverse team of talented individuals. If you're looking for a workplace where you can grow, contribute, and be inspired, DESMI is the place for you.
  
  
**Ideally, We Are Looking For Someone Who Is**

* Curious
* Taking a holistic approach
* Thrives in a collaborative environment

**A glimpse into the role**
**Role**
As a Technical Sales Support Engineer, you’ll be a key contributor to optimizing DESMI’s sales and technical bid management processes. Your role mainly revolves around leading the end-to-end bid management process for pump system projects, including:
  
  

* Reviewing customer specifications, tender documents, datasheets, P&IDs, technical requirements, and commercial terms.
* Preparing technically compliant proposals for pump packages, engineered systems, and complete pumping solutions.
* Performing pump selection and hydraulic calculations based on customer operating conditions and application requirements.
* Selecting suitable IEC motors, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), control panels, instrumentation, and automation systems.
* Developing technical bid documentation such as compliance statements, deviations, technical datasheets, equipment schedules, GA drawings, and Bills of Material (BOM).
* Coordinating with suppliers and subcontractors to obtain technical and commercial quotations for motors, panels, automation systems, instrumentation, valves, and auxiliary equipment.
* Evaluating vendor quotations for technical compliance and optimizing solutions for cost, performance, and delivery.
* Working closely with Sales teams to develop competitive and technically optimized proposals.
* Identifying technical, commercial, and execution risks during the bidding stage and recommending mitigation strategies.
* Supporting bid clarification meetings, customer technical discussions, and pre-award negotiations.
* Ensuring proposals comply with customer specifications, international standards, and company engineering guidelines.

**Your next opportunity starts here**
As Someone Who Will Join Our Sales Support Team, We Are Looking For a Self-driven Individual With a Deep Understanding Of Pump Systems And Technical Sales Support. We Also Imagine That You
  
  

* Possess strong knowledge of centrifugal, internal gear pumps, engine room pumps, and industrial pump systems.
* Are experienced in pump selection and sizing, pump performance curves, and NPSH evaluation.
* Have expertise in mechanical seals, couplings, bearings, materials of construction, pump skid packages, and piping systems.
* Have strong knowledge of IEC motors, motor selection, protection systems, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), soft starters, MCC integration, and power distribution.
* Are familiar with electrical load calculations, pump control panels, PLC and HMI fundamentals, and SCADA integration concepts.
* Have experience with hazardous area equipment (ATEX/IECEx) — an advantage.
* Hold a bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering.
* Have 5–8 years of experience in technical sales support, bid management, or application engineering for pumps or rotating equipment.
* Have experience with Defence, naval, marine, or government projects, preferably with knowledge of Defence specifications, military standards, and marine class requirements.
* Are comfortable working with ERP/CRM systems and quotation tools.
* Have strong English communication skills, both written and spoken, and are comfortable collaborating with international teams.

**What we’re about**
But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
  
  
**When You Join DESMI, You Can Expect**

* A collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
* A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
* A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
  
  
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
If you're a motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
To learn more about this opportunity, please contact Aarti Sharma at aash@desmi.com . We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Technical Sales Engineer/Analyst**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented
**Technical Sales Analyst**
to support the development of technical and commercial solutions for utility-scale solar projects. This role will play a key part in preparing project proposals, analysing technical requirements, maintaining sales tools, and providing data-driven insights that enable timely and competitive customer submissions.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong engineering fundamentals with analytical capabilities and enjoys working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment supporting global business opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze customer RFIs, RFPs, tender documents, technical specifications, and project drawings.
* Prepare project cost estimates by coordinating with Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams.
* Create high-quality customer-facing technical documentation, presentations, datasheets, and proposal packages.
* Support technical evaluations of project requirements and recommend optimized engineering solutions.
* Analyze project risks, assumptions, and technical deviations during the bidding process.
* Maintain technical databases, design assumptions, cost libraries, and proposal templates.
* Support the evaluation of new products, technologies, and market trends relevant to utility-scale solar projects.
* Coordinate with Product Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics, and Sales teams to ensure proposal accuracy and alignment.
* Generate reports and dashboards using CRM and Excel tools to monitor proposal metrics and sales performance.
* Assist in developing internal knowledge documents, technical guides, and sales enablement materials.
* Participate in customer technical discussions and internal project review meetings when required.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve proposal quality, turnaround time, and process efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/ electrical/ civil engineering/computer science/IT/ Renewable Energy, or any related engineering discipline.
* 5-8 years of experience in utility-scale solar, renewable energy, EPC, project engineering, applications engineering, or technical sales support.
* Strong understanding of utility-scale solar PV systems, trackers, balance of system (BOS), and plant design principles.
* Experience interpreting engineering drawings, technical specifications, and construction documents.
* Support the preparation of responses to customer IT, OT, cybersecurity, data protection, and product security questionnaires during the proposal and tender process.
* Coordinate with IT, cybersecurity, engineering, product management, and commercial teams to collect accurate evidence, statements, and compliance documentation.
* Develop a working understanding of cybersecurity considerations for utility-scale solar plants, including SCADA systems, tracker controllers, industrial networks, remote monitoring, and cloud-connected platforms.
* Understand the purpose and basic requirements of relevant cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, IEC 62443-4-1, IEC 62443-4-2, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and NIST SP 800-82.
* Support the review of customer requirements related to network architecture, access control, authentication, encryption, logging, vulnerability management, software updates, incident response, and secure remote access.
* Maintain controlled and accurate records of cybersecurity claims, product security documents, certifications, declarations, technical responses, and customer commitments.
* Apply good information security practices when handling customer data, tender documents, drawings, credentials, commercial information, and other confidential materials.
* Familiarity with solar design and energy simulation software (Helioscope, PVsyst, AutoCAD, or similar).
* Knowledge of engineering economics, cost estimation, and project optimization.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, IF statements, and data analysis.
* Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or equivalent.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while meeting aggressive deadlines.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in proposal engineering, bid management, estimating, or commercial analysis.
* Understanding of procurement, supply chain, logistics, and EPC execution processes.
* Familiarity with tracker systems, energy storage, or power electronics.
* Basic knowledge of industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus/ TCP-IP, OPC-UA).
* Familiarity with basic IT and OT concepts, including IP networking, TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs, network segmentation, user access management, multi-factor authentication, backups, and endpoint protection.
* Experience in responding to cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, or product security requirements in customer RFIs, RFPs, tenders, or vendor assessments.

The majority of time is spent establishing and maintaining customer relationships, developing new customer relationships, implementing sales strategies and closing sales.

**Autonomy:**
Entry-level sales professional on one or more individual or team accounts. Sells products and/or services to a group of clients and identifies new and potential customers. Work is closely supervised. Maintains relationships.

Works to achieve individual sales targets within product area and/or account by selling lower complexity products / services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Has some impact on the overall achievement of sales results for the team. Work typically on smaller, less complex accounts, small quota or territory.
  
  
**Innovation and Complexity:**
Follows standard sales and business development practices and procedures in analyzing situations or data from which answers can be readily obtained. May recommend changes in account tactics to achieve sales goals. Implements improvements and changes to work processes and procedures.

N / A – Job at this level are focused on self-development.

title: Sales Executive-Real Estate
description:
**Job description:**

**Company: Propteliio Consultants Private LimitedLocation: Hyderabad, Telangana**

**Department: Sales & Business Development**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**About Propteliio:**
Propteliio Consultants Private Limited is a real estate consultancy with a presence in Hyderabad, Dubai, and the UK. We help clients make informed property decisions through property selection, investment strategies, legal support, and after-sales services. We collaborate with real estate developers to connect their projects with potential buyers and investors.

.
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven Sales Executive to expand Propteliio’s developer network by identifying, approaching, negotiating with, and onboarding new real estate developers.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end sales cycle, from prospecting and relationship building to partnership closure and ongoing account management.

The ideal candidate should have strong negotiation and communication skills, a good understanding of the real estate market, and the ability to build long-term business relationships with developers & clients.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Developer and Client Acquisition & Onboarding: Identify and approach new real estate developers, builders, and property development companies to establish business partnerships. Reach out to clients and understand their needs and propose suitable properties to them.
* Lead Generation & Prospecting: Build a pipeline of potential developer partners and Clients through market research, networking, cold calling, referrals, industry events, and field visits.
* End-to-End Sales Management: Manage the complete sales process, including initial outreach, requirement analysis, presentations, meetings, negotiations, deal closure, and onboarding.
* Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, explore emerging real estate markets, and expand Propteliio’s developer and clients portfolio.
* Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with developers and clients.
* Negotiation & Deal Closure: Negotiate commercial terms and other partnership requirements to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. Close deals with clients after scheduling their site visits.
* Project Understanding: Develop a thorough understanding of developers’ projects, pricing, inventory, amenities, payment plans, and unique selling propositions.
* Internal Coordination: Work closely with marketing teams to facilitate project promotion, lead sharing, client engagement, and successful business execution.
* Market Intelligence: Track competitor activities, new project launches, market trends, and developer offerings to identify growth opportunities.
* Sales Reporting: Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, negotiations, onboarding progress, and closures in the company’s CRM.
* Target Achievement: Meet monthly and quarterly targets for developer acquisition, partnership closures, client closures and business revenue.
* RequirementsBachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
* Prior experience in real estate sales, business development, channel partner management, or developer acquisition is preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently generate leads and manage the complete sales cycle.
* Good understanding of the Hyderabad real estate market and its developer ecosystem is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel for developer meetings, project visits, and business development activities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, CRM tools, and sales reporting.
* A self-motivated, result-oriented approach with the ability to work towards ambitious sales targets.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Number of new developers identified and approached.**

* Number of developer meetings and business presentations conducted.
* Number of developers successfully onboarded.
* Number of clients closed and sales done.
* Conversion rate from prospecting to partnership & client closures.
* Revenue and business opportunities generated through developer partnerships.
* Quality of developer relationships and ongoing account engagement

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to build and expand a strong developer network and client base.
* Exposure to Hyderabad’s real estate and property investment markets.
* Career growth opportunities in sales and business development.
* A performance-driven work environment with opportunities to take ownership of business growth.

title: District Manager (SET), Kolkata
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Sports Med & Extremities) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.
  
  
The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within the operating theatre environment and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of this environment and of the role as both a representative of Zimmer and a part of the operating theatre team. The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Sports Med & Extremities range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.
  
  
The DM (Sports Med & Extremities) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.
  
  
As a conduit of information to and from the field, DM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.

**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts & seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.
* Responsibility of primary and secondary sales in the designated territory and Key accounts.

**Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers currently using competitor products, within targeted geographical & product areas.
* Present proposal to decision makers and convert customers to usage of Zimmer products.
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.

**Management Reporting (5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by NSM/RSM (or others), including monthly reports & expenses.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports on an as-required basis.
* To liaise with Distributors for effective customer service, order procurement for primary sales and realization of receivables from Distributors/Hospitals of the territory in co-ordination with the Area/Regional Sales Manager and Finance Department.

**Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and, where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles & data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers & staff.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Horizon Pilot Training Institute is a professional aviation academy in Hyderabad specializing in CPL ground classes and DGCA exam preparation. The institute offers expert training in Air Navigation, Air Regulations, Meteorology, Technical General, and RTR (A), supported by experienced instructors and live sessions with airline pilots. Learners benefit from structured guidance, career-focused mentorship, and a practical approach that prepares them to become knowledgeable, confident, and cockpit-ready commercial pilots. Located in the F Coworking Building in Begumpet, the institute serves aspiring pilots seeking high-quality training and clear pathways into commercial aviation.

**Role Description**
The Sales Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based at our Hyderabad campus in Begumpet. The Sales Executive will handle daily outreach to prospective students and families through calls, messages, emails, and in-person consultations, clearly explaining our courses, exam preparation offerings, and career pathways in aviation. This role includes managing inquiries, conducting follow-ups, guiding applicants through admissions and enrollment processes, and maintaining accurate records in CRM or internal systems. The position requires consistent on-site presence to welcome walk-ins, represent the institute professionally, and support a positive experience for learners and visitors.

**Qualifications**

* Proven ability in sales, student counseling, or customer-facing roles, with strong persuasion and negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including clear spoken and written English; proficiency in regional languages is an advantage.
* Comfort with using computers, CRM tools, spreadsheets, and basic online communication platforms.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple inquiries and follow-ups efficiently.
* Interest in the aviation or education sector; prior experience in training institutes, coaching centers, or academic admissions is a plus.
* Ability to work on-site full time in Hyderabad (Begumpet), including occasional evenings or weekends for events and admissions drives.
* Minimum qualification of a bachelor’s degree in any discipline, or equivalent experience in sales or education services.
* Self-motivated, goal-oriented mindset with a commitment to ethical, learner-focused sales practices.

at The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts

The brand is also delighted to announce the upcoming opening of its latest property in Jaisalmer. The Leela has a strong pipeline of future projects. The brand celebrates each hotel through its unique location, art, culture, and cuisine with thoughtful services, celebratory rituals, and immersive experiences. title: Regional Manager
description:
**Job Title: Regional Manager**

**Location:**
City-Based Field Role for Hyderabad

**Company:**
Beauty Beyond Borders (BBB)

**About Beauty Beyond Borders**

Beauty Beyond Borders (BBB) is India’s exclusive distributor of globally respected luxury and dermacosmetic skincare brands including LA Fervance (France), Elementre Dermo Cosmetics (Switzerland), Future Cosmetics (Israel), Valmont (Switzerland), and possibly more and We partner with leading dermatologists, aesthetic clinics, premium hotels, and wellness centers across India, offering science-backed skincare supported by structured education and brand positioning.

This is a field-intensive position requiring:

● Disciplined daily activity

● Strong product understanding

● Professional engagement with dermatologists and clinic owners

● Structured follow-ups and reporting

● Travel outside Hyderabad for 2 Weeks

The
**Regional Manager**
is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving regional revenue, overseeing high-ticket clinic acquisitions.

This is a high-impact, field-intensive leadership position requiring a blend of strategic territory planning and hands-on mentorship. The RM ensures that the entire regional team reflects the credibility and sophistication of our premium international brands while maintaining rigorous operational discipline.

**1. Regional Strategy & Revenue Leadership (80%)**

title: Events Lead – Brand Activations
description:
About Roligt Foods

Roligt Foods is building a next-gen clean-label beverage brand out of Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch, running live activations across the city and rolling out smart vending kiosks. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

Role Description

The Events Lead runs every activation we do: flea markets, food fests, community carnivals and corporate campuses. Based in Hyderabad, you work with the revenue team, the brand promoters and the brand team. Every event has to produce sampling numbers, sales and leads. This role suits someone who is happiest on the ground and obsessive about the details of a good stall.

Key Responsibilities

1. Build and run the events calendar, with 4 to 8 activations a month.
2. Find organisers and venues, negotiate stall fees and close bookings.
3. Own stall setup, stock, collateral, permissions and teardown.
4. Hire, brief and roster the brand promoter team. Run the on-ground script.
5. Capture leads with consent at every event and hand them over to the CRM team on the same day.
6. Report on each event: footfall, samples, conversions, leads and cost per lead.
7. Feed customer reactions back to the brand and product teams.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have

1. 2 to 4 years of experience in events, BTL activations or on-ground marketing for an FMCG or F&B brand.
2. An existing network of Hyderabad organisers and vendors.
3. Experience leading a field team, even a small one.
4. A two-wheeler and a valid licence.
5. The attitude of "if it needs to get done, I will make sure it gets done."

What We Offer

1. **Fair, competitive compensation.**
   Pay is in line with industry standards and based on your experience, capability and track record. Strong performers grow faster than a standard annual cycle.
2. **Fast-track growth.**
   You work directly with the leadership team and see how a consumer brand is built from zero. Good people grow into bigger roles as the business scales.
3. **Broad exposure.**
   You see product, brand, events, retail and operations, not one narrow slice.
4. **Real ownership.**
   Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

Please Do Not Apply If

1. You are not based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.
2. You are not available most weekends.
3. You prefer planning from a desk to running things on the ground.

We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.

company: Veneraa | Own Slice of Commercial Real Estate
description:
**About Veneraa**

Veneraa (veneraa.in) is building a new way to own commercial real estate in India. We identify premium commercial properties that are eligible for an SPV structure, so investors can co-own them through the SPV and share the rental income. We also help clients buy, sell, and lease commercial properties. We’re at the very start, launching in Hyderabad, and you’ll build our property pipeline from day one.

**The role**

We’re looking for a co-founder to own the real estate side of the business: bringing in the right properties and getting them in front of the right investors. You’ll be the on-ground face of Veneraa with developers, owners, and buyers in Hyderabad.

**What you’ll own**

* **Supply:**
  Source and onboard Grade-A and pre-leased commercial properties from developers, landlords, and existing investors.
* **Asset evaluation:**
  Assess whether each property is SPV-eligible by checking clear title, approvals, tenant quality, lease terms, and rental yield. Then decide what’s worth taking forward.
* **Investor sales:**
  Build and close a pipeline of HNIs, NRIs, family offices, and first-time commercial investors.
* **Partner network:**
  Grow and manage our channel partners and agents.
* **Company building:**
  Shape pricing, deal structure, and the investor experience alongside the founder.

**You’re a fit if you have**

* 5+ years in commercial real estate in Hyderabad, in leasing, sales, investment advisory, or developer-side business development.
* Personal relationships with developers and landlords in Gachibowli, Hitech City, Financial District, Kokapet, or Madhapur.
* A track record of closing commercial deals of ₹1 Cr and above with individual investors.
* A working understanding of pre-leased assets, including lock-in periods, escalations, yields, and due diligence.
* The drive to build something from zero, without a big brand behind you.

**Strong bonus**

* Experience at an IPC (CBRE, JLL, Cushman & Wakefield, Colliers, Knight Frank, Anarock) or on a developer’s commercial sales team.
* Experience with SPV-based or fractional ownership deals, or familiarity with SEBI’s SM REIT framework.
* An existing investor base, or NRI investor connections.

**What we offer**

* 10% equity, vesting over 2 years.
* An equity-only role for now, with no salary or stipend.
* A true co-founder seat with real say in how the company is built.

title: Outbound Lead Generation Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an
**Outbound Lead Generation Specialist**
to build and fill the new-business pipeline for 8 Views.

**This is a pure outbound role.**
Your job is to start conversations with the right prospects and hand over qualified, meeting-ready leads. You will not handle proposals, negotiation or closing. The Business Development team picks up from your handover.

You will source leads from LinkedIn and other channels, build relationships with consultants and potential partners, and run a consistent weekly outreach cadence. If you enjoy research, outreach and the discipline of hitting activity and meeting targets, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Source leads**
  from LinkedIn, referrals, events, directories, industry databases and other channels, with a focus on our core sectors: Real Estate, Education, Healthcare and other lead-generation businesses.
* Run structured
  **LinkedIn outreach**
  : build prospect lists, send connection requests, follow up and start conversations that lead to meetings.
* Build and nurture relationships with
  **consultants, agencies and other potential partners**
  to create referral and collaboration channels.
* Research each prospect's business, competitors and current digital presence so every outreach message is relevant and personalised.
* Qualify leads on budget, need, timeline and decision-maker access before handing them over.
* Book discovery calls and meetings for the BD team, with clear notes on the prospect's context and needs.
* Maintain a steady weekly outreach cadence and hit defined targets for connections, conversations and meetings booked.
* Keep the CRM updated daily with lead status, outreach activity and follow-ups.
* Track outreach performance (reply rates, meeting conversion, source-wise quality) and refine messaging and targeting based on the numbers.
* Use outreach and lead-generation tools, including LinkedIn automation, enrichment and email tools, to scale outreach without losing quality.
* Share weekly reports on pipeline activity and lead quality with the BD lead.

**What We're Looking For**

* **2-4 years of experience**
  in outbound lead generation, business development, inside sales or SDR roles, ideally in a digital marketing agency or similar service business.
* Strong command of
  **LinkedIn as a prospecting tool**
  , including Sales Navigator, search filters and connection-led conversations.
* Proven ability to source leads from multiple channels and book qualified meetings consistently.
* Excellent written communication: you can write short, personalised messages that get replies.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing and performance marketing, enough to hold a credible first conversation with a prospect.
* Comfort with numbers: reply rates, conversion rates and lead-to-meeting ratios.
* Hands-on experience with a CRM and outreach or lead-generation tools.
* Strong research skills and attention to detail.
* Self-driven and comfortable working to weekly activity and meeting targets.
* Comfortable using AI tools to improve research, outreach and productivity.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* You enjoy outreach and are not discouraged by silence or rejection.
* You research before you reach out, and your messages reflect it.
* You build genuine relationships with consultants and partners, not just send cold messages.
* You track your own numbers and keep improving what works.
* You stay disciplined with your daily and weekly cadence.
* You are curious about how performance marketing works and how it drives leads for clients.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience selling digital marketing or performance marketing services.
* An existing network of consultants, agencies or channel partners.
* Experience with Real Estate, Education or Healthcare clients.
* Experience with LinkedIn automation tools, Clay, Apollo, Lusha or similar platforms.

**Prior experience in outbound lead generation is mandatory. Candidates with agency experience will be preferred.**

title: Institutional Sales Manager (B2B / Government Sales)
description:
****About The Role****
**Institutional Sales Manager (Government & Institutional Sales)**
**Company:**
Marut Drones
  
  
**Position:**
Institutional Sales Manager
  
  
**Function:**
Government & Institutional Sales
  
  
**Experience:**
5–10 Years
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Zonal Sales Manager
  
  
****About The Role****
Marut Drones is looking for an experienced
**Institutional Sales Manager to drive business with Government Departments, PSUs, Defence Organizations, Police & Law Enforcement Agencies, public institutions and other large institutional customers**
. The primary objective of this role is to identify business opportunities, build strong customer relationships, develop key accounts, manage the sales pipeline and convert opportunities into orders and revenue.
  
  
The candidate should have strong experience in Government or Institutional Sales, preferably in drones, agricultural equipment, defence/security solutions, surveillance systems, technology products or related sectors.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Institutional Sales & Business Development**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across Government Departments, PSUs and institutional customers.
* Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, government officials, procurement stakeholders and technical teams.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable Marut Drones products and solutions.
* Develop new institutional accounts and expand business from existing customers.
* Conduct regular customer meetings, follow-ups and opportunity reviews.
* Manage opportunities from initial engagement through commercial discussion and order closure.
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline aligned with assigned targets.

**Key Account Management**

* Manage strategic Government and Institutional accounts within the assigned territory.
* Develop account-wise business plans and identify opportunities for repeat orders and account expansion.
* Maintain strong long-term relationships with customers and key stakeholders.
* Act as the primary sales contact for assigned institutional customers.
* Ensure regular engagement with customers throughout the sales and order lifecycle.

**Product Presentations & Demonstrations**

* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, trials and customer meetings.
* Understand operational requirements and propose appropriate drone solutions.
* Coordinate demonstrations and Proof of Concept activities wherever required.
* Gather customer feedback and communicate relevant requirements internally.
* Work closely with technical and operational teams to address customer requirements.

**Commercial & Opportunity Management**

* Prepare and present commercial proposals in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in pricing discussions and commercial negotiations.
* Understand Government procurement processes, GeM and institutional purchasing requirements.
* Coordinate required commercial and procurement-related inputs for opportunities.
* Maintain visibility on opportunity value, expected closure dates and customer decision timelines.

**Order Execution & Collections**

* Coordinate with relevant teams after order confirmation to support smooth execution.
* Maintain regular communication with customers regarding order progress and commitments.
* Follow up for timely invoicing, payment realization and outstanding collections.
* Support resolution of customer issues related to order execution and commercial commitments.

**Market Development**

* Identify emerging applications and business opportunities for drone solutions.
* Track market developments, customer requirements and competitor activities.
* Develop new institutional markets and customer segments.
* Provide regular market and customer feedback to management.
* Identify opportunities to increase Marut Drones' presence within key Government and Institutional accounts.

**CRM & Sales Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information in CRM.
* Update sales pipeline, expected order values and closure timelines regularly.
* Prepare periodic reports on customer meetings, opportunities, orders and collections.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts and account plans.

****Required Qualifications & Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management is preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in Government Sales, Institutional Sales, B2G Sales or Key Account Management.
* Experience dealing with Government Departments, PSUs, Defence, Police, Law Enforcement Agencies or large institutional customers is preferred.
* Experience in drones, defence/security equipment, surveillance solutions, technology products or related industries will be an advantage.
* Proven experience managing high-value institutional sales opportunities.
* Good understanding of Government procurement processes and platforms such as GeM is preferred.
* Experience managing the complete sales cycle from opportunity identification to order closure and payment realization.

****Key Skills Required****

* Government & Institutional Sales
* B2G Business Development
* Key Account Management
* Customer & Stakeholder Relationship Management
* Sales Pipeline Management
* Opportunity Development & Conversion
* Commercial Negotiation
* Product Presentation & Demonstration
* CRM & Sales Forecasting
* Market Development
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Communication & Presentation Skills
* Order Closure & Payment Follow-Up

****About Marut Drones****
Marut Dronetech Pvt Ltd is a leading Indian drone technology company focused on developing and deploying advanced unmanned aerial solutions across agriculture, public safety, disaster response, logistics, and environmental restoration. With a strong emphasis on indigenous innovation and real-world problem solving, Marut Drones combines engineering excellence with field-driven insights to create scalable and reliable drone ecosystems.

title: Sales Data Quality Analyst
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
Sales Data Quality Analyst
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore or Hyderabad India
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time, regular, hybrid work arrangement
  
  
**About The Job**
Seeking dynamic and detail-oriented Sales Data Quality Analysts to join our team. Analysts will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of sales deal data, focusing on critical elements that impact business decisions and financial outcomes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to validate, maintain, and enhance the quality of sales data, thereby enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct thorough data profiling and analysis to identify data anomalies, inconsistencies, and outliers.
* Execute comprehensive data quality checks to ensure accuracy and completeness of critical data elements including but not limited to conversion rates, new/renewal splits, incremental Annual Contract Value (ACV) / Total Contract Value (TCV), and deal spans.
* Develop and implement data cleansing and standardization processes to ensure consistency and accuracy across sales deal data.
* Validate the classification of new logos and account segments to ensure alignment with organizational criteria and strategies.
* Conduct thorough reviews of closed lost renewal deals to verify alignment with new business opportunities and prevent discrepancies in deal categorization.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of SPIF attributes and flags associated with sales deals.
* Perform validation checks on opportunity close dates and start dates to ensure timely renewal validation and compliance with contractual terms.
* Perform root cause analysis on data quality issues to identify underlying factors and implement preventive measures.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of data quality rules, processes, and issues.
* Collaborate with stakeholders from various departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, IT) to understand data requirements, address data quality issues, and ensure alignment with business objectives.

**Good to have**

* Good to know SaaS Products and their different pricing models offered by companies such as One time cost, Pay-as-You-Go, subscription etc.,
* Knowledge on sales strategies such as Cross Sell, Upsell, Down sell, price uplift is required
* Experience with inventory management data, including quotes, purchase orders, invoices, deal registrations, licenses, contracts is desired
* Ability to understand Sales data flow from different systems to a unified database or CRM tool is a plus
* Working knowledge of identifying and automating manual, repetitive processes using Excel (advanced formulas, VBA), SQL, Power Query and other AI-powered tools, with experience in developing data validation, reconciliation, reporting, and dashboard solutions to enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, and data governance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Systems, or related field.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, sales operations, or related roles.
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or similar data analysis tools.
* Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems preferred.
* Basic understanding of sales processes and deal structures.
* Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

**Commercial at AVEVA**
Our Commercial team, comprised of over 2,000 dedicated colleagues, is the backbone of our customer relationships and business growth. From industry experts and solution architects to sales, support, success managers, and business operations, everyone shares a common goal: to deeply understand our customers' needs and deliver tailored solutions.
  
  
If you're passionate about driving growth, tackling complex business challenges, and fostering strong customer relationships, you'll find success and fulfilment in our Commercial team.
  
  
Find out more:
https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. title: Red Emergency Navigator
description: About RED.Health RED.Health is India's largest emergency response company, built on a simple but urgent truth: in a medical emergency, every second determines the outcome — and for too long, patients in India have been navigating those moments largely alone. India faces one of the most pressing pre-hospital care crises in the world. With over 1.5 million road accident deaths and countless cardiac, stroke, and trauma emergencies every year, the gap between the moment an emergency occurs and the moment a patient reaches definitive care is often the difference between life and death. Unorganised ambulance services, inconsistent clinical standards, and the absence of real-time coordination have historically made that gap wider — and more dangerous — than it needs to be. RED.Health was founded to close it. Starting in 2015, RED.Health set out to build what India's emergency ecosystem had never had: a technology-driven, clinically rigorous, and accountable pre-hospital care network. Today, the company operates a fleet of over 450 ambulances across a network of 5,000 partners pan-India, offering Ground, Train, and Air Ambulance services — covering everything from critical ICU-to-ICU transfers to long-distance patient repatriation. The company's proprietary HeartbeatX technology ensures ambulances are dispatched in under 5 minutes, with real-time visibility across every case, every vehicle, and every shift. In 2023, RED.Health became the first EMS company in India to receive both ISO 9001:2015 and NABH EMS certifications simultaneously — a benchmark that reflects the clinical rigour and operational discipline the company holds itself to. RED.Health operates on three values — Speed, Empathy, and Reliability — not as aspirational statements, but as the operating principles behind every dispatch decision, every crew deployment, and every hospital relationship the company builds. About the Role The Hospital Relationship Manager is RED.Health's most critical frontline position. This is not a traditional sales role — it is a hospital embedded, relationship-first, revenue-driving function that requires equal parts clinical awareness, interpersonal skill, and operational discipline. You will be physically present inside your assigned hospital every shift, running structured rounds across the Emergency Department, ICUs, surgical wards, and every other key department. Your job is to ensure that when a doctor, nurse, or discharge planner thinks of ambulance services, they think of RED.Health — and they think of you by name. This role demands someone who thrives on human connection, takes personal ownership of their numbers, and does not need to be pushed to show up. If that describes you, this is one of the most impactful field roles in Indian healthcare today. What You Will Own Your accountability is organised across three core areas: Revenue Generation • Drive daily trip volumes and revenue from your assigned hospital accounts by converting relationships into referrals • Proactively identify transfer opportunities — discharge patients, ICU-to-ICU referrals, post-surgical transport, and NICU cases • Monitor your pipeline throughout the shift and flag shortfalls early — never wait until shift end to report a problem Hospital Relationship Management • Build and maintain genuine, trusted relationships with CSOs, Medical Officers on Duty, ER managers, ICU consultants, discharge planners, and billing staff • Complete 8 structured floor rounds per shift across all departments — MICU, ICCU, Neurology, Surgical wards, ED, Mortuary, and Marketing • Meet at least 3 different doctors every day; grow a referral network that expands every week On-Ground Operations • Manage shift handovers, wallet monitoring, revenue reporting, and client WhatsApp group communications • Be the single point of accountability for everything that happens at your hospital — no caveats, no exceptions What We Are Looking For We hire for disposition, not just experience. The best HRMs come from backgrounds where daily field presence, relationship building under pressure, and personal accountability were non-negotiable. Here is what that looks like: Background Medical Representative, BFSI field sales (credit cards, insurance), telecom or D2H territory sales, edtech or Health-tech field executives. Hospital or diagnostic centre experience is a strong plus. Experience 1–3 years in a daily-visit, target-driven, field sales role. Freshers with zeal to work in Sales welcomed. Education Any graduate. Science or life sciences background preferred. The candidate should have a sales instinct Language Fluent in the local language of the city you are deployed in. Working knowledge of Hindi or English depending on hospital environment. Physical Comfortable standing and walking for a full 10–12-hour shift. Personality High warmth, affectionate, rejection-resilient, structured, self-starting, and mildly competitive. You take personal pride in completing things. You are someone who can greet a customer with warmth, persuasive & converts lead into sales. Why Join RED.Health • Competitive fixed salary with performance-linked incentives tied directly to your trip volumes and revenue achievement • Structured 4-day induction followed by a 45-day onboarding support framework — dedicated Cluster Manager check-ins, an onboarding buddy from the floor, and regular P&O support calls • Clear, performance-driven growth path — high performers who deliver on floor presence, revenue, and relationships are promoted fast, not based on tenure • You will work alongside trained paramedics, EMTs, and pilots operating ALS, BLS, NICU, Train, and Air Ambulance services across 34+ cities • This is work that visibly matters. Every shift, your relationships directly determine which patients reach definitive care faster — and that is not a tagline, it is the daily reality of this role Your Growth Path at RED.Health Growth at RED.Health is entirely merit-based. There is no tenure gate. The HRMs who move fastest are those who consistently deliver on floor presence, revenue targets, and stakeholder relationships — and who show they can lead before they are asked to. Role What it means Timeline Hospital Relationship Manager Day 1 — You own your hospital floor end-to-end. Revenue, relationships, reporting, and floor presence are all yours. You are RED.Health on that floor. Start Senior HRM 6–12 months — Demonstrated mastery of floor KPIs. You mentor new HRMs, manage larger or more complex hospital accounts, and are the peer others turn to. 6–12 mo Cluster Manager 12–24 months — You step up to cluster-level P&L ownership, lead multiple HRMs, manage fleet and crew, and drive business development across your hospital network. 12–24 mo City Head Beyond — City-wide operations, cross-cluster performance, strategic hospital partnerships, and full accountability for the city's revenue and team. title: City Manager

**Role Description**
As a City Manager at payrentz, you will play a hands-on role in growing our Hyderabad business, with a focus on business development, partnerships, and city operations. From building relationships, partnerships to generating leads, converting opportunities, and coordinating daily deliveries and service operations, you will be involved in the end-to-end execution of the city’s growth. * Strong collaborative relationships with IT colleagues and leaders, stakeholders and clients helping you to influence and create confidence.

**Experience & Profile**

* Strong experience in a senior Sales/Pre-Sales Engineering, Client-facing IT Solution Design or similar role within enterprise services, BPO, or outsourcing
* Excellent presentation and client-facing skills including definition and presentation of compelling technology pitches, ability to clearly articulate technology design features and considerations, and has excellent spoken and written English language skills.
* Track record across global, multi-region, multi-tower deals
* Strong CCaaS platform knowledge across at least two of: NICE CXone, Genesys Cloud, Amazon Connect, Google CCaaS
* Strong knowledge of typical IT infrastructure, connectivity, application layer and security supporting outsourced customer service operations.
* Demonstrable knowledge of common AI platforms and their capabilities coupled with experience/interest In AI tools and services in the BPO sector
* Demonstrable experience dealing with third-part vendors and partners in relation to technology integration, procurement and licensing of technology products and services.
* Architectural mindset paired with commercial instinct, with ownership of cost and risk in addition to design
* Operates effectively in ambiguity and influences senior stakeholders without relying on positional authority
* Willing to occasionally travel domestically or internationally for client workshops, executive sessions, and discovery workshops if pursuits require this.

India-Telangana-Hyderabad

**Reports to:**

About CDSW

The Council for Digital Safety and Wellbeing (CDSW) is a national platform advancing safety, ethics, privacy, trust, and societal wellbeing in an increasingly digital and AI-driven world.

Through learning, dialogue, and collaboration, CDSW helps institutions, communities, and individuals address challenges such as misinformation, deepfakes, data misuse, and automation-related risks. Our work equips people to engage with technology safely and responsibly.

About the Role

CDSW is seeking a Director – Sales & Business Development to build and scale its
**Higher Education & Enterprise vertical**
. You will own revenue growth, develop institutional relationships, negotiate commercial agreements, and build the team and processes required for sustained expansion.

The role covers two distinct offerings:

* **Higher Education:**
  A semester-long, graded, for-credit elective requiring Board of Studies (BoS) approval and university sign-off. Sales involve academic stakeholders, institutional governance, and semester planning.
* **Enterprise:**
  An LMS-based self-learning program covering eight topics with quizzes, supported by periodic webinars. Sales focus on per-seat subscriptions and enterprise licensing, with opportunities for renewals and seat expansion.

Key Responsibilities

**Sales Strategy and Revenue Ownership**

* Set and deliver annual and quarterly revenue targets across Higher Education and Enterprise.
* Prioritise university systems, institutional networks, enterprise sectors, and geographic markets.
* Own pipeline development, forecasting, negotiations, and closures.
* Build distinct sales approaches suited to each segment’s buying process.

**Higher Education Sales**

* Develop relationships with Vice Chancellors, Deans, Registrars, department heads, and faculty champions.
* Lead institutional engagement through BoS presentations, syllabus reviews, academic-council approvals, and semester scheduling, supported by the Curriculum team.
* Expand adoption across university systems and affiliated institutional networks.
