title: AVP National Sales & Business Development
description:
\*Please note this role is not for 2070 Health\*
  
  
**About Sukoon Health**
Sukoon provides inpatient mental healthcare for severe and complex mental health conditions and addiction. We are looking for a commercial leader who can help patients access high-quality care by strengthening referral relationships, developing effective sales teams and turning market opportunities into measurable business growth.
  
  
You will lead national sales and business development across our markets. Your work will combine time in the field with city managers and representatives, rigorous account planning, revenue-generating events and sales collateral that helps people understand Sukoon's value. You will work closely with clinical, marketing, admissions, customer care and operations teams.
  
  
**Role Overview**
This is a role for someone who takes ownership of results and improves how other people sell. You should be comfortable accompanying representatives, demonstrating a consultative sales conversation, coaching managers and making clear decisions about account priorities and investment. You will join an existing operation with targets, processes and training in place, and strengthen execution while addressing specific gaps.
  
  
Success means more productive referral accounts, better sales-team performance, qualified opportunities from events and partnerships, and reliable progress against revenue targets. You must be able to explain what you changed, how it worked and how the team can repeat it.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibities**
Sales leadership and account development
  
  

* Own national commercial performance
* Translate national and city revenue targets into channel, territory and account plans.
* Diagnose performance gaps using account potential, referral activity, conversion, capacity and commercial economics.
* Identify the few actions most likely to close those gaps and hold clear owners accountable.
* Maintain a credible forecast and explain variances early.
* Allocate sales effort and approved budgets to opportunities with a clear rationale.
* Work with Finance and the Head of Growth on channel economics, investment decisions and corrective action.
* Build productive referral relationships
* Segment and prioritise doctors, clinics, hospitals and other relevant partners based on clinical relevance, account potential and relationship stage.
* Understand their unmet needs, referral barriers and current alternatives.
* Develop account plans with a specific proposition, next action, owner and date.
* Activate appropriate new accounts, deepen productive relationships and re-engage lapsed referrers.
* Work with Sukoon clinicians to build professional trust through meaningful conversations and evidence.
* Ensure partners understand referral pathways and receive timely follow-through from the relevant teams.
* Explore partnerships where they support the agreed growth strategy.
* Assess fit, expected demand, delivery requirements, economics and ownership before proposing an investment.
* Referral development remains a core responsibility; expansion into other channels must have a clear business case.
* Coach in the field
* Spend regular time with city managers and frontline representatives. Observe real meetings, diagnose the skills or account barriers involved and demonstrate effective discovery, value explanation, objection handling and next-step agreement. Give specific feedback and follow up on whether behaviour and results improve.
* Teach managers to coach their teams consistently. Use existing training materials and performance data to identify development needs. Translate training into practice through joint visits, role-play, account reviews and individual development plans. Measure improvements in representative productivity and target attainment.
* Build a capable sales organisation
* Clarify responsibilities, territory coverage, manager spans and account ownership. Set hiring standards, interview and assess sales talent, improve onboarding and ramp-up, and address persistent underperformance. Make staffing proposals based on workload, geography and account opportunity.
* Create a culture of preparation, honest reporting and reliable follow-through. Recognise results and effective behaviours, and ensure reviews lead to useful decisions. Develop managers who can sustain performance without every issue escalating to the national leader.

Events collateral and commercial execution
  
  

* Create events that develop business
* Design and execute targeted clinician roundtables, facility visits, educational discussions and other relevant engagement formats. Choose the audience and format around a specific account opportunity or referral barrier. Work with clinical colleagues on content and marketing colleagues on invitations and delivery.
* Own the commercial plan for each event: target accounts, proposition, attendee recruitment, approved budget, representative preparation, intended next actions and follow-up. Track full costs and evaluate qualified opportunities, productive accounts and attributable revenue over an agreed period.
* Assign follow-up owners before the event. Ensure opportunities are recorded and progressed in the CRM. Distinguish newly generated business from influence on existing opportunities. Use results to decide which formats to repeat, improve or discontinue.
* Know what sales collateral to build
* Audit existing materials and identify gaps by audience, sales stage and recurring question or objection. Brief marketing on assets such as referral guides, clinical capability summaries, evidence-based case examples, care-journey explanations, FAQs, presentations and event follow-up material.
* Specify the audience, purpose, message, evidence, format and intended next action for each asset. Work with clinical leaders to validate clinical content and with marketing to maintain brand consistency. Test material in real conversations, teach teams to use it and improve it based on feedback and account progression.
* Strengthen execution across teams
* Use existing CRM and reporting systems to maintain account plans, activity quality, source attribution, next actions and forecasts. Improve data quality and sales processes where a specific performance gap warrants it. Lead reviews that result in decisions and completed actions.
* Work with admissions and customer care to ensure referral enquiries receive timely attention and a clear handoff. Escalate repeated service or coordination barriers that damage partner trust. Support the clinical team's patient conversations through relevant information and feedback while respecting assigned ownership.
* Exercise sound healthcare judgment
* Represent Sukoon accurately and communicate value with evidence. Protect patient confidentiality and ensure patient stories and clinical claims have appropriate approval. Build trust with clinicians, partners and families through clear, respectful communication.
* Clinical decisions remain with clinicians. Commercial targets must support clinically appropriate care and informed patient choice. You are accountable for referral-channel performance and sales execution; clinical recommendations and lengths of stay are not sales decisions

**How Accountability Will Work**

* Revenue and admission outcomes depend on clinical eligibility, patient choice, facility capacity and patient-facing execution. You will own the sales actions and account relationships within your control, diagnose shared barriers and coordinate resolution. Reviews will distinguish weak sales execution from other causes of performance variance.
* Productive-account and conversion definitions will use consistent windows and denominators. Registered contacts and raw visit counts will not substitute for qualified opportunities or account outcomes. Count unique referrals consistently and avoid duplicate revenue credit across channels and events.
* The scorecard will inform priorities and performance assessment. Incentive terms and weightings will be specified separately in the employment offer.

**What Strong Performance Looks Like**
City managers can explain their account priorities and coach their teams effectively. Representatives understand partner needs, communicate Sukoon's value and secure meaningful next steps. Events create opportunities that are followed through, and collateral solves specific sales problems. Forecasts are reliable and the team can demonstrate progress against targets.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Must Haves**

* Demonstrated commercial experience in healthcare in India, including clinician or referral-partner engagement. A record of leading sales or business-development teams, owning targets and improving results through personal intervention is essential.
* Ability to show field coaching, territory and account development, revenue-generating events and sound sales-collateral judgment. Strong commercial numeracy, CRM discipline and cross-functional execution. Willingness to spend substantial time in the field and travel regularly between markets.
* Typically 12 or more years of relevant commercial experience, with meaningful people-leadership responsibility. We will consider strong regional leaders ready for national responsibility as well as established national leaders. Evidence of performance and capability will carry more weight than title or tenure alone.
* Bachelor's degree required. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Clear professional communication in English is essential; language capabilities relevant to our markets are valuable

**Good to have**

* Direct hospital or specialty-healthcare service sales
* Multi-city or multi-facility leadership
* Referral-account development involving complex patient decisions
* Effective work with consultants, marketing and admissions teams.
* Experience in mental healthcare, rehabilitation or addiction services is valuable but not mandatory.

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
****Brief Job Overview****
The Sales Effectiveness Director is a global commercial leadership role responsible for strengthening USP’s sales execution, productivity, and performance discipline across regions.
  
  
Based in India and reporting to the Vice President, Global Business Development, this role will partner closely with commercial leadership, regional sales teams as well as commercial support functions across USP to translate business objectives into practical sales strategies, scalable processes, and actionable performance insights.
  
  
You will lead global initiatives related to commercial strategy, sales enablement, CRM excellence, incentive governance, data analytics, and change management to help USP build a more consistent, accountable, and effective global sales organization.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a change agent across the organization. He/ She/ They will be results driven, with a passion for building high-performance organizations, tools and processes.
  
  
We are searching for a person who wants to grow and develop his/her/their own career, a commercial leader with a passion for opening new doors and creating new opportunities.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. * Partner with Marketing Operations to deploy effective messaging, value propositions, and customer engagement frameworks across regions.

* Drive self-development and continuous learning by actively participating in coaching and executing against developmental feedback

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of supervisory experience

title: Manager - Sales
description:
**Overview**
This position is responsible for warehouse trade spend results and escalation of blockers preventing the teams from getting to period targets. The role will own oversight for contract management on FSV agreements. We have dotted line ownership of BPO team who process trade claims in TPM based on proof of performance against the contract for Quaker & Gatorade LOB. The FSV team audits QSDI and Frito-Lay claims in CCM for trade spend payments to customers, auditing against specific performance criteria, ensuring claims are cleared in timely manner, and adhering to aging metrics. The Supervisor supports the Senior Supervisor and supports Finance to identify trade process gaps and implement solutions to optimize trade performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Assists in the oversight of team validation of customer proof of performance against established trade accruals to meet targets
* Ensure Team compliance with established Warehouse and FLNA Trade Settlement processes and procedures
* Assists in the oversight of S4 harmonization and escalations of known issues to drive resolution
* Ensure timely, accurate, and efficient processing of trade spend checks and deductions, fund adjustments, and customer enrollments
* Works with the Senior Supervisor to partner with Finance and Sales to manage and collect or clear aged claims, including obtaining all necessary contracts and supporting documentation; period review of open chargebacks and credits to drive cash recovery
* Monitor period KPI’s and ensure adherence to target metrics
* Perform analysis of deduction activity, forecast balances for cash flow reporting, and provide period reporting on write-off activity
* Design and implement trade payment process efficiencies to streamline trade payment processing
* Collaborate with Finance to identify and implement business process efficiencies and changes to drive improvements to trade spending
* For FSV, partner with the PACMAN Systems team to identify and implement process and system improvements and reporting needs
* Assist with Balance Sheet Reviews and SOX testing
* Provide ad hoc reporting for leadership and Finance as needed

**Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of relevant trade deduction business experience and practical exposure in: problem solving, root cause analysis, and/or summarizing and interpretation of data
* Service oriented with ability to manage day-to-day and periodic time-sensitive problem solving, multitasking for projects and escalations
* Solid understanding and working knowledge of general accounting and accrual transactions
* 2-4 years of experience with Microsoft Applications with an extremely high level of proficiency
* Ability to work independently and prioritize work with minimal direction
* Ability to learn new technology concepts quickly with attention to detail
* Strong analytical, problem solving and organizational skills
* Self-motivated and is results oriented
* Strong written and verbal communication and collaboration skills with ability to work cross functionally with people at multiple levels in Sales, Finance, Control, Retail, Trade and IT
* Curiosity for learning, critical thinking and able to interpret trends in data and share insights

title: Business Lead – Smart Kiosk
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next-gen, clean-label beverage brand in Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch. We are expanding through smart, automated beverage kiosks across corporate campuses and other high-footfall locations. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**Role Description**

The Business Lead owns our smart vending kiosk channel end to end. Based in Hyderabad, you decide where machines go, how much each one sells, and whether the network makes money. You work with the founder, the machine vendor, maintenance, and the brand team. This role suits someone who likes building a channel from zero and being judged on its numbers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Identify, negotiate, and secure kiosk locations across tech parks, gyms, hospitals, colleges, and residential societies.

2. Own the P&L of each machine, including daily sales, uptime, wastage, rent, revenue sharing, and profitability.

3. Coordinate with the machine vendor for timely deployment, preventive maintenance, servicing, and spare parts availability.

4. Plan and optimise restocking routes, inventory levels, and replenishment schedules with the maintenance team.

5. Review sales and CRM data weekly, identify underperforming machines, and take corrective action, including relocation or withdrawal where necessary.

6. Develop and execute a scalable rollout plan, growing the network from the first 10 machines to 100.

7. Prepare and present monthly network performance reports to leadership, highlighting achievements, challenges, and action plans.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

1. 2–5 years of experience in vending, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or B2B location sales.

2. A proven track record of identifying, negotiating, and closing location agreements with facility managers, property owners, or landlords.

3. A strong understanding of unit economics, P&L management, and proficiency in spreadsheets and data analysis.

4. Good knowledge of Hyderabad's commercial areas and business hubs. Proficiency in Telugu and Hindi is preferred.

5.
High ownership and a bias for action

**What We Offer**

1. Fair, competitive compensation: Pay is in line with industry standards and based on your experience, capability, and track record. Strong performers grow faster than a standard annual cycle.

2. Fast-track growth: You work directly with the leadership team and see how a consumer brand is built from zero. Good people grow into bigger roles as the business scales.

3. Broad exposure: You see product, brand, events, retail, and operations, not one narrow slice.

4. Real ownership: Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

1. You are not based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.

2. You want a role with a fixed playbook already written.

3. You are not comfortable owning a P&L number.

*We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.*

title: District Manager, Visakhapatnam
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Recon) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.
  
  
The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within the operating theatre environment and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of this environment and of the role as both a representative of Zimmer and a part of the operating theatre team. The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Recon range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.
  
  
The DM (Recon) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.
  
  
As a conduit of information to and from the field, DM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.
  
  
Principal Duties & Responsibilities
  
  
**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts & seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.
* Responsibility of primary and secondary sales in the designated territory and Key accounts.

**Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers currently using competitor products, within targeted geographical & product areas.
* Present proposal to decision makers and convert customers to usage of Zimmer products.
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.

**Management Reporting(5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by NBM/GSM/SM (or others), including monthly reports & expenses.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports on an as-required basis.
* To liaise with Distributors for effective customer service, order procurement for primary sales and realization of receivables from Distributors/Hospitals of the territory in co-ordination with the Area/Regional Sales Manager and Finance Department.

**Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and OT , where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles & data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers & staff.

Expected Behaviour
  
  
The incumbent will be required to demonstrate behavior in accordance with Zimmer Biomet’s Guiding Principles, as listed below;
  
  
We respect you for your individual contributions and your diverse perspectives. We support your professional growth and provide you with opportunities to share in the company's success.
  
  

* Commit to the highest standards of patient safety, quality and integrity.

We commit to the highest standards of patient safety and quality in our products and services and to be recognized for world-class integrity and ethical business practices.
  
  

* Focus our resources in areas where we will make a difference.

We focus our resources in areas where we will make the greatest impact for our customers and patients through our collective knowledge of the disease state or market, established infrastructure, relevant engineering expertise and skillsets.
  
  

* Ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.

We innovate to provide value through effective and efficient solutions for customers and improved outcomes for patients to ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.
  
  

* Give back to our communities and people in need.

We partner with communities where we live and work and support causes and programs that forward our mission for people in need.
  
  
Your Background
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Must Possess The Following**

* Science Graduate with 3 – 5 yrs of work experience
* Preferred Qualifications in B.Pharma, Business, Marketing or Paramedical discipline.

**The candidate must have the following level of experience in, or knowledge of:**

* Previous experience in OR/OT surgical support experience, preferably in orthopedic
* Demonstrated sales abilities & a track record of successful selling to the medical profession

title: Senior Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description**
India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd. (ISFC) is an affordable housing finance company with a 12-year track record, operating across 15 states in India. The organization focuses on providing housing and small-ticket loans against property to primarily self-employed customers with informal income documentation. Its products include financing for new home purchases, home expansion and upgrades, construction on previously owned land, and loans against property. ISFC has built a hassle-free loan management process designed to serve middle- and lower-income segments and supports home ownership dreams with loans up to Rs 30 lakhs. The head office is located in Gurugram, Haryana.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Senior Relationship Manager role based in Hyderabad. The role involves acquiring and managing customers seeking affordable housing loans and loans against property, with a focus on self-employed and informally documented income profiles. The Senior Relationship Manager will meet prospective customers, understand their financial needs, explain product features, collect and verify documentation, and coordinate with credit and operations teams to ensure timely loan processing. Responsibilities include maintaining strong relationships with existing customers, monitoring repayment behavior, addressing service issues, and supporting portfolio quality and growth targets. The role also requires collaboration with local partners and internal stakeholders, regular field visits, and adherence to regulatory and company policies.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong relationship management and customer service skills, including the ability to build trust with diverse customer segments.
* Experience in retail lending or housing finance, preferably handling self-employed or informal income customers.
* Ability to assess basic financial information, understand credit risk, and work with documentation relevant to housing loans and loans against property.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with proficiency in local language(s) and clear written and verbal communication in English.
* Comfort with field-based work, including regular customer visits, local market engagement, and on-site verification.
* Working knowledge of standard office and loan management systems; ability to learn new digital tools quickly.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; relevant experience in financial services or housing finance is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated integrity, attention to detail, and a strong focus on responsible lending and regulatory compliance.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Key purpose of the role**
CISS is Redington's IT services business. It delivers deployment, implementation, professional and managed services across Cybersecurity, Software, IDCS (Integrated Data Centre Solutions), Server & Storage, Cisco and Networking. We sell these services through Redington's channel partners, alongside every product deal we distribute.
  
  
We are looking for a driven Business Development Manager to grow CISS services revenue in their region. The role builds a qualified services funnel, works with Redington's sales teams (ASMs) to turn product conversations into services opportunities, and takes those opportunities through to order and billing.
  
  
The ideal candidate has sold IT services or solutions in IT distribution, an OEM, a system integrator or the channel partner ecosystem. They understand that services are sold differently from boxes: by scope, outcome and delivery, not by price list.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
**Build the services funnel**

* Identify and qualify services opportunities across Cybersecurity, Software, IDCS, Server & Storage, Cisco and Networking: deployment, implementation, migration, professional services, training and managed services, including SOC (security operations).
* Work with ASMs on their partner accounts to generate services leads from product deals, so that services are proposed with the hardware or software, not after it.
* Engage channel partners and system integrators to position Redington as their services delivery arm, and activate new partners for services.
* Turn OEM-generated and large-account leads into services opportunities.

**Take opportunities to closure**

* Qualify every lead on customer, need, timeline and size, and take it through to proposal, order and billing.
* Work with practice leads, presales and delivery teams to scope services, build the bill of quantities and statement of work, and prepare proposals and commercials.
* Run joint customer calls with partners and ASMs, and handle negotiation through to purchase order.
* Track every order in hand through delivery so that it converts into billing on time.

**Enable the sales teams and partners**

* Brief ASMs and partners on the CISS portfolio and how to pitch services, using the practice playbooks.
* Support partner enablement sessions, webinars and partner round tables in the region.

**Run the business with discipline**

* Keep the funnel accurate and current in RediCRM: every lead tagged with customer, branch, practice and stage.
* Publish weekly funnel and forecast updates. Track win/loss and record a reason for every loss.
* Monitor the market, competitor services offerings and partner needs to spot new opportunities.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Qualified services funnel built, and its conversion to orders
* Services revenue billed against target
* Partners activated for services, and leads generated with ASMs
* Services attach on product deals in the region
* Funnel hygiene and forecast accuracy in RediCRM

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, Commerce or a related field. An MBA is an advantage.
* 2–6 years of B2B sales or business development in the IT industry, with at least 2 years selling IT services or solutions.
* Experience in IT distribution, an OEM, a system integrator or a managed services provider is preferred.
* Exposure to one or more of these areas:
* Cybersecurity services (SOC, managed security, implementations)
* Data centre, server and storage deployment and migration(Dell, HPE, Lenovo & others)
* Networking services (Cisco, Juniper, HPE Aruba and others)
* Software, platform and AI services(IBM, Redhat, Oracle )
* Managed services and IT outsourcing
* Understanding of how services are scoped, priced and delivered: SOW, BOQ, time and material versus fixed price, and recurring revenue.
* Good grasp of the channel ecosystem and how to win partners' trust as a delivery partner.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship skills.
* Comfortable working across sales, presales, practice and delivery teams without direct authority over them.
* Target-driven, organised, and disciplined with CRM and reporting.
* Willing to travel for partner and customer meetings within the region.

title: Inside Sales Specialist - Voice agents
description:
Senior Enterprise Account Executive – AI Voice Agents

Company: StepsAI

Location: Hyderabad, India

Work mode: Full-time, work from office

Experience: 5+ years in B2B enterprise sales

About StepsAI

StepsAI builds AI agents that help businesses handle customer conversations across phone, WhatsApp, websites and social channels. Our voice agents can qualify leads, answer customer questions, book appointments, follow up on enquiries and automate repeatable customer workflows.

We’re expanding our voice-agent business in India. We’re looking for a strong enterprise seller who can find the right accounts, understand their operations and close meaningful deals.

The role

You will own the sales cycle from the first prospecting call to a signed contract and a successful handoff to implementation.

This is a hands-on sales role. You will build your own pipeline, reach decision-makers, lead discovery, shape a business case, coordinate technical and compliance discussions, and close paid pilots and annual contracts.

You should be comfortable selling a new solution to senior business leaders—and able to make the value clear without relying on a generic AI pitch.

What you’ll own

* Build and manage a pipeline of enterprise and mid-market accounts in India.
* Prospect independently through calls, email, LinkedIn, referrals, events and partner relationships.
* Identify high-volume customer workflows where voice agents can improve revenue, service or operating efficiency.
* Develop relationships with business heads in customer service, contact centres, collections, sales operations, dealer operations and digital transformation.
* Lead discovery meetings and quantify the current cost, workload or missed opportunity.
* Present tailored demos using the customer’s use case, workflow and systems.
* Work with product, engineering and implementation teams to define integrations, call flows, human handoffs and pilot success measures.
* Coordinate with IT, security, compliance, legal and procurement teams through evaluation and contracting.
* Close paid pilots and convert successful pilots into annual production contracts.
* Expand accounts into additional workflows, teams, regions and languages.
* Maintain a reliable forecast and clear CRM records.

Initial markets

You will help StepsAI build repeatable sales in:

* NBFCs and lending: enquiry follow-up, customer service, due-date reminders and other approved customer workflows.
* Insurance: quote follow-up, renewals, policy service and customer retention.
* Automotive and dealer networks: enquiry follow-up, test-drive booking, service reminders and customer feedback.
* High-volume commerce and logistics: COD confirmation, delivery exceptions, order support and returns.

You do not need to have sold into every industry. You do need to know how to learn a customer’s business and turn an operational problem into a funded project.

What we’re looking for

* At least 5 years of successful B2B sales experience, including enterprise or strategic accounts.
* A track record of personally sourcing and closing complex deals—not only managing inbound leads or passing opportunities to another team.
* Experience selling SaaS, cloud, contact-centre, telecom, CRM, automation or technology solutions.
* The ability to sell to senior stakeholders and build consensus across business, IT, compliance and procurement teams.
* Strong discovery skills: you can uncover call volumes, workflow costs, existing systems, decision criteria and buying timelines.
* Confidence presenting to senior buyers and handling commercial, technical and operational objections.
* Strong written and spoken communication in English. Hindi or an Indian regional language is an advantage.
* A practical, persistent and accountable approach to targets, follow-ups and forecasting.

You’ll stand out if you have

* Existing relationships with NBFCs, banks, insurers, automotive groups, contact centres or large consumer businesses.
* Experience selling AI, conversational automation, voice technology, CCaaS, BPO or customer-experience solutions.
* Closed multi-stakeholder deals involving pilots, integrations, security reviews or procurement.
* Built a new territory or market rather than relying on an established brand and inbound demand.
* Experience working with channel partners, system integrators or telecom providers.

How we’ll evaluate candidates

We care about what you have personally sold and how you sold it. Please be ready to discuss:

* A complex deal you sourced or materially advanced and closed.
* The buyer, deal value, sales cycle, blockers and your specific contribution.
* How you built pipeline when inbound leads were limited.

\* How you would sell a voice agent to an enterprise with a large customer-contact operation.

Apply

Send your CV with a short note about the largest B2B deal you personally helped close, your role in winning it, and the kind of enterprise customers you can reach.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**About the Role :**

We are looking for a
**Business Development Manager**
with a strong understanding of
**Performance Marketing**
to bring new clients to 8 Views and grow the agency's revenue.

**This is not a traditional sales role.**
You will pitch performance marketing-led businesses across Real Estate, Education, Healthcare and other lead-generation focused brands, so you need to understand the numbers behind the pitch, not just the pitch itself.

You will curate client-specific pitches, build pitch decks, manage the pipeline and close deals. About
**30% of your time**
will go to your own outreach: sourcing leads on LinkedIn and building relationships with consultants and potential partners. A dedicated outbound team supports lead generation, so the rest of your time goes to pitching, proposals and closing.

If you enjoy combining sales with marketing strategy and data-driven conversations, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Own the
  **new-business pipeline**
  from first conversation to signed contract, and close deals to meet monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
* **Curate client-specific pitches**
  by researching each prospect's business, competitors, digital presence and gaps, and recommending the right service mix (SEO, performance marketing, social, content, creative).
* Create
  **pitch decks and proposals**
  that are clear, visually strong and persuasive, and prepare scope-of-work and pricing documents with the team.
* Present to clients in person and over calls, and handle objections, negotiation and follow-ups.
* Discuss
  **performance marketing numbers**
  confidently with prospects: CPL, CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS, conversion rates and lead-to-sale ratios across Google Ads, Meta and SEO.
* Build realistic budget, lead and ROI projections for proposals, backed by data.
* Run your own
  **outreach (about 30% of your time)**
  : source leads on LinkedIn and other channels, send connection requests and follow-ups, and start conversations with decision-makers.
* Build relationships with
  **consultants, agencies and potential partners**
  for referrals and collaborations.
* Work with the outbound team on lead handovers, giving feedback on lead quality and ideal prospects.
* Qualify leads on budget, need, timeline and decision-maker access.
* Manage the pipeline in the CRM and share weekly and monthly reports on pipeline status, conversions and revenue forecasts.
* Hand over closed clients smoothly to the Brand Management and delivery teams, and make sure promises made in the pitch are understood internally.

**What We're Looking For :**

* **3+ years of experience**
  in business development, sales or client acquisition, preferably in a digital marketing or advertising agency.
* **Strong understanding of performance marketing,**
  digital strategies, marketing funnels and key performance metrics.
* A track record of closing deals and hitting revenue targets.
* Ability to
  **build pitch decks**
  and proposals in PowerPoint, Canva or Google Slides.
* Strong command of
  **LinkedIn as a prospecting tool**
  and comfort running your own outreach.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* **Strong analytical thinking**
  and a data-driven mindset, with comfort in numbers, reports and ROI discussions.
* Hands-on experience with a CRM and outreach tools.
* Proficiency in G Suite; familiarity with Meta, Google and LinkedIn Ads is an advantage.
* Comfortable using AI tools to improve research, proposals and productivity.

**What Will Make You Successful :**

* You think beyond the pitch and understand the client's business growth.
* You are comfortable discussing marketing numbers, not just creative ideas.
* You tailor every pitch to the client instead of reusing a template.
* You can challenge a client's assumptions with data and advise them confidently.
* You build real relationships with consultants and partners who bring referrals.
* You stay disciplined on pipeline hygiene and follow-ups.

**Bonus Points If You Have :**

* Experience selling digital marketing or performance marketing services.
* An existing network of consultants, agencies or channel partners.
* Experience with Real Estate, Education or Healthcare clients.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn automation and lead-generation tools.

**Agency experience is mandatory. Candidates with prior experience selling performance marketing services will be preferred.**

title: Associate Director of Sales
description:
Role purpose

Build and run Kryon's sales function for STB, ONT and adaptors: win and grow accounts with telcos, ISPs and MSOs, brand owners and distributors, and convert them into repeat, profitable volume. You own the revenue number, the pipeline and a small team that delivers it.

Key responsibilities

**Sales strategy and revenue ownership**

•        Own the annual sales plan, revenue and margin targets for STB, ONT and adaptors.

•        Define target segments, account priorities and go-to-market for each product line.

•        Track competitors, pricing and market trends, and feed them back into product and portfolio decisions.

**Telco / ISP / MSO sales**

•        Develop and close business with operators, ISPs and cable/MSO players for STB and ONT rollouts.

•        Lead RFQ, tender and pilot processes end to end: qualification, technical and commercial responses, trials, negotiation and order closure.

•        Manage long enterprise sales cycles and multi-level stakeholder relationships (technical, procurement, business heads).

**Brand owner and OEM/ODM business**

•        Pursue brand owners and OEM/ODM partners who want Kryon to design and manufacture under their brand.

•        Structure commercial terms, supply agreements and volume commitments together with the Director and sourcing, finance and legal teams.

**Distribution and channel**

•        Appoint, manage and grow distributors and channel partners, with clear territory, pricing and targets.

•        Set channel margins, schemes and credit terms that protect Kryon's profitability.

**Pipeline, pricing and commercial discipline**

•        Maintain a reliable pipeline and forecast, reviewed regularly with leadership.

•        Build quotations from BOM and cost inputs; approve pricing within agreed margin guardrails.

•        Drive payment collection and keep receivables healthy.

**Cross-functional coordination**

•        Turn customer requirements into clear inputs for engineering, NPI, sourcing and operations, and keep customers updated on build and delivery status.

•        Support regulatory, certification and compliance requirements needed for customer approvals (including export where relevant).

**Team leadership**

•        Hire, coach and set targets for 2-3 key account / sales executives.

•        Run weekly pipeline reviews and report to the Director on sales performance and risks.

Required qualifications

•        12-18 years in B2B sales within telecom, broadband CPE, set-top boxes, networking or consumer electronics.

•        Proven track record selling STB, ONT, routers or similar CPE to telcos, ISPs or MSOs, with existing operator or OEM relationships.

•        Experience handling RFQs, tenders and pilots, and negotiating large supply contracts.

•        Strong commercial grounding: costing, margins, pricing, receivables.

•        Experience leading or building a small sales team.

•        Bachelor's degree in engineering (Electronics / Telecom preferred); MBA is an advantage.

•        Based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad; comfortable with regular travel.

Preferred

•        Experience with ODM/OEM or contract manufacturing sales.

•        Working knowledge of the Indian CPE market, relevant certifications (such as BIS, TEC, WPC/ETA) and export compliance.

•        Existing relationships with distributors, system integrators and brand owners.

•        Familiarity with GPON/ONT, Android TV / IPTV STB ecosystems and power adaptor markets.

Key competencies

•        Consultative, relationship-led selling with senior decision-makers.

•        Technical fluency to discuss product specs, certification and integration with customer engineers.

•        Negotiation and commercial judgement; protects margin while closing volume.

•        Structured pipeline management and forecasting.

•        Builds, coaches and holds a small team accountable.

•        Ownership mindset suited to a growing company moving into EMS.

title: HEAD – SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
description:
**Luxury Furniture & Architectural Solutions**

**Location- Hyderabad, India | Pan-India & international exposure**

**Experience-**
12–18 years preferred

**Employment-**
Full-time | On-site

**Reporting to-**
Director

About Altossa

Altossa Projects LLP is a luxury project solutions and furniture curation company headquartered in Hyderabad, with a 40,000 sq. ft. flagship showroom. We work with international manufacturers, architects, interior designers, developers and discerning private clients on luxury villas, residences, family offices, premium commercial environments, clubhouses and international projects.

Our portfolio includes Italian and international furniture, bespoke and collectible-design pieces, decorative and architectural lighting, kitchens, wardrobes, doors, premium windows and façade systems, modular office furniture and specialized interior solutions.

The Opportunity

We seek an accomplished, commercially astute and well-connected Head – Sales & Business Development to lead growth across India and select international projects. This is a hands-on leadership position, not a conventional showroom sales role. The candidate must engage confidently with principal architects, design directors, developers and HNI/UHNI clients, personally originate and close high-value projects, and guide the sales team to convert opportunities profitably.

Key Responsibilities1. Strategic Relationships & New Business

·       Develop trusted relationships with principal architects, leading interior designers, developers, family offices and HNI/UHNI decision-makers.

·       Generate new opportunities in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore and other key markets.

·       Engage international architectural practices and identify cross-border opportunities.

·       Build an active, qualified opportunity pipeline through personal introductions, specification discussions and proactive follow-through.

2. High-Value Sales & Deal Closure

·       Personally lead strategic opportunities from first meeting and design specification to commercial negotiations, confirmed orders and collections.

·       Present convincing design, quality, technical and lifecycle-value arguments rather than competing only on discount.

·       Navigate difficult client objections, competitive tenders, multiple stakeholders and long project cycles.

·       Protect gross margins while negotiating commercially sound terms and closing profitable business.

3. Multi-Category Luxury Product Knowledge

·       Demonstrate strong familiarity with Italian/international luxury loose furniture, upholstery, dining and bespoke furniture.

·       Understand kitchens, wardrobes, storage systems, premium office/modular furniture and collectible-design pieces.

·       Discuss architectural doors, entrance systems, internal doors, premium windows, sliding systems and façades in aluminium, steel, brass and stainless steel.

·       Present decorative and architectural lighting, custom installations, materials, finishes, customization, durability and relevant specifications.

·       Read architectural drawings, concepts and mood boards, and align product selection with design intent, proportions, performance and budget.

4. Team Leadership & Commercial Control

·       Lead, coach and hold the business development/sales team accountable while directly managing high-value accounts.

·       Maintain forecasts, account plans, conversion metrics, project margins and collection discipline.

·       Coordinate with design, sourcing, technical, finance and project teams to deliver credible proposals and commitments.

·       Represent Altossa at design presentations, manufacturer meetings, exhibitions and client events; travel as required.

Candidate ProfileEssential

·       12–18 years of relevant experience preferred, ideally in luxury furniture, premium architectural products, interiors or design-led project sales.

·       Genuine active relationships with senior architects and HNI/UHNI clients, supported by a record of business generated.

·       Verified track record of personally originating, negotiating and closing significant high-value deals.

·       Strong Italian/international luxury brand literacy, design sensibility and multi-product commercial awareness.

·       Executive presence, maturity, consultative communication, negotiation skills and ability to persuade senior decision-makers.

·       Experience leading a sales team, managing deal pipelines, protecting margins and tracking collections.

·       Willingness to travel across India and internationally as required.

Preferred

·       Experience with premium European furniture and architectural-product manufacturers.

·       Project specification and bespoke/contract sales exposure, including luxury residences and premium offices.

·       Relationships with design studios across multiple Indian cities and international markets.

Success Measures

·       Quality and depth of new architect, client and developer relationships.

·       Personally generated opportunities converted into confirmed profitable orders.

·       Revenue, gross profitability, timely collections and sustained repeat business.

·       Improved opportunity pipeline, forecast accuracy and team execution.

·       Stronger market recognition of Altossa as a design-led project-solutions partner.

Application & Selection

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to discuss three to five significant completed projects that they personally originated, negotiated and closed, including approximate values, their specific role and outcomes (respecting client confidentiality). The selection process may include a senior-architect pitch and a live high-value project negotiation case.

We value demonstrable commercial achievement and authentic professional relationships above prestigious brand names or contact lists alone.

title: Senior Sales Lead — Hospital Software & Clinical AI
description:
Senior Sales Lead — Hospital Software & Clinical AITelangana & Andhra Pradesh | Brahmo AI

Location: Hyderabad-based field role, with extensive travel across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh

Experience: 5–12 years in B2B healthcare IT or hospital software sales

Compensation: ₹4–16 LPA, comprising fixed salary and performance-linked incentives

Employment: Full-time

Reporting to: Founders

About Brahmo AI

Brahmo AI is building an AI-first clinical platform for hospitals and clinics in India. Our current production offering focuses on AI-powered medical scribing and structured clinical documentation, with broader clinical and hospital workflows under development.

With a live product and paying contracts already in place, we are expanding across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. We are looking for a hands-on sales leader who brings hospital relationships, personally wins customers, and builds a small field sales team as the business grows.

The Role

You will own new customer acquisition and revenue growth across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.

This is a hands-on selling role with leadership responsibility—not a position focused only on managing a team. You will carry an individual sales target and personally lead prospecting, decision-maker meetings, discovery, demonstrations, commercial negotiations, and closures.

You will work directly with the founders, supported by product training and technical assistance when required. As the territory develops, you will recruit and coach a small field sales team while continuing to own key accounts and important deals.

We bring the product, training, and existing customer contracts to build on. You bring market access, disciplined execution, and the ability to turn hospital interest into paying, active customers.

What You Will Do

* Personally acquire hospital customers. Own the complete sales cycle—from identifying opportunities and securing meetings to demonstrating the product, negotiating commercials, closing contracts, and coordinating first payment.
* Build and execute the territory plan. Map and prioritise hospitals, nursing homes, specialty clinics, and hospital groups across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. Identify the right accounts, decision-makers, and routes to market.
* Develop decision-maker relationships. Engage hospital owners and promoters, medical directors, medical superintendents, operations leaders, and IT and purchase teams. Understand their clinical, operational, and commercial priorities.
* Run discovery and product demonstrations. Independently demonstrate the core product after training. Translate its capabilities into practical value for doctors and administrators, rather than relying on feature lists or unsupported claims.
* Manage pilots with clear conversion plans. Agree on the scope, duration, success criteria, decision-maker, commercial terms, and decision date before a pilot begins. Drive a clear outcome rather than allowing open-ended free trials.
* Follow through after signature. Coordinate payment, onboarding handover, and initial customer activation. Maintain the buyer relationship and resolve commercial blockers while working with the onboarding and product teams.
* Grow existing accounts. Identify opportunities for paid expansion, additional departments or locations, referrals, and relevant cross-selling as products become available.
* Build and lead a small field team. Recruit and coach salespeople as the territory grows. Set targets, conduct weekly pipeline reviews, support important deals, and develop a repeatable sales playbook.
* Maintain sales discipline and market feedback. Keep CRM records, forecasts, and next steps current. Represent Brahmo AI at relevant industry events and share customer feedback and competitor insights with the founders. Distinguish live capabilities from roadmap items and obtain approval before making custom commitments.

What You Bring — Must-Haves

* 4–12 years of relevant B2B sales experience in HIMS/HIS, EMR/EHR, LIMS, hospital SaaS, or closely related healthcare IT products, with a verifiable record of personally closed deals and target achievement.
* An active hospital network across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, with recent relationships among owners, promoters, medical directors, or operational decision-makers. Experience selling into 20–200-bed hospitals or larger institutions is particularly relevant.
* Personal ownership of the full sales cycle. You have sourced opportunities, conducted discovery and demonstrations, negotiated commercials, and closed business—not only supervised others who did.
* Experience leading or mentoring field salespeople, including target-setting, coaching, follow-up discipline, and pipeline reviews.
* Confidence demonstrating software yourself. You can learn the core workflows, handle common objections, and explain the value to both doctors and hospital administrators.
* Fluency in Telugu and English, a Hyderabad base or willingness to relocate, and readiness for extensive field travel across both states. Hindi is an advantage.
* A bachelor’s degree. An MBA or a healthcare, hospital administration, or pharma background is an advantage.

Relevant backgrounds may include companies such as HealthPlix, Suvarna Technosoft, KareXpert, Attune, Medinous, Insta by Practo, MocDoc, Birlamedisoft, Akhil Systems, or similar healthcare IT vendors. Demonstrated sales results matter more than a particular employer name.

Good to Have

* Experience selling an early-stage or AI-enabled product where you helped develop the positioning and sales approach.
* Relationships in Tier-2 and Tier-3 markets, including Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Guntur, Warangal, Tirupati, Nellore, and Karimnagar.
* Experience selling to hospital chains or specialty groups.
* Familiarity with ABDM/ABHA and hospital digital-health requirements.

Who Will Thrive Here

You are a hands-on seller who opens doors personally and takes responsibility for outcomes. You are comfortable building a territory without an established sales organisation behind you.

You sell consultatively, follow up consistently, and know how to move an opportunity toward a decision. You work independently while recognising when technical or commercial approval is needed.

Above all, you build trust: you represent the product accurately, make realistic commitments, and care whether customers successfully adopt what they purchase.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success will be measured through qualified opportunities, conversion to paid contracts, collected revenue, and commercial follow-through on customer activation—not meetings or proposals alone.

As the team grows, you will also be accountable for team performance, pipeline quality, forecast accuracy, and account expansion. Targets and responsibilities will be agreed with the founders, taking account of product scope and onboarding capacity.

Compensation

₹4–16 LPA annual compensation, comprising fixed salary and performance-linked incentives.

The package will depend on relevant hospital software sales experience, demonstrated closures, territory relationships, and the scope of responsibility. The fixed component, performance targets, incentive calculation, and payout terms will be clearly agreed before joining.

How to Apply

Apply on LinkedIn with your résumé and a brief note covering:

1. Products and performance: The healthcare IT products you have personally sold, your buyer segments, and your targets versus achievement.
2. Three representative closures: Hospital deals in Telangana or Andhra Pradesh, including approximate contract value, sales-cycle length, your personal contribution, and whether the customer went live.
3. Territory strength: Your strongest markets and hospital relationships across both states, including how recently you engaged with those stakeholders.
4. Availability: Your current location, notice period, and willingness to travel.

* Applications with specific, relevant sales evidence will be prioritised. Commercially sensitive information may be anonymised; please do not submit confidential customer documents, internal CRM exports, or private contact details.

description:
**We're Hiring | Enterprise AI Strategy & Growth Lead**

Build CXO Relationships. Shape Enterprise AI Adoption. Drive Business Growth.

**Location:**
Hyderabad |
**Experience:**
0–5 Years |
**Employment:**
Full-time

**Preferred Qualifications:**
Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA + B.Tech

THIS IS NOT A CONVENTIONAL ENTERPRISE SALES ROLE.

Enterprise AI is at an inflection point.

Businesses are moving beyond AI experimentation and looking for technologies that can fundamentally change how they operate, make decisions and execute business processes.

At FinteractAI, we're building the next generation of enterprise AI.

Our flagship platform, FORGE, is an Autonomous Business Operations Engine that works across existing ERP and business systems to intelligently understand, validate and execute complex business processes within enterprise-defined controls.

With live deployments across industries and demonstrated outcomes including up to 90% reduction in manual processing, we're now accelerating enterprise adoption.

We're looking for an exceptional individual who can help lead this journey.

Someone who can think like a strategist, engage like a business leader and execute like an entrepreneur.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

As our Enterprise AI Strategy & Growth Lead, you'll work closely with the founding leadership, product and engineering teams to help enterprises understand and realise the business potential of AI.

You will independently develop enterprise relationships, engage with CEOs, CFOs, COOs and other senior leaders, identify high-impact business opportunities and convert them into successful customer engagements.

This is a frontline, revenue-owning role — combining strategic business understanding with the energy, initiative and persistence required to win enterprise customers.

You'll have the opportunity to build deep expertise in Enterprise AI, influence product direction and develop a strong professional network across industries.

We're looking for someone with the potential to become a recognised Enterprise AI leader and take on significantly larger business responsibilities as we grow.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

Enterprise Strategy & Business Development

- Identify and develop enterprise opportunities across industries.

- Build relationships with CEOs, CFOs, COOs and senior business decision-makers.

- Understand enterprise operating models, business challenges and technology priorities.

- Identify where AI can create measurable improvements in operational efficiency, execution speed, operating capacity and governance.

- Develop compelling business cases that connect AI capabilities with commercial outcomes.

Enterprise Growth & Revenue Ownership

- Independently own the enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and CXO engagement to commercial negotiations and closure.

- Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified enterprise opportunities.

- Drive customer acquisition, new revenue and account development.

- Take personal ownership of commercial outcomes, execution discipline and growth targets.

Enterprise AI Thought Leadership

- Stay current with developments in Enterprise AI, agentic AI, autonomous operations and enterprise technology adoption.

- Understand how AI is reshaping business processes, organisational roles, operating models and technology roadmaps.

- Build credibility as a knowledgeable and trusted enterprise AI professional.

- Represent FinteractAI in relevant industry discussions, business forums and customer engagements.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

- Work closely with our product and engineering teams to translate enterprise challenges into practical AI solutions.

- Bring customer insights and market feedback into product development discussions.

- Collaborate on solution positioning, demonstrations and customer adoption strategies.

- Help build repeatable enterprise use cases and scalable go-to-market approaches.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We value intellectual ability, curiosity, ambition and ownership more than conventional job titles or years of experience.

Educational Background

We particularly encourage applications from:

- Chartered Accountants (CA) — including exceptional newly qualified professionals.

- MBA + B.Tech graduates with strong analytical, business and technology aptitude.

- Exceptional candidates from other academic backgrounds who demonstrate outstanding potential.

Experience: 0–5 years.

Experience in enterprise sales, consulting, business development, corporate finance, technology or related areas is valuable, but not mandatory for outstanding candidates.

**THE QUALITIES THAT MATTER MOST**

1. Exceptional Intelligence & Analytical Ability

You think independently, learn quickly, connect complex ideas and can understand business problems beyond their surface symptoms.

2. Strong Technology Aptitude & AI Curiosity

You actively follow AI developments and understand their implications for enterprises.

You don't need to be a developer or AI researcher. But you should be able to discuss how AI can reshape business processes, human roles, enterprise systems and operating models.

3. High Energy & Commercial Drive

You enjoy building relationships, opening doors, pursuing ambitious opportunities and converting conversations into business outcomes.

You are persistent, resourceful and comfortable with demanding growth targets.

4. Leadership Potential

You demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, confidence, resilience and the ambition to take on larger responsibilities.

You don't wait for detailed instructions to make progress.

5. Executive Communication & Presence

You can communicate complex ideas simply, ask intelligent questions, engage confidently with senior executives and build lasting professional relationships.

6. Collaborative & Entrepreneurial Mindset

You enjoy working with engineers, product builders and business leaders.

You challenge assumptions constructively, contribute ideas and take ownership of outcomes beyond your immediate responsibilities.

**WHY JOIN FINTERACTAI?**

Work at the Frontier of Enterprise AI

Be part of a company building AI-native capabilities that go beyond conventional automation and AI copilots to execute real business operations.

Learn Directly from Experienced Leadership

Work closely with a founding team bringing decades of experience across global banking, enterprise technology, product development and business operations.

Engage with Enterprise CXOs

Build meaningful relationships with senior business leaders across industries and participate in conversations shaping enterprise AI adoption.

Influence Product Direction

Your understanding of business problems and customer requirements will help shape the evolution of our AI platform.

Accelerate Your Leadership Journey

We believe exceptional individuals should grow based on capability and contribution, not tenure. The right candidate can progress into enterprise coverage leadership, industry vertical ownership or broader business leadership responsibilities.

Earn Exceptional Rewards

For the right talent, we offer a highly competitive, performance-oriented compensation package comprising:

- Attractive fixed compensation.

- Significant performance-linked incentives.

- Revenue-sharing opportunities.

- ESOP participation for eligible high performers.

- Accelerated growth opportunities based on results.

We want the people who create exceptional value to participate meaningfully in the value they help build.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Within your first year, you should be developing into a confident enterprise AI professional who can:

- Independently engage senior enterprise decision-makers.

- Identify business problems where AI can create meaningful, measurable impact.

- Build credible business cases and lead strategic customer conversations.

- Convert enterprise opportunities into signed customers and revenue.

- Become a valued partner to our product and engineering teams.

- Build a reputation for business insight, commercial execution and ownership.

Your success will be measured by the enterprise relationships you build, the customers and revenue you win, and the leadership capabilities you demonstrate.

**WHO WILL THRIVE HERE?**

Someone who wants more than a conventional corporate career.

Someone who is intellectually curious, commercially ambitious, technology-oriented and excited by the opportunity to help enterprises adopt AI at scale.

Someone who wants to build the credibility, experience and capabilities to become a future business leader.

If you want to be at the intersection of AI, enterprise strategy and business growth, we'd love to meet you.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV to info@finteract.ai

Subject: Enterprise AI Strategy & Growth Lead – Hyderabad

**Along with your CV, please answer this question in 150 words or less:**

**"Identify one enterprise business process that AI could fundamentally change over the next three years. What would change, and how would you measure its business impact?"**

**We are interested in how you think, not how many AI buzzwords you know.**

FinteractAI | Building the Autonomous Enterprise

www.finteract.ai

Less Manual Work. Faster Operations. Greater Operating Capacity. Stronger Controls.

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
TruColors, founded in 2022, designs, manufactures, and markets school-wear merchandise under the brand name Prepster. The company focuses on creating high-quality, contemporary uniform and school-wear options for educational institutions and students. Team members can expect an environment that offers challenging, varied work and opportunities to contribute to a growing brand. TruColors encourages individuals who enjoy dynamic roles and are motivated to support the company’s expansion in the school-wear market.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Salesperson role based in Hyderabad. The Salesperson will engage with schools, institutions, and retail partners to promote Prepster products, manage the sales cycle, and build long-term customer relationships. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying new prospects, conducting product presentations, following up on leads, negotiating pricing and terms within company guidelines, and closing sales. The role also involves maintaining accurate sales records, coordinating with the production and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries, and gathering market feedback to support product improvements. The Salesperson will work closely with management to meet sales targets and contribute to strategic growth initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sales, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills, with the ability to convert leads into repeat business.
* Ability to conduct product demonstrations, explain features and benefits clearly, and tailor sales pitches to different stakeholders.
* Competence in basic business communication, including email, phone, and in-person interactions, with clear spoken and written English.
* Comfort with using spreadsheets, CRM tools, or other sales tracking software to maintain records and report on performance.
* Prior experience in apparel, uniforms, retail, or related sectors is beneficial, especially in B2B or institutional sales.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel locally within Hyderabad and surrounding areas for client meetings and site visits.
* Minimum educational qualification of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is an advantage.

title: Real Estate Sales Consultant
description:
**ob description:**

Company: Propteliio Consultants Private Limited

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Department: Sales & Business Development

Employment Type: Full-time

**About Propteliio**

Propteliio Consultants Private Limited is a real estate consultancy with a presence in Hyderabad, Dubai, and the UK. We help clients make informed property decisions through property selection, investment strategies, legal support, and after-sales services. We collaborate with real estate developers to connect their projects with potential buyers and investors.

Job Overview

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven Sales Executive to expand Propteliio’s developer network by identifying, approaching, negotiating with, and onboarding new real estate developers. The candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end sales cycle, from prospecting and relationship building to partnership closure and ongoing account management.

The ideal candidate should have strong negotiation and communication skills, a good understanding of the real estate market, and the ability to build long-term business relationships with developers & clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Developer and Client Acquisition & Onboarding:**
  Identify and approach new real estate developers, builders, and property development companies to establish business partnerships. Reach out to clients and understand their needs and propose suitable properties to them.
* **Lead Generation & Prospecting:**
  Build a pipeline of potential developer partners and Clients through market research, networking, cold calling, referrals, industry events, and field visits.
* **End-to-End Sales Management:**
  Manage the complete sales process, including initial outreach, requirement analysis, presentations, meetings, negotiations, deal closure, and onboarding.
* **Business Development:**
  Identify new business opportunities, explore emerging real estate markets, and expand Propteliio’s developer and clients portfolio.
* **Relationship Management:**
  Build and maintain strong relationships with developers and clients.
* **Negotiation & Deal Closure:**
  Negotiate commercial terms and other partnership requirements to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. Close deals with clients after scheduling their site visits.
* **Project Understanding:**
  Develop a thorough understanding of developers’ projects, pricing, inventory, amenities, payment plans, and unique selling propositions.
* **Internal Coordination:**
  Work closely with marketing teams to facilitate project promotion, lead sharing, client engagement, and successful business execution.
* **Market Intelligence:**
  Track competitor activities, new project launches, market trends, and developer offerings to identify growth opportunities.
* **Sales Reporting:**
  Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, negotiations, onboarding progress, and closures in the company’s CRM.
* **Target Achievement:**
  Meet monthly and quarterly targets for developer acquisition, partnership closures, client closures and business revenue.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
* Prior experience in real estate sales, business development, channel partner management, or developer acquisition is preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently generate leads and manage the complete sales cycle.
* Good understanding of the Hyderabad real estate market and its developer ecosystem is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel for developer meetings, project visits, and business development activities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, CRM tools, and sales reporting.
* A self-motivated, result-oriented approach with the ability to work towards ambitious sales targets.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of new developers identified and approached.
* Number of developer meetings and business presentations conducted.
* Number of developers successfully onboarded.
* Number of clients closed and sales done.
* Conversion rate from prospecting to partnership & client closures.
* Revenue and business opportunities generated through developer partnerships.
* Quality of developer relationships and ongoing account engagement

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to build and expand a strong developer network and client base.
* Exposure to Hyderabad’s real estate and property investment markets.
* Career growth opportunities in sales and business development.
* A performance-driven work environment with opportunities to take ownership of business growth.

* A diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, Interior Design, or a related field is beneficial but not mandatory for candidates with strong sales aptitude.

Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site

About KOHIRA Diamonds

KOHIRA is a fast-growing premium lab-grown diamond jewellery brand, committed to offering exceptional craftsmanship, certified diamonds, contemporary designs, and an outstanding customer experience.

As we expand our retail presence across India, we are looking for an experienced, dynamic, and result-oriented Showroom Manager to lead our Hyderabad showroom operations.

1. Sales & Business Growth

\* Take complete ownership of showroom sales targets, revenue growth, and profitability.

\* Improve walk-in conversions, average transaction value, and repeat purchases.

\* Develop strategies to increase customer footfall and showroom revenue.

2. BTL Marketing & Local Business Development
