\* Build relationships with nearby residential societies, corporate offices, premium communities, and local businesses.

\* Organize society activations, corporate exhibitions, promotional events, referral activities, and local customer engagement programmes.

\* Monitor BTL activity performance, lead generation, conversions, and ROI.

\* Proactively develop new local customer acquisition opportunities.

3. Team Leadership & Motivation

\* Lead, inspire, train, and motivate the showroom sales team.

\* Set individual sales targets and regularly review team performance.

\* Conduct daily morning meetings, product training, and sales coaching.

\* Build a high-performance, customer-focused sales culture.

\* Ensure discipline, accountability, grooming, and professional behaviour.

4. Diamond Jewellery Expertise & Customer Experience

\* Demonstrate excellent knowledge of natural and lab-grown diamonds, including the 4Cs, certification, quality, and jewellery craftsmanship.

\* Explain diamond characteristics, product value, and jewellery features confidently to customers.

\* Deliver a premium and personalised luxury jewellery shopping experience.

\* Handle high-value customers, negotiations, escalations, and customer relationships professionally.

\* Ensure effective CRM follow-ups, customer retention, and repeat business.

5. Showroom Operations & Compliance

\* Manage day-to-day showroom operations, including opening and closing procedures.

\* Ensure stock accuracy, inventory control, visual merchandising, and showroom presentation.

\* Maintain compliance with company SOPs, billing procedures, security standards, and cash-handling policies.

\* Monitor CRM updates, customer inquiries, pending orders, and sales reports.

\* Coordinate with Head Office and regional management for smooth operations.

Required Qualifications & Experience

\* Minimum 5–7 years of experience in the jewellery retail industry.

\* Minimum 2–3 years of proven experience as a Showroom Manager / Store Manager with an established jewellery brand.

\* Strong knowledge of diamond jewellery, diamond grading, certification, and jewellery retail sales.

\* Proven experience in achieving sales targets and leading showroom teams.

\* Demonstrated ability to independently plan and execute BTL marketing activities.

\* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

\* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to inspire and develop a team.

\* Proficiency in CRM, retail reporting, and basic showroom management systems.

\* Fluency in English, Hindi, and Telugu preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a hands-on business leader, not just an operations manager.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently driving showroom sales, generating local business through BTL activities, developing a motivated sales team, and delivering an exceptional luxury jewellery customer experience.

Candidates with experience in reputed branded diamond jewellery retail chains will be preferred.

Why Join KOHIRA?

\* Be part of a rapidly expanding premium diamond jewellery brand.

\* Opportunity to lead showroom growth and local market development.

\* Performance-driven work culture with opportunities for career advancement.

\* Opportunity to grow with KOHIRA’s expanding pan-India retail network.

Apply now and become part of KOHIRA Diamonds’ growth journey.

**What You Will Own**

* Deliver white-glove operational support for strategic and enterprise-level opportunities, ensuring deal accuracy, policy alignment, and operational compliance.
* Review and validate pricing, configurations, and supporting documentation for complex sales transactions.

**Process Improvement, AI & Operational Excellence**

* Ensure operational requests are accurately categorized and documented to support meaningful reporting, analytics, and service improvement.
* Use operational data and trends to identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Identify and responsibly apply automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern productivity practices to reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, and enhance service delivery.
* Lead and participate in cross-functional initiatives focused on improving sales processes, systems, controls, and business operations.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, training materials, playbooks, and best practices that support consistency, knowledge transfer, and scale.

**Stakeholder Partnership & Escalation Management**

* Act as a liaison across Sales, Renewals, Contracts, Billing, IT, and other business partners to resolve issues, clarify ownership, and streamline workflows.
* Translate complex operational issues into clear options, decisions, and next steps for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build trusted relationships across geographies and maintain strong daily partnership with U.S.-based stakeholders during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

**Required**
**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, Quote-to-Cash, or related commercial-operations function.
* Prior experience leading, coaching, or formally managing people, with evidence of developing team capability and performance.
* Strong knowledge of quoting, contract administration, order management, pricing, approvals, and operational handoffs that support sales execution.
* Advanced proficiency in Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform, plus Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint with CPQ tools, is strongly preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across functions and organizational levels.
* Ability and willingness to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours from Hyderabad.
* Demonstrated curiosity and sound judgment in adopting automation, AI-enabled tools, and emerging technologies to improve team effectiveness.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting strategic or enterprise sales opportunities in a B2B SaaS or enterprise-technology environment.
* Experience with Salesforce CPQ and related contract, billing, e-signature, or reporting platforms.
* Experience leading process improvement, systems-enablement, automation, or AI-adoption initiatives.
* Experience supporting a geographically distributed team and stakeholders across India and the United States.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Why This Role Matters**
This role will shape the day-to-day effectiveness, capability, and culture of the Sales Support team in Hyderabad. The Team Lead will directly influence how quickly new team members become productive, how consistently complex sales requests are handled, and how effectively Sales Support partners with the wider business.
  
  
The right leader will combine strong people’s management with operational depth and a practical improvement mindset. Success in this role means building a high-performing team, creating scalable ways of working, and using data, automation, and AI-enabled practices to deliver dependable support as business needs evolve.

GL Stone Expo is a premium destination for natural stone solutions, offering a curated selection of high-quality marbles and exclusive granites. Located in Hyderabad, the company focuses on elevating residential, commercial, and bespoke spaces through elegant, durable materials. GL Stone Expo emphasizes craftsmanship, design, and attention to detail in every project. The team collaborates closely with clients, designers, and contractors to deliver tailored stone solutions that meet both aesthetic and functional needs. The company is growing its presence in the local market and offers opportunities to contribute to a brand centered on quality and style.

**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Business Development Associate role is based at GL Stone Expo in Hyderabad. The role involves identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, generating leads through market research, networking, and outreach to potential clients in residential and commercial segments. The associate will prepare and deliver presentations that showcase GL Stone Expo’s products and solutions, and will support client meetings, showroom visits, and follow-ups to convert prospects into customers. Daily tasks include maintaining a pipeline of opportunities, coordinating with the sales and operations teams, and documenting interactions in CRM or tracking tools. The role also requires continuous engagement with local market trends and competitors to support strategic growth initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Presentation Skills and the ability to create and deliver effective Presentations to diverse audiences.

* Candidates should possess Market Research capabilities to analyze trends, competitors, and customer needs.
* Candidates should possess clear and professional Communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Relevant experience in business development, sales, or client-facing roles, preferably in building materials, interiors, or related industries.

* Ability to work with basic productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, CRM or lead tracking software).
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.

title: Business Development Manager

**Company Description**
Trace Network & Engineering Pvt Ltd is a premier provider of IT and networking infrastructure and cybersecurity solutions, offering end-to-end services tailored to enterprise needs. With over 22 years of experience and more than 900 clients across diverse industries, the company focuses on secure, reliable, and future-ready IT environments. Its portfolio includes enterprise networking, network security, cybersecurity, cloud services, hardware solutions, and VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing). Strategic partnerships, including Platinum partner status with Sophos and Gold with HPE Aruba Networking, along with collaborations with leading OEMs such as Microsoft, Dell, IBM, Google, and others, enable Trace Network to deliver industry-leading technologies. The organization is committed to helping businesses drive digital transformation, efficiency, and resilience through robust IT and security solutions.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Business Development Manager role based in Hyderabad. The Business Development Manager will identify and pursue new business opportunities, build and maintain strong client relationships, and promote Trace Network’s IT infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, and hardware solutions. Responsibilities include understanding customer requirements, preparing and presenting proposals, coordinating with internal technical and pre-sales teams, and managing the sales pipeline from lead generation to closure. The role also involves conducting market research, participating in industry events, and providing regular forecasts and performance reports to leadership. The Business Development Manager will collaborate closely with OEM partners and internal stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term account growth.

**Qualifications**

* Strong business development and sales skills, including lead generation, opportunity qualification, negotiation, and deal closure.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong presentation and interpersonal capabilities.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent business qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in B2B enterprise sales, preferably with IT, networking, or cybersecurity products and services.
* Ability to work independently, meet targets, and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

**Job Title:**
Relationship Manager (B2B Partnerships)
  
  
**Department:**
B2B Sales
  
  
**Product:**
Education Loan & B2B Admissions
  
  
**About GyanDhan:**
GyanDhan is India's leading platform for education financing, helping students secure loans for studying abroad. We partner with study abroad consultants to provide the best financial and admission solutions for students.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
As a Relationship Manager at GyanDhan, you will play a critical role in driving B2B sales and building partnerships with study abroad consultants, channel partners, DSAs, and coaching institutes. Your goal is to generate student referrals across both education loans and B2B admissions, position GyanDhan as the preferred financing and admission partner, and drive partner adoption of Setulin, GyanDhan's study-abroad CRM.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* B2B Sales & Field Partnerships: Identify and secure new business opportunities through consultants, channel partners, DSAs, and coaching institutes. Focus on field sales to drive referrals and build strong partnerships across both loan and admission business lines.
* B2B Admissions: Expand partner engagement beyond loans to include admission referrals, driving cross-sell of GyanDhan's admission services alongside education loan products.
* Setulin CRM Adoption: Onboard and train partners on Setulin so they manage the full student journey from enquiry to admission on the CRM, replacing manual tracking via Google Sheets or diaries. Drive consistent partner usage to improve lead visibility, cross-sell, and conversion tracking.
* Relationship Management: Establish and maintain long-term relationships with partners, ensuring consistent support and communication through regular meetings and networking.
* Achieve Referral & Sales Targets: Drive the referral pipeline across loans and admissions, ensuring 100% student referrals from your partner network, contributing to increased disbursements, admission conversions, and overall growth.
* Strategic Planning & Market Insights: Identify key business opportunities, monitor market trends, and ensure GyanDhan's loan and admission offerings remain competitive.
* Partner Education & Support: Organize webinars, seminars, and training sessions to educate partners on GyanDhan's loan and admission products and on using Setulin effectively.
* Resolve Issues & Ensure Smooth Operations: Act as the primary point of contact for partners, providing timely solutions to any concerns and ensuring seamless operations.
* Track Performance & Report Results: Monitor and report key metrics, including referral rates, loan disbursements, admission conversions, Setulin adoption/usage rates, partner satisfaction, and sales performance to senior management.

**Preferred Experience**

* 2+ years in B2B sales, relationship management, business development, or field sales (experience with study abroad consultants, DSAs, or coaching institutes is a plus).
* Proven skills in negotiation, persuasion, and driving business growth.
* Comfort with CRM tools; experience driving partner/customer adoption of a CRM or digital platform is a plus.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with a wide range of stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel extensively for field sales.
* Target-driven and results-oriented, with a track record of exceeding sales goals.

**Interested candidates can connect me at priyanka.yadav@gyandhan.com or 9266766233**

title: Regional Sales Head — Hospital Software & Clinical AI
description:
Regional Sales Head — Hospital Software & Clinical AITelangana & Andhra Pradesh | Brahmo AI

**Location:**
Hyderabad-based field role, with extensive travel across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh

**Experience:**
5–12 years in B2B healthcare IT or hospital software sales

**Compensation:**
₹5–20 LPA, comprising fixed salary and performance-linked incentives

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Reporting to:**
Founders

About Brahmo AI

Brahmo AI is building an AI-first clinical platform for hospitals and clinics in India. Our current production offering focuses on AI-powered medical scribing and structured clinical documentation, with broader clinical and hospital workflows under development.

With a live product and paying contracts already in place, we are expanding across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. We are looking for a hands-on sales leader who brings hospital relationships, personally wins customers, and builds a small field sales team as the business grows.

The Role

You will own new customer acquisition and revenue growth across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.

**This is a hands-on selling role with leadership responsibility—not a position focused only on managing a team.**
You will carry an individual sales target and personally lead prospecting, decision-maker meetings, discovery, demonstrations, commercial negotiations, and closures.

You will work directly with the founders, supported by product training and technical assistance when required. As the territory develops, you will recruit and coach a small field sales team while continuing to own key accounts and important deals.

We bring the product, training, and existing customer contracts to build on. You bring market access, disciplined execution, and the ability to turn hospital interest into paying, active customers.

What You Will Do

* **Personally acquire hospital customers.**
  Own the complete sales cycle—from identifying opportunities and securing meetings to demonstrating the product, negotiating commercials, closing contracts, and coordinating first payment.
* **Build and execute the territory plan.**
  Map and prioritise hospitals, nursing homes, specialty clinics, and hospital groups across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. Identify the right accounts, decision-makers, and routes to market.
* **Develop decision-maker relationships.**
  Engage hospital owners and promoters, medical directors, medical superintendents, operations leaders, and IT and purchase teams. Understand their clinical, operational, and commercial priorities.
* **Run discovery and product demonstrations.**
  Independently demonstrate the core product after training. Translate its capabilities into practical value for doctors and administrators, rather than relying on feature lists or unsupported claims.
* **Manage pilots with clear conversion plans.**
  Agree on the scope, duration, success criteria, decision-maker, commercial terms, and decision date before a pilot begins. Drive a clear outcome rather than allowing open-ended free trials.
* **Follow through after signature.**
  Coordinate payment, onboarding handover, and initial customer activation. Maintain the buyer relationship and resolve commercial blockers while working with the onboarding and product teams.
* **Grow existing accounts.**
  Identify opportunities for paid expansion, additional departments or locations, referrals, and relevant cross-selling as products become available.
* **Build and lead a small field team.**
  Recruit and coach salespeople as the territory grows. Set targets, conduct weekly pipeline reviews, support important deals, and develop a repeatable sales playbook.
* **Maintain sales discipline and market feedback.**
  Keep CRM records, forecasts, and next steps current. Represent Brahmo AI at relevant industry events and share customer feedback and competitor insights with the founders. Distinguish live capabilities from roadmap items and obtain approval before making custom commitments.

What You Bring — Must-Haves

* **5–12 years of relevant B2B sales experience**
  in HIMS/HIS, EMR/EHR, LIMS, hospital SaaS, or closely related healthcare IT products, with a verifiable record of personally closed deals and target achievement.
* **An active hospital network across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh**
  , with recent relationships among owners, promoters, medical directors, or operational decision-makers. Experience selling into 20–200-bed hospitals or larger institutions is particularly relevant.
* **Personal ownership of the full sales cycle.**
  You have sourced opportunities, conducted discovery and demonstrations, negotiated commercials, and closed business—not only supervised others who did.
* **Experience leading or mentoring field salespeople**
  , including target-setting, coaching, follow-up discipline, and pipeline reviews.
* **Confidence demonstrating software yourself.**
  You can learn the core workflows, handle common objections, and explain the value to both doctors and hospital administrators.
* **Fluency in Telugu and English**
  , a Hyderabad base or willingness to relocate, and readiness for extensive field travel across both states. Hindi is an advantage.
* **A bachelor’s degree.**
  An MBA or a healthcare, hospital administration, or pharma background is an advantage.

Relevant backgrounds may include companies such as HealthPlix, Suvarna Technosoft, KareXpert, Attune, Medinous, Insta by Practo, MocDoc, Birlamedisoft, Akhil Systems, or similar healthcare IT vendors.
**Demonstrated sales results matter more than a particular employer name.**

Good to Have

* Experience selling an early-stage or AI-enabled product where you helped develop the positioning and sales approach.
* Relationships in Tier-2 and Tier-3 markets, including Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Guntur, Warangal, Tirupati, Nellore, and Karimnagar.
* Experience selling to hospital chains or specialty groups.
* Familiarity with ABDM/ABHA and hospital digital-health requirements.

Who Will Thrive Here

You are a hands-on seller who opens doors personally and takes responsibility for outcomes. You are comfortable building a territory without an established sales organisation behind you.

You sell consultatively, follow up consistently, and know how to move an opportunity toward a decision. You work independently while recognising when technical or commercial approval is needed.

Above all, you build trust: you represent the product accurately, make realistic commitments, and care whether customers successfully adopt what they purchase.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success will be measured through qualified opportunities, conversion to paid contracts, collected revenue, and commercial follow-through on customer activation—not meetings or proposals alone.

As the team grows, you will also be accountable for team performance, pipeline quality, forecast accuracy, and account expansion. Targets and responsibilities will be agreed with the founders, taking account of product scope and onboarding capacity.

Compensation

**₹5–20 LPA annual compensation, comprising fixed salary and performance-linked incentives.**

**The package will depend on relevant hospital software sales experience, demonstrated closures, territory relationships, and the scope of responsibility. The fixed component, performance targets, incentive calculation, and payout terms will be clearly agreed before joining.**

How to Apply

Apply on LinkedIn with your résumé and a brief note covering:

1. **Products and performance:**
   The healthcare IT products you have personally sold, your buyer segments, and your targets versus achievement.
2. **Three representative closures:**
   Hospital deals in Telangana or Andhra Pradesh, including approximate contract value, sales-cycle length, your personal contribution, and whether the customer went live.
3. **Territory strength:**
   Your strongest markets and hospital relationships across both states, including how recently you engaged with those stakeholders.
4. **Availability:**
   Your current location, notice period, and willingness to travel.

* Applications with specific, relevant sales evidence will be prioritised. Commercially sensitive information may be anonymised; please do not submit confidential customer documents, internal CRM exports, or private contact details.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Company:**
 Rentesy

**Role:**
 Field Sales Executive / Business Development Executive

**Location:**
 Assigned City / Territory, India

**Department:**
 Sales & Business Development

Language: Telugu / Hindi / English

**About Rentesy**

Rentesy is a property management SaaS platform that helps residential communities, gated communities, apartments, and property managers simplify their day-to-day operations. From maintenance and CAM collections to visitor management, complaint tracking, facility management, and digital records, Rentesy brings everything together in one platform.

We're building for India's rapidly growing real estate ecosystem, helping property managers replace manual processes, paper registers, spreadsheets, and scattered WhatsApp conversations with smarter, more efficient digital operations.

**Daily Activity**

This is the front line of Rentesy's growth. You'll be out in the field every day, meeting apartment association representatives, facility managers, property management companies, and builders, demonstrating Rentesy's software, and closing deals that directly contribute to the company's growth.

This isn't a back-office job. If you enjoy meeting people, building relationships, convincing decision-makers, and closing deals, this role is for you. You'll own your territory, manage your sales pipeline, and turn potential customers into paying clients.

**Your mission is simple: find the right customers, demonstrate Rentesy's value, close deals, and make sure every new client gets started successfully.**

**Key Responsibility**

* Visit gated communities, apartment complexes, property management companies, builders, and facility management firms to introduce Rentesy.
* Identify decision-makers, including apartment association presidents, secretaries, treasurers, facility managers, and property management heads.
* Make at least 40 outbound calls and conduct one live product demo per working day.
* Conduct a minimum of four in-person client meetings every week, with regular field visits across your assigned territory.
* Understand customer pain points around maintenance collections, complaints, visitor management, staff coordination, and community operations.
* Demonstrate how Rentesy solves these problems and clearly communicate the value and return on investment.
* Handle objections such as "we already use Excel," "our current process works," or "we don't have the budget" confidently and independently.
* Negotiate and close subscription deals while maintaining approved pricing and discount guidelines.
* Own ambitious monthly and quarterly sales targets for your assigned territory.
* Build relationships with apartment associations, builders, facility management companies, and real estate industry stakeholders to generate referrals and new business.
* Take ownership of onboarding new customers and ensure a smooth transition from sales to product adoption.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, calls, meetings, demos, follow-ups, and deal stages in the CRM every day.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and ensure no qualified lead is lost due to poor follow-up.
* Continuously identify new communities and business opportunities to expand Rentesy's presence in your territory.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong communication skills in English, Hindi, and/or the relevant regional language.
* Excellent persuasion, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Confidence in speaking with apartment association members, facility managers, builders, and business owners.
* A proactive, target-driven attitude with a genuine interest in sales and business development.
* Willingness to travel daily within the assigned territory and conduct in-person meetings.
* Ability to explain software products in simple, practical language to non-technical customers.
* A self-starter who takes ownership of targets, follow-ups, and customer relationships.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment where initiative and results matter.
* Basic familiarity with CRM tools, spreadsheets, and mobile or web applications is an advantage.
* Any graduate can apply. Prior experience in field sales, B2B sales, SaaS sales, real estate, or facility management is preferred, but strong sales ability and willingness to learn matter most.

**Growth Path**

At Rentesy, performance creates opportunities.

Consistently achieve your monthly sales targets for three consecutive months, demonstrate strong product knowledge, maintain an accurate CRM, and show the ability to independently manage your territory to become eligible for advancement to 
**Senior Sales Executive, Assistant Sales Manager, or City Sales Manager**
, based on performance and business requirements.

High performers will have opportunities to take ownership of larger territories, manage sales teams, and help expand Rentesy's presence across new cities.

**Compensation**

**Monthly Fixed Salary:**
 ₹25,000–₹40,000, depending on experience and capabilities, plus travel allowance.

**Performance Incentives:**
 Additional incentives for achieving or exceeding sales targets.

**What You Get:**
 A performance-driven role, direct exposure to real estate technology, opportunities to grow with an ambitious SaaS startup, and the chance to make a measurable impact on how communities are managed across India.

**Who should apply?**

If you're someone who enjoys meeting people, isn't afraid of rejection, can confidently pitch a product, and wants your earnings and career growth to reflect your performance, we'd love to hear from you.

**Come build the future of property management with Rentesy.**

title: GCC Brownfield Sales Leader
description:
**Leading at Cognizant**
This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level:
**Drive our business strategy**
and inspire teams around our future.
**Live the leadership behaviors**
, leading themselves, others and the business.
**Uphold our Values**
, role modeling them in every action and decision.
**Nurture our people and culture**
, creating a workplace where all can thrive.
  
  
At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a GCC Brownfield Sales Leader, you will make an impact by driving revenue growth and strategic expansion within Global Capability Centers (GCCs) by leading sales initiatives, building C-suite relationships, and positioning Cognizant as a partner of choice for strategic transformation, technology integration, and advanced managed services. Drive growth by selling post-setup services (expansion, technology integration, operating model transformation, monetization) to existing GCCs. Shift the service relationship from vendor-based to strategic partnership.
  
  
The "Brownfield" context means engaging with clients who already have an established GCC. Success hinges on understanding their unique evolution stage and challenges.
  
  

* Understand the GCC's Evolution Stage: GCCs mature from cost-centric support units to strategic innovation hubs. Your sales approach must align with their maturity—offering basic operational services to a nascent GCC versus proposing AI-driven innovation partnerships to a mature center.
* Focus on the "Pitcher": A common challenge is that the parent organization ("the pitcher") may not be fully aligned or prepared for a deeper strategic partnership with the GCC ("the catcher"). A key part of the role is to help the onshore leadership manage internal change and see the value of transforming the GCC.
* Address Key Pain Points: Brownfield GCCs often face specific challenges you can solve, such as integrating Generative AI, overcoming talent retention issues, redesigning operating models for better autonomy, and establishing robust data governance frameworks.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Strategic Sales & Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor; articulate value of AI, operating model changes, and monetization strategies. Lead large, complex deal pursuits and negotiations.
* Portfolio Development: Create service offerings for GCC expansion, AI integration, and talent management.
* Stakeholder Management: Navigate complex stakeholder landscapes including GCC leadership and C-suite.
* Market Insight & Positioning: Maintain deep understanding of GCC evolution trends and leverage insights for practice leadership.
* Represent Cognizant’s voice in industry forums and build the GCC service line brand.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen)

**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* Strategic Acumen: Understand GCC strategic drivers like cost optimization and access to talent.
* Technical & Domain Knowledge: Possess strong understanding of AI, cloud infrastructure, and GCC operating models.
* Relationship Management: Excel at building trust, navigating change resistance, and aligning diverse stakeholder groups.
* Solution Selling: Ability to conceptualize/sell complex solutions around AI implementation and operating model changes.
* 20+ years in IT services sales, GCC leadership, Big 4 or global advisory experience preferred.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, & Leading the Business
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It

**Work model –**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client or Cognizant office.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Scientific Business Development Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Aganitha applies advanced AI to accelerate scientific innovation for global biopharma, consumer care, and material science organizations. The team combines data-driven agentic and generative AI with multi-omics and physics-based simulations to support the full biopharma R&D value chain, from target and biomarker discovery through therapeutic design, formulation, and patient stratification. Aganitha works across diverse therapeutic areas, including immunology, metabolic and cardiovascular disorders, rare genetic diseases, oncology, neuroscience, and infectious diseases, turning complex data into actionable insights. Its flagship Igniva™ Agentic AI platform encapsulates over eight years of global R&D collaboration experience into reusable scientific workflows that scale across teams and programs. For consumer care and material science, Aganitha’s solutions enable next-generation formulations through integrated AI, simulation, and multi-omics approaches.

The Scientific Business Development Lead will drive growth by identifying, developing, and closing opportunities with biopharma, consumer care, and material science clients, with a strong focus on AI-enabled R&D solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include prospecting and qualifying leads, conducting discovery meetings, preparing and delivering scientific and business presentations, and managing the end-to-end sales cycle. The role also includes collaborating with internal scientific and product teams to shape offerings, contributing to go-to-market strategies, and maintaining long-term client relationships through account management and strategic planning. The Scientific Business Development Lead will be expected to track market trends, gather competitive intelligence, and provide feedback that informs product roadmap and positioning.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex scientific and business data and convert insights into clear value propositions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills for engaging scientific, technical, and executive stakeholders, both written and verbal.

* Experience in Research and Development (R&D) and research, ideally in biopharma, life sciences, or materials science, with familiarity in AI or data-driven approaches.

* Ability to work cross-functionally with scientific, product, and engineering teams and manage multiple opportunities in parallel.
* Comfort with AI

 BioTradX is India's digital trade infrastructure for biomass, biofuels, and green resources, built to accelerate the country's transition to a sustainable, low\-carbon economy. The platform enables businesses, communities, and ecosystem participants — generators, aggregators, processors, traders, and industrial buyers — to engage in the circular economy through transactions that are seamless, compliant, and transparent.

Through smart infrastructure, data\-driven insights, and trusted digital workflows, the platform unlocks value from underutilized resources while advancing both environmental and economic outcomes.

 \- Work closely with product, operations, and logistics teams to ensure smooth deal execution

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

**Key Competencies** 




**Functional Competencies** 




 \- Strong grounding in B2B sales and business development processes
 



 \- Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills
 



 \- Ability to operate effectively in a field\-driven, target\-oriented environment
 



  





**Behavioral Competencies**

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Business Development Manager – UAV \& Robotics Propulsion Systems** 




**Full\-time \| On\-site (Non\-Hybrid)** 




**Vector Technics Pvt Ltd** 




 SY No 37/A, Plot No. 2\-12, Shamshabad, Rasheedguda, Hyderabad, Telangana 501218
 



  





 You don’t just close deals. You architect the kinetic backbone of the next generation of unmanned systems.
 



 At Vector Technics, we design and manufacture the complete electric propulsion stack — BLDC motors, ESCs, propellers, power electronics, and motion\-control solutions — with uncompromising vertical integration and a 100% indigenous, traceable supply chain. Our systems power mission\-critical UAVs, defense platforms, and advanced robotics across 12\+ countries. We are not chasing the future. We are building the precision that makes it possible.
 



 We are looking for a Business Development Manager who lives at the intersection of deep technical understanding and relentless commercial execution. Someone who can walk into a DRDO lab, a UAV integrator’s engineering review, or a robotics OEM’s strategy meeting and speak their language fluently — because you’ve lived it.
 


 The Role
 
 This is not a desk\-and\-dial job. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based at our advanced manufacturing and engineering facility in Shamshabad, Hyderabad. You will be immersed in the same ecosystem where our propulsion systems are conceived, refined, tested, and built. Real\-time collaboration with design, quality (AS9100\), and production teams is not optional — it is how we win.
 



 You will own the full business development lifecycle for our propulsion and motion\-control portfolio across UAV, defense, and robotics verticals:
 



 ●      Identify, qualify, and convert high\-value opportunities with UAV OEMs, defense primes, system integrators, and robotics companies — both in India and internationally.
 



 ●      Lead complex, technical sales cycles: RFP responses, custom solutioning, technical presentations, and contract negotiations.
 



 ●      Build and nurture long\-term strategic partnerships rather than transactional orders. You will become the trusted advisor who understands not just thrust and KV ratings, but the mission parameters, environmental stresses, and supply\-chain security requirements that actually matter.
 



 ●      Represent Vector Technics at key industry platforms — trade shows, technical working groups, and customer sites — translating field intelligence back into product and process improvements.
 



 ●      Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline, accurate forecasting, and CRM hygiene while working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with leadership on strategic account planning.
 



 ●      Champion indigenous capability. You will articulate why a fully traceable, NDAA\-aligned, Made\-in\-India propulsion solution is not just compliant — it is strategically superior.
 


 Who Thrives Here
 
 You are not a generic “sales guy.” You are a domain\-fluent builder with:
 



 ●      5–8\+ years of proven B2B business development or strategic sales experience selling UAV/drone components, robotics motion systems, aerospace actuators, or mission\-critical power electronics.
 



 ●      Demonstrated success navigating long\-cycle, technical, and often multi\-stakeholder deals in defense, aerospace, or advanced robotics.
 



 ●      Strong technical acumen — you can comfortably discuss motor constants, ESC firmware behavior, thermal management, propeller dynamics, and system\-level integration trade\-offs.
 



 ●      Existing relationships or credible access within the Indian UAV ecosystem, defense procurement landscape, or global robotics integrators (a significant advantage).
 



 ●      Comfort with ambiguity, ownership of outcomes, and the ability to operate with minimal hand\-holding in a high\-growth, high\-standards environment.
 



 ●      Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.
 



 Engineering background (Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, or Mechatronics) is strongly preferred. Experience with AS9100/ISO environments, government tenders, or export\-controlled technologies is a plus.
 


 The Culture You’re Joining
 
 We are a team of engineers, makers, and operators who believe that precision is a moral responsibility when lives and national capability depend on it. Titles are secondary to impact. Feedback flows freely because truth travels faster than hierarchy. We celebrate people who spot problems early, own them completely, and drive elegant solutions — whether on the shop floor or in a customer war\-room.
 



 You will work directly with leadership that still gets their hands dirty on drawings, test data, and supplier development. You will see your wins translated into real hardware flying in the field within months, not years. And you will be part of an organization that treats supply\-chain sovereignty not as a slogan, but as the foundation of credible deterrence and technological independence.
 



 This is a place where “good enough” is unacceptable, where data and testing trump opinions, and where your success is measured by the strength and longevity of the partnerships you build — not just the orders you book.
 


 What We Offer
 
 ●      The chance to play a defining role in one of India’s most credible indigenous propulsion companies during its most aggressive growth phase.
 



 ●      Direct visibility and access to founders and technical leadership who value commercial insight as much as engineering depth.
 



 ●      Competitive compensation with meaningful performance\-linked upside that rewards pipeline quality and revenue impact.
 



 ●      The privilege of working at the physical heart of production — where strategy meets reality every single day.
 



 ●      Exposure to global markets, emerging platforms, and the people actually shaping the future of autonomous systems.
 


 Ready to Build What Matters?
 
 If you are tired of selling commodities and ready to sell capability that strengthens sovereignty and advances real missions, we should talk.
 



 Send your resume and a short, thoughtful note (no more than 200 words) explaining why this mission and this role resonate with you to:
 



**careers@vectortechnics.com**

title: Sales Leader
description:
**Job Description:** 

 SatelliteHR is a new HRMS venture built to bring a modern, workforce\-first product to market. We are looking for a Sales Leader to own the sales function from the ground up: define the go\-to\-market strategy, build and lead the sales team, and take personal ownership of early revenue while the function is still being established.
 



 ‍
 



 This is a founding sales leadership role, not an individual\-contributor position. The right candidate has already carried a quota, has since built or led a sales team, and is ready to do both again at the same time: sell personally in the early stage while designing the process, hiring the team, and reporting directly to the founders on strategy and results.
 



 ‍
 



 The ideal candidate combines direct HRMS, HCM, Payroll, or HR\-Tech sales experience with a track record of building a sales function or team from an early stage, strong consultative selling instincts with CHROs, CFOs, and founders, and the judgment to operate with significant autonomy in a founder\-led environment.
 



 ‍
 


**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 

  




**Sales Strategy and Go\-to\-Market Ownership** 
* Define and own the sales strategy for SatelliteHR, including target segments, pricing approach, and channel mix.
* Build the sales playbook, pipeline stages, and qualification criteria from the ground up.
* Set and own monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets, and report progress directly to the founders.
* Identify and prioritize industry verticals and territories for early market entry, including GCC and other target markets.



  




**Team Building and Leadership** 
* Hire, train, and lead the first sales and business development hires as the function scales beyond the founding stage.
* Build a repeatable onboarding and coaching approach so the team can scale without the Head of Sales personally closing every deal.
* Set individual and team quotas and hold the team accountable to them.



  




**Direct Sales Ownership (Early Stage)** 
* Personally own and close early deals while the team is being built, from prospecting through contract closure.
* Conduct discovery conversations with HR and business leaders to understand workforce challenges and map them to the product.
* Lead commercial discussions, pricing negotiations, and contract closures for strategic accounts.
* Ensure a smooth handover of signed customers to implementation and customer success.



  




**Consultative Solution Selling** 
* Position the HRMS platform as a strategic business solution across HR operations, payroll, attendance, leave management, recruitment, performance management, and employee engagement.
* Act as a trusted advisor to CHROs, HR heads, business heads, founders, and CFOs.
* Build strong, ROI\-driven business cases tailored to each buyer.



  




**Stakeholder Management** 
* Build and maintain relationships with CHROs, HR heads, CEOs, CFOs, founders, and operations heads at target accounts.
* Navigate complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders and influencers.
* Drive consensus and accelerate decision\-making within client organizations.



  




**Market Intelligence and Competitive Positioning** 
* Track HR technology trends, workforce management challenges, and competitor offerings, and translate them into positioning and messaging.
* Feed market insight and customer feedback back into product and founder\-level strategy discussions.



  




**Partnership and Channel Development** 
* Develop relationships with HR consultants, implementation partners, payroll partners, and industry associations.
* Build channel partnerships that extend market reach without requiring a proportional increase in headcount.



  




**Sales Operations and Governance** 
* Stand up and maintain CRM discipline, pipeline reporting, and forecasting from the earliest stage of the company.
* Provide regular pipeline and revenue updates directly to the founders.



  




**Work Experience and Skills:** 
* Proven experience in HRMS, Payroll, HCM, HR Tech, ERP, or SaaS sales, including direct, personal deal ownership.
* Demonstrated experience building or leading a sales team, ideally from an early or founding stage.
* Track record of building a market or sales function from the ground up (0\-to\-1 experience), not only scaling an established one.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and workforce management challenges.
* Excellent consultative and solution\-selling skills, with the ability to sell personally as well as lead others to do so.
* Strong negotiation and commercial acumen.
* Ability to influence senior executives, founders, and business leaders.
* Comfort operating with high autonomy and direct founder\-level accountability, without a fully built\-out organization around the role.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, or similar platforms.



  




**Minimum Qualifications:** 
* At least 2 to 3 years in a role that included building, leading, or mentoring a sales or business development team.
* Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets.
* Experience in startup environments or service\-based businesses is highly desirable.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Human Resources, Information Technology, or a related discipline.



  




**What’s in it for you?** 

  




**Professional Growth \& Impact** 
* The opportunity to build a sales function and team from the ground up at a founding\-stage company, with direct visibility to the founders.
* Ownership of go\-to\-market strategy, not just execution against a plan set by someone else.
* A fast growth path tied to the growth of the company itself, with career coaching and mentorship along the way.



  




**Work Environment \& Culture** 
* Innovative Team: Collaborate with passionate professionals in a fast\-paced, agile environment.
* Autonomy \& Ownership: Take full ownership of your sales pipeline and strategy.
* Mission\-Driven Work: Help startups thrive by solving real operational challenges.



  




**Employee Benefits** 
* Competitive Compensation: Attractive base salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Health \& Wellness: Medical insurance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy including vacation, and holidays.
* Retirement Benefits: PF, and Gratuity.
* Employee Engagement: Regular team events, recognition programs, and a collaborative culture that values your contributions.

description:

**Overview:**
 As a Renewals Manager supporting SMB and Commercial customers, you will own the commercial renewal process for a portfolio of customers, driving predictable retention and identifying opportunities for future growth. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales and cross\-functional partners, you will deliver a seamless renewal experience, proactively manage commercial risk, and help customers realize continued value from their investment in Seismic.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* 3–5 years of experience in Renewals, Account Management, Customer Success, or a related commercial role within a B2B SaaS environment.

* Strong commercial and negotiation skills with the ability to confidently lead customer conversations and achieve successful outcomes.

* Analytical mindset with experience using customer insights, product usage, and CRM data to inform decisions and prioritize work.
* Experience maintaining accurate forecasts and CRM hygiene using Salesforce or a similar CRM platform.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a high\-volume portfolio while maintaining attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative approach to working across Sales, Customer Success and Revenue Operations..
* Self\-motivated, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**What you’ll be doing:**
* Own Commercial Renewals: Manage the end\-to\-end renewal process for an assigned portfolio, delivering timely, accurate, and predictable renewal outcomes.
* Drive Retention: Proactively manage renewal plans, identify commercial risks early, and engage customers to maximize retention and long\-term value.

 Field Sales \& Client Relationship Management
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a Technical Sales Engineer to be the face of our mining equipment business in the field. This is not a desk job. You will be out meeting clients, opening doors, and building relationships, becoming the person a client picks up the phone to call when they need something. Your job is to win trust, spot opportunities, upsell, and act as the client's champion inside our company, pulling in the right technical and commercial people when a deal needs to move. We want ambitious engineers who want to build a career in sales.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Get out into the field: visit clients, prospect actively, and open new doors across the assigned territory.
 



 ● Be the client's first point of contact, answering their calls, understanding their needs, and escalating quickly to the right people inside the company.
 



 ● Act as the client's champion internally, driving their requirements through the organisation.
 



 ● Build and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with procurement and engineering teams.
 



 ● Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and grow account value.
 



 ● Respond to RFQs and RFPs with quotations and proposals respectively.
 



 ● Make technical presentations to customers, which requires studying the applications, use cases, and technical details of all products and services.
 



 ● Engage and win after\-sales services and products, including repairs and recertifications, spares and consumables.
 



 ● Represent the technical strength of our equipment credibly in client conversations. Travel
 



 ● Must be willing to travel, with travel expected to be around 50% of the role. All travel expenses will be covered by the company.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 ● Engineering degree (Mechanical, Petroleum, Production, Industrial, or related). This is key.
 



 ● 3 to 5 years of experience in B2B field sales, ideally in the heavy duty equipment and/or mining industry.
 



 ● Sound grasp of engineering fundamentals: torque, force, momentum, and physical dimensioning, able to hold a technical conversation credibly.
 



 ● Hands\-on exposure to heavy\-duty machinery, positive displacement pumps, centrifugal pumps, shakers, and crushers to name a few. Who We're Looking For

title: Sales Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 SHREE (A Legacy of Fine Jewellery), part of Shree Jewellers, has been a trusted name in fine jewellery in Hyderabad since 1989, known for original design, master craftsmanship, and hallmarked quality. The brand offers a wide range of collections including Diamond, Kundan/Uncut, Bridal, Festive, High Jewellery, and contemporary everyday wear, crafted in gold, diamonds, colored precious stones, silver, and beads for diverse occasions. Each piece undergoes multi\-stage quality checks for gold purity, diamond weight, and stone quality, reflecting SHREE’s commitment to accountability and enduring value. In\-house designers and jewellery stylists provide bespoke customization, maintenance, repair, and doorstep delivery to create highly personal pieces. SHREE currently serves patrons through three stores in Hyderabad—Jubilee Hills, Basheerabagh, and Kokapet—continuing a legacy of trust, excellence, and authenticity spanning more than three decades.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Sales Specialist will work on\-site at SHREE’s Hyderabad locations in a full\-time capacity, supporting patrons throughout their in\-store journey. The Sales Specialist will demonstrate product features, explain materials, craftsmanship, and pricing, and guide customers through selection, customization options, and purchase decisions. Daily responsibilities include managing sales transactions, maintaining accurate records, coordinating with designers and stylists on bespoke orders, and ensuring displays are well\-organized and visually appealing. The role also includes handling customer queries, providing after\-sales support, participating in sales promotions, and contributing to store targets and overall patron experience.

* Strong Communication skills, including clear verbal interaction and confident presentation of products.
* Proven Customer Service abilities, with a focus on building trust, understanding patron needs, and resolving concerns.
* Demonstrated Sales experience, including consultative selling, upselling, and working towards individual and store targets.
* Exposure to Training or mentoring, with the ability to learn quickly and share product and process knowledge with team members.

* Interest in fine jewellery, fashion, or luxury retail, with the ability to understand design, materials, and current trends.
* Ability to work flexible retail hours, including weekends and peak festive seasons, as required.
* Prior experience in jewellery, luxury retail, or customer\-facing roles is preferred; relevant education in commerce, business, or retail management is an advantage.

description:
**About the Role** 




 Niti Aide is an AI solution provider to governments and PSUs across India, with a Telangana\-first focus (planned expansion to Andhra Pradesh). We're looking for someone who can be our on\-ground presence in government offices, building relationships with officials, uncovering real departmental pain points, and helping us track relevant empanelment and tender opportunities along the way.
 



 This is a field\-heavy, relationship\-driven role. You'll spend most of your time outside a desk, visiting offices, meeting officers, following up, and turning conversations into structured notes we can act on.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Visit government department offices (state and district level) to meet with officers and understand their operational challenges
* Do preliminary online research on departments, schemes, and tenders before visits, so conversations are informed and efficient
* Build and maintain relationships with department staff, Section Officers, PAs, and, over time with our support, senior officials
* Represent Niti Aide in meetings on our behalf when we can't be present, and brief us clearly afterward
* Track empanelment opportunities, tender notices, and government procurement processes relevant to our work
* Maintain a day\-to\-day activity log: who you met, what was discussed, what the pain point is, what the next step is
* Prepare short write\-ups, presentations, and documents in English summarizing findings and outreach status
* Learn enough about our AI solutions (what LLMs and AI agents are, and how we apply them for governments and PSUs) to explain it clearly and answer basic questions when representing us



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Comfortable and confident walking into government offices and initiating conversations with officers you don't know
* Working English, able to read/write a short document, WhatsApp update, or email, and follow a meeting conducted in English. Fluent Telugu required.
* Comfortable using a laptop for basic tasks: typing documents, filling forms, browsing, email
* Prior experience in any of the following is a strong plus: liaisoning work (real estate, RERA, registrations), insurance/loan field sales, political or constituency\-level work, or a similar govtech/PSU\-facing consulting role
* Organized, able to keep clear, consistent notes and follow up without being chased
* Comfortable with basic tools (WhatsApp, Google Docs/Sheets, smartphone use) and willing to learn new ones
* No prior tech background required, we'll train you on what LLMs and AI agents are and how to talk about them
* Willing to travel with the team for extended periods, including outside Hyderabad



  





**Compensation** 



* based on experience and fit
* Performance bonus tied to milestones: securing empanelment, tender wins, or projects moving to signed status as a result of your groundwork

description:
Sales Executive — Part\-Time, Hybrid
   

  

 Location: Kukatpalli, Hyderabad
   

 Work Type: Part\-Time \| Hybrid / On\-Site
   

 Industry: EdTech \| Digital Marketing \| Career Education
   

 Experience: 1–2 years preferred; freshers with strong communication and sales ability can apply
   

  

**About ZapScholar**
 ZapScholar is a digital learning platform focused on building practical, job\-ready digital marketing skills.
   

  

 Instead of relying only on classroom theory, ZapScholar focuses on hands\-on learning, real\-world projects, business challenges, and practical industry exposure. Our programs are designed to help learners develop skills they can apply directly in startups, businesses, agencies, and modern marketing teams.
   

  

 We are building a learning environment for people who want to learn by doing, build real skills, and become valuable in the workplace.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We are looking for a Sales Executive who can take ownership of the learner enrollment journey—from the first conversation with a prospective learner to final enrollment.
   

  

 You will speak with students, graduates, working professionals, and aspiring entrepreneurs who are interested in digital marketing and career growth. Your responsibility will be to understand their goals, explain the right ZapScholar program, handle questions and objections, conduct follow\-ups, and convert qualified prospects into enrolled learners.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on sales role, not just a calling position.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Marketing and Training teams to understand lead quality, learner requirements, objections, and market demand, and help improve the overall learner acquisition process.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 1\. Lead Management \& Prospecting
   

  

 \- Contact and qualify leads generated through marketing campaigns, referrals, events, and other channels.
   

 \- Understand each prospect’s career goals, experience, interests, and learning requirements.
   

 \- Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective learners.
   

 \- Identify high\-intent prospects and prioritize follow\-ups accordingly.
   

  

 2\. Sales \& Conversions
   

  

 \- Conduct sales calls and consultations with prospective learners.
   

 \- Clearly explain ZapScholar's programs, learning methodology, projects, outcomes, and value proposition.
   

 \- Conduct online or in\-person program demonstrations and counseling sessions.
   

 \- Handle questions, concerns, and objections professionally.
   

 \- Follow up consistently with interested prospects and move them through the enrollment funnel.
   

 \- Convert qualified prospects into paid enrollments while maintaining a consultative approach.
   

  

 3\. Learner Counseling
   

  

 \- Understand what the learner is trying to achieve before recommending a program.
   

 \- Help prospects evaluate whether ZapScholar is the right fit for their goals.
   

 \- Provide accurate information about programs, schedules, fees, learning structure, and enrollment process.
   

 \- Ensure that learners enter the program with clear expectations.
   

  

 4\. CRM \& Reporting
   

  

 \- Maintain accurate lead and prospect records in the CRM or designated sales\-tracking system.
   

 \- Track calls, follow\-ups, meetings, objections, conversions, and lead status.
   

 \- Provide regular updates on pipeline, conversions, and pending opportunities.
   

 \- Maintain disciplined follow\-up schedules.
   

  

 5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

 \- Work with the Marketing team to improve lead quality and campaign performance.
   

 \- Share recurring objections, learner questions, and market feedback.
   

 \- Coordinate with the Training team when prospects require deeper information about the learning experience.
   

 \- Contribute ideas to improve the sales and enrollment process.
   

  

**Key Performance Areas**
 Success in this role will be measured through:
   

  

 \- Qualified leads contacted
   

 \- Calls and consultations conducted
   

 \- Follow\-up completion
   

 \- Lead\-to\-enrollment conversion rate
   

 \- Number of enrollments
   

 \- Revenue generated
   

 \- Pipeline management and CRM discipline
   

 \- Learner experience and quality of counseling
   

  

**Who We're Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who is:
   

  

 \- Confident and comfortable speaking with new people.
   

 \- Persuasive without being overly aggressive.
   

 \- Strong at listening, understanding needs, and explaining solutions.
   

 \- Comfortable making sales calls and following up repeatedly.
   

 \- Organized enough to manage multiple prospects simultaneously.
   

 \- Target\-oriented and motivated by measurable results.
   

 \- Interested in digital marketing, startups, business, sales, or education.
   

 \- Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
   

 \- Willing to learn, experiment, and improve their sales approach.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required** 
 :
   

  

 \- Strong verbal communication skills.
   

 \- 1\-2 years of experience
   

 \- Basic sales and negotiation ability.
   

 \- Ability to conduct prospecting, follow\-ups, and sales conversations.
   

 \- Basic understanding of digital marketing or willingness to learn.
   

 \- Ability to work from our Kukatpalli location as required.
   

 \- Basic computer skills and familiarity with Google Workspace or similar tools.
   

  

**Preferred** 
 :
   

  

 \- 1–2 years of experience in sales, inside sales, business development, education counseling, admissions, or customer\-facing roles.
   

 \- Experience using a CRM or lead\-tracking system.
   

 \- Previous experience selling courses, education, SaaS, services, or other consultative products.
   

 \- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
   

  

 Freshers: Candidates without prior sales experience can apply if they demonstrate strong communication, confidence, learning ability, and a genuine interest in sales.
   

  

 What You'll Get
   

  

 \- Hands\-on experience in EdTech, digital marketing, and startup sales.
   

 \- Opportunity to work directly with the founding and growth team.
   

 \- Exposure to the complete learner acquisition and sales funnel.
   

 \- Practical experience with lead generation, sales calls, CRM, conversions, and customer psychology.
   

 \- Performance\-based growth opportunities.
   

 \- Opportunity to develop into a larger sales, business development, or growth role based on performance.
   

  

 Important
   

  

 This role is best suited for someone who enjoys talking to people, understanding their problems, selling a valuable solution, and being accountable for results.
   

  

 If you are looking for a role where you simply make calls from a script, this may not be the right position.
   

  

 If you want to learn real startup sales while helping people build practical digital marketing careers, we'd like to hear from you.
   

  

 Apply for the Sales Executive role at ZapScholar.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain working linkages with key stakeholders — community groups, community\-based organisations, government departments, health facilities and other partners.
* Set up and follow up referral pathways, so that people reached through outreach actually access clinic services.
* Organise awareness activities, community meetings and small events in and around Hyderabad.
* Maintain day\-to\-day records of outreach visits, contacts made and referrals completed, and submit reports on time.
* Travel across the city and nearby areas at short notice, as the work demands.
* Coordinate closely with the clinic team and the Programme Lead on daily plans and follow\-up actions.
* Represent YRG MERF and the Sabrang Clinic with courtesy, and maintain confidentiality at all times.

**Requirements**
* Willingness to expend energies on field outreach and to work in a mobile, on\-the\-move role.

* Fluency in English and Telugu at the minimum. Knowledge of Hindi or other languages will be an added advantage.
* Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and e\-mail.
* Capability for independent communication with stakeholders — in person, over the phone and in writing.
* A sensitive and non\-judgemental approach while working with sexual minority communities, and the ability to keep information confidential.


**Benefits**
**Benefits \& Work Environment**
* 24 days of annual leave, in addition to public holidays.
* Health insurance coverage
* Opportunity to work in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
* Scope for learning and professional development.


 YRG is an equal\-opportunity organisation. At YRG, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity as part of our values. Our team are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives.

**About Darwinbox:**
 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform. Brainchild of alumni from world's most distinguished organizations (McKinsey, EY, Google), we are the preferred choice of 850\+ global enterprises to manage their 2\.2 Million\+ employees across 100\+ countries.
   

  

 For three years in a row, we are the fastest growing HCM tech company in the Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Cloud HCM Suites for enterprises with 1,000\+ employees.
   

  

 Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups – Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Adani Wilmar, DLF, Crisil, JG Summit Group, Cebu Pacific Air, Nivea, etc.
   

  

 The vision of Darwinbox to build a world\-class product company from Asia and is backed by marquee global investors like Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners and Microsoft.
   

  

**About The Role:**
 As we scale our Enterprise motion, we’re looking for a specialist who can crack net\-new strategic accounts and land first meetings with Group CHROs, CXOs, and transformation leaders.
   

  

 This is not a volume outbound role; It’s a strategic account\-opening role!!!
   

  

 You’ll identify the right accounts, map complex stakeholder networks, run multi\-threaded outreach, leverage AI and research tools intelligently, and create opportunities that most teams assume are impossible
   

  

**What’s Expected of You:**
* You’ll build your own pipeline.
* You’ll use AI, deep research, LinkedIn, executive referrals, and creative outbound plays to identify and engage decision\-makers.
* You’ll think less about “cadence completion” and more about account penetration.
* One week, you might build a stakeholder map across a large conglomerate. Another week, you might orchestrate a multi\-threaded approach across HR, IT, and business leadership to land a single strategic meeting.
* When the door opens, you hand the opportunity to the enterprise sales team and move on to the next account


**Who will thrive here :**
* People who get energy from winning difficult accounts.
* People who’ve personally opened net\-new enterprise logos.
* People who use AI every day—not because it’s trendy, but because it helps them research better, personalize deeper, and reach executives more intelligently.
* People who can show us one creative outbound strategy they designed and the result it produced.


**What we’re looking for:**
* 5 to 10yrs years in B2B SaaS in the inside sales function/SDR.
* Proven experience opening net\-new enterprise or conglomerate accounts
* Strong track record of reaching senior decision\-makers and creating first meetings
* Enterprise SaaS background preferred; HCM/HR Tech ideal
* Experience with platforms such as Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise ecosystems is a plus

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Consultant, Technical Transformation or equivalent
   

  

 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 Configure and enhance Five9 ACD capabilities: skills, queues, IVR/IVA, call flows, routing strategies, agent profiles, and campaigns.
   

  

* Build and maintain integrations between Five9 and external systems (e.g., CRM such as Salesforce/Dynamics, ticketing, identity/SSO, data/warehouse).
* Develop using Five9 APIs (REST) and platform features (CTI/CRM adapters where applicable), including event handling, screen pops, click\-to\-dial, and dispositioning.
* Implement automation and data workflows: call logging, activity creation, customer lookup, case creation, callbacks, and post\-call processing.
* Support reporting/analytics needs: business dashboards, operational KPIs, data extracts, and reconciliation between Five9 and source systems.
* Troubleshoot production issues (routing, audio, agent login, integration failures), perform root\-cause analysis, and implement fixes with proper change control.
* Ensure solutions meet security, privacy, and compliance requirements (PII handling, access control, retention).
* Create technical documentation: configuration specs, runbooks, test plans, deployment steps, and operational handover.
* Participate in Agile delivery: estimation, sprint execution, code reviews, CI/CD practices where applicable.


**The team:**
 Step into our
 **Sales \& Service** 
 team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end\-to\-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back\-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
   

  

**Qualifications**

* 3 \- 6 years of hands\-on experience in contact center engineering/development with at least 1–2 years hands\-on with Five9\.
* Strong experience with Five9 Studio/IVR and routing/ACD configuration (skills, queues, priority, agent states, campaigns).
* Hands\-on experience building API\-based integrations (REST, OAuth/token auth patterns), plus solid JSON/data mapping.
* Proficiency in at least one general\-purpose language commonly used for integrations (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, C\#) and writing maintainable, testable code.
* Experience with CRM integrations (Salesforce/Dynamics or similar) and common contact center patterns (screen pop, call logging, CTI).
* Working knowledge of telephony fundamentals (SIP, PSTN basics, call flows, DTMF, codecs concepts) sufficient to troubleshoot with telecom partners.
* Strong debugging skills across logs, API traces, and platform configuration; ability to translate business requirements into technical designs.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Five9 certifications (if available/active) or comparable CCaaS certs.
* Experience with WFO/WFM/QM integrations, speech analytics, or AI/IVA platforms.
* Data/BI skills: SQL, Power BI/Tableau, building KPI layers for contact center reporting.
* Experience with SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and enterprise identity patterns.
* Prior work in regulated environments (HIPAA, PCI, SOX, CJIS) and secure SDLC.


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**About the Role** 




 As an International Sales And Operations Specialist \- Travel And Tourism, you will be responsible for handling international travel enquiries, converting leads into bookings, designing suitable travel packages, and managing flight ticketing and related operational activities.
 



  





 You will work closely with customers, airlines, hotels, destination partners, and internal teams to ensure that international travel arrangements are planned accurately and delivered smoothly. The role requires a combination of sales ability, destination knowledge, ticketing expertise, operational coordination, and strong customer communication skills.
 



  





 Your key responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
 



 ● Handling enquiries for international holiday packages and understanding customer travel requirements, preferences, budgets, and timelines.
 



 ● Designing and customising international travel itineraries based on customer requirements.
 



 ● Preparing quotations and package proposals covering flights, accommodation, transfers, sightseeing, activities, and other travel services.

 ● Maintaining accurate booking records, passenger information, travel documents, payment details, and operational updates.

 ● Achieving assigned sales targets, conversion targets, and revenue objectives.
 



 ● Identifying opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling additional travel services.
 



 ● Staying updated on international destinations, travel products, airline fares, seasonal offers, and package trends.
 



 ● Ensuring accuracy in quotations, ticketing, itinerary details, pricing, and customer documentation.

 ● Strong knowledge of international holiday packages and travel destinations.

 ● Good understanding of international flight ticketing, fares, reservations, re\-issuance, and cancellations. 
 



 ● Strong customer handling and communication skills.

 ● Problem\-solving ability and willingness to take ownership of customer and operational issues.
 



  





**Other Job Details**
